all.name: Duet
all.effect: Apply Duet to one player. Bard abilities also originate from that player. May end Duet. Effects stack in overlap; Bard attack targets take +1 hit.

all.name: Rising Hope
all.effect: gain +1 ACC/1 and +1 CR/1. Max 2 Rising Hopes affecting a player.

all.name: Dissonance
all.effect: inflict 3 Bleed/1. Ignores ATK/MAG, half DEF, and outside damage factors. If target hit twice, +3 DMG/1.

all.name: Primadonna
all.effect: If origin has more MAG: gain +4 MAG/1 and -3 MDEF/1. If not: gain +4 ATK/1 and -3 MDEF/1. Targets with both ATK and MAG buffed also gain +1 dice/1, doubled on crit.

all.name: Fantasia
all.effect: Choose: +3 ATK/MAG, +1 ACC/CR, or +4 DEF. Until next turn, Rising Hope becomes Star 2 and grants all selected Fantasia bonuses. Cannot choose same bonus more than once.

all.name: Staccato
all.effect: Reaction: When a foe attacks user or Duet ally (after damage). Hits target and foes in Star 2 of user and Duet ally. inflict -2 DEF/1 and -1 EVA/1 per hit. If attacker kills Duet ally: gain permanent +2 MP, +2 ACC, +2 CR. Ignores outside damage factors.

all.name: Ironclad
all.effect: When attacked for 40+: inflict 2 Cripple/1 on attacker. If 55+ (before effect): nullify 10% damage, deal it back to attacker.

all.name: Mantrap
all.effect: Reaction: When foe ends turn within or enters tile's Star 1: inflict 3 Cripple/1 and -4 DMG/1, then remove.

all.name: Smokescreen
all.effect: Until next turn: attacks entering Burst 2 have -2 Range, -7 DMG. Attacks used within Burst 2 have -2 Range.

all.name: Tinker's Dam
all.effect: Create Stone wall on target and Line 2 in chosen direction. Removed after 2 rounds, or Free action on user's turn. Foes ending turn with Stone in Melee: take 5 damage and inflict 3 Burn/1. Stone acts like Ice, 30 HP to break, 1 EVA.

all.name: Reforge
all.effect: Choose one base stat (except HP). Foe: reduce by 1/3/1, cannot receive buffs to that stat. Ally: multiply by 1.5/1.

all.name: Mending Mantel
all.effect: Place Hearth tile. When user or allies end turn in its Star 3: gain +5 DEF/1 and heal 5 HP. Hearth acts like Stone. Removed when user dies.

all.name: First Aid
all.effect: Heal target for rolled amount. If ally: may use as Standard to add ATK or MAG. Can only target if attacked in last round.

all.name: Ward
all.effect: Cannot be inflicted with debuffs or statuses/1.

all.name: Heaven's Wind
all.effect: Swap targets.

all.name: Martyrdom
all.effect: Gain +15% healing/1. Healed targets gain +1 EVA and +1 MP/1 (max +3). Per dead ally: +15% healing.

all.name: Vestments
all.effect: Choose primary and secondary target (may be same)./1: primary heals 1/4 of damage secondary takes. Self as primary costs 2 uses. Max 1 Vestments per primary.

all.name: Pas de Deux
all.effect: Target takes turn immediately after user. Target cannot use Pas de Deux that turn. If Standard: target loses Movement. Juggernaut target: only 1 Standard.

all.name: Emboîté
all.effect: Targets' abilities on cooldown: use 1 round earlier (E3T->EoT, EoT->Every Turn).

all.name: Fouetté
all.effect: Until next turn: target may use one Once/Twice/Thrice move without expending a use. Cannot target Reactions or Triggers.

all.name: En Pointe
all.effect: May use Class and Item Swift actions as Free. When targeting ally with Dancer action: gain copy of this passive until end of next turn.

all.name: Divertissement
all.effect: Target's next Standard/Full attack next turn: gain +dice faces equal to actions used that turn (max +5). Unaffected by En Pointe.

all.name: Qi Force
all.effect: After non-Free/Swift attack: gain 1 Qi (max 5). Gain +2 ATK/MAG per Qi. Max 2 Qi between turns. Ally dies: gain 1 Qi.

all.name: Soulstep
all.effect: Move up to MP. Targeting before or after movement. Ignores outside damage factors, DEF, and ATK/MAG.

all.name: Eightfold Shield
all.effect: Spend 2+ Qi: gain +1d4+1 DEF per Qi spent./1

all.name: Conversion
all.effect: Spend 1-3 Qi. This turn: attacks become opposite damage type, swap ATK and MAG. Per Qi spent: ignore 5 DEF and gain +1 Range.

all.name: Nirvana
all.effect: Spend any Qi. Next attack: gain +1 dice and +2 DMG per Qi spent.

all.name: Aegis
all.effect: Reaction: When ally in Homing 4 damaged by attack. Move adjacent to ally. Redirect 25% of attack damage to user. User not considered target if not already.

all.name: Pavise
all.effect: Until next turn: when user or ally in Burst 2 hit by attack, damaged players gain +3 DEF/1 per damaged player.

all.name: Impasse
all.effect: Choose: ally/self, or foe. Ally/self: cannot be inflicted with Push/Pull or stat reduction by foes/1. Foe: remove target's buffs.

all.name: Radiance
all.effect: Until next turn: user takes 80% damage from attacks. Aegis redirects 50%.

all.name: Oathkeeper
all.effect: User and target gain Oath of Mercy. Start of turn: heal 2 HP and gain +1 ATK/MAG (max +5). Ends on death. Does not stack.

all.name: Rewind
all.effect: Reaction: When user or foe attacking user rolls attack damage. Reroll up to 3 damage dice. Rerolled dice cannot trigger or negate Bomb dice.

all.name: Warp
all.effect: Teleport to tile in Range 4. Inflict -5 DEF/1 on foes in tile's Burst 1. This turn: attacks pass through players.

all.name: Superposition
all.effect: Roll d20 and store (max 1). Reaction: before user accuracy check, substitute stored roll. Reaction: when foe attacks in Range 4 after accuracy, replace accuracy with stored roll (cannot cause miss).

all.name: Fractal Division
all.effect: This turn: next single-target attack targets 2 foes in Range 4. Loses Splash. User picks target for secondary effects.

all.name: Time's Edge
all.effect: This turn: gain +1 Standard (MR -3). Next 2 Standard/Full: 25% ATK/MAG. If first deals damage, second ignores outside damage factors and ATK/MAG/DEF. Only Reactions and Triggers between these actions.

all.name: Adrenaline
all.effect: Backstep penalty: -1 MP (instead of -2). May use Basic Movement multiple times per turn.

all.name: Lightspeed
all.effect: If target Dashes before user's next turn: choose Glide or Rushdown. Glide: move 2 tiles per MP (max 12). Rushdown: after Dash, Standard in Melee (max 10 tiles, immune to AoO).

all.name: Outmaneuver
all.effect: Spend any MP. Until next turn: attacks from max range gain +1 ACC per 2 MP spent.

all.name: Quick Thinking
all.effect: After last Standard: spend MP, move 1 tile per 2 MP. Ignores Backstep penalty.

all.name: Tunneling
all.effect: This turn: move through tiles and foes as Normal tiles. Cannot end turn on obstructions or Broken tiles.

all.name: Wormhole
all.effect: Place Wormhole on target tile. Swift: user or ally spends half MP (rounded up) to teleport to Wormhole. Expires on use or after 2 rounds.

all.name: Hunter's Mark
all.effect: When Crossbow attack resolves: targets gain 1 Mark. Attacks deal +1d4 damage per Mark on target. Marks only apply to their user's abilities.

all.name: Arrow Flurry
all.effect: If target has Mark: Splash 1. If target has 3+ Marks: Splash 2 instead.

all.name: Cursed Bolts
all.effect: inflict 3X Curse/1 (X = Marks on target). If target has 3+ Marks: ignores negative outside damage factors.

all.name: Arrow Net
all.effect: Before damage: target takes 3 damage each time they gain a Mark from user/1.

all.name: Pierce
all.effect: If target has 1+ Marks: ignores EVA and 1/4 DEF. If 2+ Marks: also ignores negative ACC modifiers and ignores 1/2 DEF.

all.name: Bolt Compaction
all.effect: This turn: Standard Crossbow attacks lose secondary effects. Next turn: first Standard attack gains +1 dice and the negated effects.

all.name: Quick Scope
all.effect: Ignores ATK/MAG, half DEF, and outside damage factors (except Hunter's Mark).

all.name: Explosive Shot
all.effect: The target holds a "Bomb". If a foe with a Bomb targets another foe (including their allies) they transfer the Bomb to one of their targets.\nAfter one round or when the holder dies, the Bomb detonates and deals Xd4 Bomb damage to foes in the Bomb's Burst 1. X = the foe who held the Bomb with the most Marks.

all.name: Tornado Bolt
all.effect: Push X (X = 1 + Marks on target). If target cannot be pushed full distance: gain +1 Mark.

all.name: Shadow Quiver
all.effect: Next Standard attack becomes Magical, treats non-player obstructions as Air, ignores non-targets. Loses 2 damage per Air tile passed through.

all.name: Serrated Arrows
all.effect: inflict X Bleed/1 (X = half of Hunter's Mark damage from this attack).

all.name: Final Hour
all.effect: Next attack: Hunter's Mark gains +4 dice faces.

all.name: Bolt Arsenal
all.effect:
When using single-target Standard Crossbow attack: choose one Bolt.
Bounty Bolt: target gains half the Marks of latest slain foe.
Split-Head Bolt: targets another foe, loses Splash.
Reeling Bolt: Pull target to tile in user's Line 3-6.
Each Bolt: once until refresh. Swift: refresh Bolts.

all.name: Quiver of Thunder
all.effect: Foes: can only target entities in their Line 8/1. If attack user in Melee: gain +1 Mark.

all.name: Bound Bow
all.effect: Physical attacks become Magical when targeting at Range 3+. Once per turn: when attacking at Range 1-2, gain +3 DEF/1.

all.name: Swift Shot
all.effect: If target is at Range 7+: crit on 14+. If target is under Range 3: gain +1 MP/2.

all.name: Crippling Shot
all.effect:
Effect varies by range.
1-2: inflict Slow/1.
3+: inflict 2 Cripple/1 on accuracy 14+.
7+: inflict Cripple regardless of accuracy.

all.name: Blessed Arrow
all.effect: Allies in target's Star 2: healing and buffs x1.25/1. Foes in target's Star 2: debuffs x1.25/1. Does not stack. As non-damaging Standard: 1/Tile/Range 10.

all.name: Scatter Shot
all.effect: If target is at Range 7+: Splash 1.

all.name: Dispell Bow
all.effect: This turn: +2 MP, ranged attacks Range becomes 3. Next turn: +1 MP, ranged attacks Range becomes 6.

all.name: Arcane Shot
all.effect: If target under Range 3: Push 3. If target at Range 7+: ignores up to 10 DEF.

all.name: Chase Arrow
all.effect: Targets within 8 tiles. May target foes on path to original target (path cannot exceed range). Damage to path foes: ignores ATK/MAG and DEF.

all.name: Volley
all.effect: If target is 7+ tiles away: +1 hit. If foes in Splash 1 of target: +2 hits. Bonus hits target random foes in Splash 1 (including original). Each: half target DEF, ignores ATK/MAG.

all.name: Fireworks
all.effect: If target at Range 7+: Bomb dice. If target under Range 3: Bound Bow becomes +5 DEF/1 and +1 MP/1 until user attacks at Range 3+.

all.name: Sniper's Focus
all.effect: This turn: Standard actions become Full. Range 7+ effects trigger at Range 4+.

all.name: Bound Gauntlet
all.effect: After Physical attack: deal magic damage equal to damage dealt (after DEF) to different foe in Melee. After Magical attack: next Physical attack ignores 5 DEF and cannot miss.

all.name: Tactical Sniper
all.effect: Game start: designate Bounty. Attacks on Bounty: treat obstructions as Air, +1 Range. Melee on Bounty: +1 dice. Bounty dies: designate new Bounty.

all.name: Hawkeye
all.effect: Gain +2 ACC on all attacks. Trigger before Standard: sacrifice up to 5 ACC, gain equal CR until next turn.

all.name: Blitz
all.effect: Crit on 18+. Per hit: gain +4 damage on next attack.

all.name: Windmill
all.effect: Non-Foe targets: gain +X ACC or CR/1 (X = players in range). As Swift: buffs halved. Attack only as Standard against Foes.

all.name: Hook Shot
all.effect: If +2 CR: Pull user within Range 2 of target, or target within Range 2 of user. Not an attack on Allies.

all.name: Splinter
all.effect: Per crit: next attack gains -1.5 dice faces and +1 base dice. Dice faces round up

all.name: Salvo
all.effect: May target different foes per hit. Adds ATK/MAG and applies damage effects to each.

all.name: Trick Shot
all.effect: If +ACC: Splash 1. If +4+ ACC: becomes Magical, Splash 2.

all.name: Surge
all.effect: Per crit: next multi-hit attack gains +1 hit.

all.name: Venom Shot
all.effect: Non-Hawkeye +ACC treated as +CR. inflict Poison/1 (X = 2 * +CR). If 12+: halve poison, extend 1 round.

all.name: Sagittarian Pride
all.effect: Hits = number of moves targets used since user's last turn.

all.name: Arrow Storm
all.effect: Crit on 18+.

all.name: Shrapnel Tip
all.effect: Per crit: gains +1 hit (MR 3, 2d3+0).

all.name: Overdraw
all.effect: Next attack gains one bonus:\nIf single-hit: non-duration numbers doubled (including X).\nIf multi-hit: +ACC treated as +dice faces on accuracy rolls.

all.name: Crimson Pact
all.effect: When user damages a foe: sacrifice 10% of damage dealt as HP (if able). Gain permanent bonus damage equal to HP sacrificed. CP gained from effect-derived sources.

all.name: Bloodrush
all.effect: If used from max range: gain +5 DMG/1 and +1 MP/1.

all.name: Defile
all.effect: inflict 3 Curse/1. When foe takes Curse damage: user takes equal CP.

all.name: Purloin Youth
all.effect: Attacks targeting user: 10% recoil/1. User sacrifices half recoil to CP.

all.name: Sanctified Blade
all.effect: Next single-target attack: CP sacrifice +10%. If foe targeted user since last turn: +5%.

all.name: Pentagram
all.effect: Start of next turn: foes in user's Burst 1 take 2d6+3 + user's CP damage.

all.name: Black Magic
all.effect: Per 5 CP: +1 DEF. Per 7 CP: +1 ACC. Per 10 CP: +1 dice.

all.name: Massacre
all.effect: If kill: gain 2x CP and +1 use of Massacre. If not: no CP sacrifice.

all.name: Covenant
all.effect: Target shares user's Black Magic buffs and gains CP passive/1. CP gained by target applies to user instead.

all.name: Exsanguinate
all.effect: If CP from this move grants Black Magic bonus: +1 to that bonus.

all.name: Siphon Soul
all.effect: Before accuracy: heal HP equal to CP.

all.name: Oblation
all.effect: Next attack this turn: double damage from CP.

all.name: Total Depravity
all.effect: CP sacrifice +5%. Start of turn: if attacked last turn, take damage equal to CP. Cannot kill user.

all.name: Bloodbind
all.effect: Twice per turn before attacking. Sacrifice any CP. Per CP: +1 DMG this turn, heal 1 HP on Standard/Full hit.

all.name: Reaper's Touch
all.effect: When user damages a foe: heal 1/8 of damage dealt.

all.name: Reap
all.effect: Reaper's Touch heals 1/5 instead of 1/8 on this attack.

all.name: Hades' Toll
all.effect: Reaper's Touch heal +50% on attacks against target/2.

all.name: Haunted Swing
all.effect: Targets at full HP: +5 damage. Heal 5 HP per target triggered.

all.name: Wither Soul
all.effect: Per debuff or status on target: Reaper's Touch heals +3 HP.

all.name: Pestilent Strike
all.effect: inflict X Poison/1 (X = Reaper's Touch healing from this attack). If X >= 6: halve poison, extend 1 round.

all.name: Coup de Grâce
all.effect: If kill: heal 10 HP, gain +5 damage to next attack.

all.name: Spirit Break
all.effect: inflict -3 DEF/1. gain +3 DMG/1.

all.name: Memento Mori
all.effect: Delay-1. May delay up to +2 more turns. Per extra delay: Reaper's Touch heals +1/8 of damage.

all.name: Phantasmal Shield
all.effect: Target heals 15% of damage taken/1. Per Standard/Full hit on target: -5% (min 0%).

all.name: Stroke of Midnight
all.effect: Before damage: Reaper's Touch healing becomes +damage on this attack/1. Other Scythe healing becomes +DMG/1.

all.name: Phantom Blade
all.effect: Reaper's Touch heal on this attack = HP healed from Scythe abilities (except Phantom Blade) last round.

all.name: Immortal Coil
all.effect: First death: set to 1 HP, take turn immediately. Immune to damage during bonus turn. Then take overkill damage. Turn order resumes.

all.name: Quietus
all.effect: Attacks auto-hit and kill targets below 25% HP.

all.name: Whittle
all.effect: Sacrifice 10 HP: create Totem tile on target (removes existing). Range Burst 1. Type: Blood, Bone, or Soul (starts Blood). Cannot be overwritten.

all.name: Totem of Blood
all.effect: Totem becomes Blood. Within Homing 6 of Blood Totem: may originate Totem moves from it. gain +5 DMG, -1 Range.

all.name: Void's Call
all.effect: Pull targets towards Totem tile instead of user.

all.name: Left-Hand Path
all.effect: User moves along line from origin until hitting obstruction. If no Totem: inflict -2 EVA/1 and -3 DEF/1.

all.name: Totem of Bone
all.effect: Totem becomes Bone. Within range: +5 DEF, immune to AoE and Splash from foes outside range.

all.name: Heredity
all.effect: Totem moves adjacent to target. Heal HP sacrificed to create it. If no Totem: place one on target's tile.

all.name: Totem of Soul
all.effect: Totem becomes Soul. User and allies: sacrifice 8 HP (Every Turn Free) within range. gain +1 MP

all.name: Feral Spark
all.effect: Target: 10% recoil/1. User's current Totem type numerical effects doubled.

all.name: Blasphemy
all.effect: inflict 6 Curse/1. While Cursed: targeting an ally extends Curse 1 round.

all.name: Effigial Pyre
all.effect: Destroy Totem: inflict 13 Burn/1 on foes in tile's Burst 1. Current Totem type loses effects for game. Totem range becomes Burst 2.

all.name: Sacrificial Lamb
all.effect: Before accuracy: players in Totem range sacrifice 5 HP. Per sacrifice: +1 target, +1 base dice, -1 MR.

all.name: Ancestral Wrath
all.effect:
Requires Totem within Range 5. Targets within Totem range. Effects by type:
Blood: targets cannot leave Totem range/1.
Bone: cleanse debuffs/statuses on allies, cleanse buffs on foes in range.
Soul: heal allies in range for 1/3 of damage dealt.

all.name: Animatus
all.effect: Non-Animated Totem on unoccupied tile: becomes Animated. Sacrifice any HP: becomes Totem's HP, gained as Shield/1. Animated Totem is allied entity, shares user's DEF. Removed when user or Totem at 0 HP.\nWith Animated Totem: move up to MP, deal 3d10 to foes in Totem range.

all.name: Egregore
all.effect: When user kills foe: Animated Totem gains overkill as HP. If not Animated: becomes Animated with HP = overkill. Choose one active ability from foe: Animated Totems may use it for rest of game (replaces Animatus damage).

all.name: Triumvirate
all.effect: Swap subweapons (Standard). Gladius: +1 dice. Scutum: ranged attacks on user lose 5 damage. Pilum: Melee attacks gain +3 Range. Swapping from effects: always occurs. Start in Gladius.

all.name: Exercitus
all.effect: Gladius: swap to Scutum. Scutum: Push 3, swap to Pilum. Pilum: inflict 4 Cripple/1, swap to Gladius.

all.name: Disengage
all.effect: Gladius: inflict -2d6 DEF/1, Push 1. Scutum: half AoE damage/1, push back 1. Switch to Pilum.

all.name: Forward Jab
all.effect: Requires Pilum. +1 base dice

all.name: Breach
all.effect: Switch to Gladius or Scutum. Gladius: foes entering melee take 3d8 damage/1. Scutum: user and allies in Burst 2 cannot have DEF ignored/1.

all.name: Phalanx
all.effect: Requires Scutum. Reaction: when foe hits user or ally in user's melee. If target in melee: +1 dice, swap to Gladius. If not: swap to Pilum. Ignores outside factors, ATK/MAG, half DEF.

all.name: Shield Wall
all.effect: Requires Gladius or Pilum. Switch to Scutum. Flat modifier on base rolls targeting user becomes negative/1. May be non-damaging Standard.

all.name: Iberian Steel
all.effect: Subweapons are used on weapon attack/standard. Next attack in least-used subweapon: +1 dice. If 2+ fewer uses: also +2 ACC.

all.name: Deus Vult
all.effect: Requires Scutum. Before accuracy: immune to statuses and debuffs/1, remove existing.

all.name: Invigorate
all.effect: Bonus varies by subweapon.\nGladius: +5 DMG/1. Scutum: 7 Shield/1. Pilum: +1 ACC/1 and +1 CR/1.

all.name: Dual Wield
all.effect: Before moving: MP halved

all.name: Weapon Crash
all.effect:
Varies by subweapon.
Gladius: 1/Foe/Melee, +3 dice faces.
Scutum: AoE/Foes/Cone 2, attacks on user immune to positive outside factors/1.
Pilum: AoE/Foes/Pierce 5, -3 MR.
Dual Wield: pick one range and one effect.

all.name: Impede
all.effect: Pilum: steal targets' buffs (duration 1). Switch to Scutum.\nScutum: becomes AoE/Foes/Beam 4. Switch to Gladius.\nGladius: gain +1 MP/1, reduce other cooldowns 1 round. Switch to Pilum.

all.name: Hastiliarius
all.effect: Subweapon bonuses:\nGladius: +0.5X dice. Scutum: +X DEF. Pilum: +0.5X ACC.\nX = uses of least used subweapon.

all.name: Thwack
all.effect: Only Stun can prevent use. +1 dice per 5 ATK or MAG (whichever higher) target has above 20.

all.name: Grave of Titans
all.effect: Ignores DEF. Per 10 max HP target has above 120: +3 DMG, -1 MR. If damage reduced by foes: next Standard/Full gains +1 ACC/1, +1 CR/1, and +1 dice.

all.name: Inertial Shift
all.effect: If foe moved or attempted to move user last round: +2 dice, becomes Homing 8 (Pull 7).

all.name: Pole Vault
all.effect: Teleport to unoccupied tile in range (ignores range reduction, even on miss). Targets foes in Splash. If no foes: not an attack.

all.name: Adaptive
all.effect: When user misses Standard/Full: buffs apply to next Standard/Full, which gains +2 ACC, 10% of missed damage, and ignores 5 DEF.

all.name: Fair Fight
all.effect: Next single-target target becomes Duel Partner/2. Ends on death or user damages other foe. User deals/takes 30 less damage from non-DP foes. If DP has allies or is monster: 5 instead.

all.name: Hardwood Slam
all.effect:
Choose status if condition met. -2 MR (Poison), +2 dice (Confusion), or heal 5 HP (Bleed).
5 Poison/2: if user ACC negative or target EVA increased.
Confusion/2: if target's ACC caused them to hit or trigger effect on user/allies.
6 Bleed/2: if target crit or had +dice on attack on user/allies.

all.name: Exploit Feign
all.effect: inflict -4 DEF/1 or -4 DMG/1. If user debuffed by foe: cleanse before accuracy, +1 hit, debuff doubled.

all.name: Stance Breaker
all.effect: If target gained >5 DEF, HP or Shield last round: advantage dice. gain 75% of highest as Shield/1.

all.name: Defiance
all.effect: Reaction: when foe statuses user or targets outside Range 4. Teleport to unoccupied tile in their Melee. Next Standard/Full: +2 ACC

all.name: Calamitous Trance
all.effect: If target dealt 50+ to user last round: +3 dice. If 75+: +4 dice faces. -1 MR per hit on user since last turn. Confusion/2 when MR < 4.

all.name: Paragon
all.effect: Adaptive numerical bonuses tripled. Turns: gain 5X Shield, attacks +5X% damage. X = times targeted by foes since last turn.

all.name: Martial Mastery
all.effect: Move up to MP+1, all tiles except final treated as Normal. This turn: attacks ignore obstructions and DEF, invert foe's negative outside damage factors.

all.name: Disarm
all.effect: Each target's next Standard/Full on user: -1 dice

all.name: Spurn
all.effect: If target can attack from Melee next turn but doesn't: user may AoO them at end of turn.

all.name: Figure 8
all.effect: Reaction: when foe willingly moves out of user's Range 2 from Melee

all.name: Reversal
all.effect: If target can end turn on different tile type but doesn't: gain +2 ACC/1, next attack ignores half DEF.

all.name: Wear Down
all.effect: Per MP target uses next turn: gain +3 DEF until next turn.

all.name: Guard
all.effect: Next Tonfa move: replace instances of the user with this target.

all.name: Yin Yang
all.effect: Choose Yin or Yang.\nYin: Physical/Melee. If target doesn't damage user next turn: target takes 1d8+5.\nYang: Magical/Homing 4. Foes take 1d8+5 when damaging user/1.

all.name: Standoff
all.effect: If target ends next turn in user's Melee: user may AoO (ignores ATK/MAG).

all.name: Dazing Hook
all.effect: Range cannot be reduced. If target attacked user outside Melee last round: inflict Confusion/1 and Inverse Bomb dice/1.

all.name: Hold Over
all.effect: Declare range type. If foes target user with attacks of that range type outside Melee: user may AoO/1.

all.name: Gale Force
all.effect: Regardless of accuracy: teleport any targets to any unoccupied tiles in range. Not an attack on Allies or when Movement.

all.name: Aikido
all.effect: When user uses 2 attacks of same damage type in one turn: gain +2 DEF and ATK/MAG of opposite type. Resets if effect doesn't occur.

all.name: Tempest Sweep
all.effect: Choose Honte or Gyakute.\nHonte: Physical. Next turn: Tonfa effects lasting 1 round/turn last +1 round/turn.\nGyakute: Magical. Next Tonfa attack gains Star 2 Splash.

all.name: Bloodlust
all.effect: When user deals or takes 15+ damage: gain 1 Rage.

all.name: Feral Chop
all.effect: X = 2.5 * user's Rage.

all.name: Chain Axe
all.effect: Bloodlust grants +1 Rage per damage instance/1.

all.name: Power Swing
all.effect: Spend X Rage: -X MR

all.name: Wide Slash
all.effect: Up to 2x: spend 2 Rage for +1 range.

all.name: Vindictive
all.effect: Gain 2 Rage on kill or miss.

all.name: Knockback
all.effect: inflict Slow/1. Spend 1 Rage: +1 Push and/or inflict Cripple 6/1 instead.

all.name: Franciscate
all.effect: Gain +2 MP

all.name: Gash
all.effect: Spend Rage: inflict 5 Bleed/X (X = Rage spent).

all.name: Sever
all.effect: Spend Rage: +1 hit and +1 MR per Rage.

all.name: Amped Strike
all.effect: +damage = 4 * user's Rage. Lose all Rage.

all.name: Swing Cycle
all.effect: Start of turn: spend 2 Rage to reset cooldowns/frequencies of last 2 attacks.\nChain Axe becomes EoT. Start with 1 Rage.

all.name: Wrath
all.effect: Spend 2 Rage per effect (cost +1 each use). Choose: +4d10 base roll, Splash 2, or -3 MR. -2 ACC on Tile.

all.name: Unstoppable Force
all.effect: If foe blocks target from full Push: that foe is hit and targeted. Pushed towards where target would have reached.

all.name: Cyclone Sweep
all.effect: +dice = number of targets hit.

all.name: Storm Strike
all.effect: Teleport to tile in target's Splash 1. inflict Slow/1.

all.name: Seismic Smash
all.effect: inflict 2 Cripple/2.

all.name: Masonry
all.effect: If unoccupied: tile becomes Stone (acts like Ice, 30 HP, 1 EVA). Removed after 2 rounds. Can be Pushed/Pulled (no damage).

all.name: Stonemason
all.effect: Hammer effects ignore Ice Clause on player-created tiles.

all.name: Crush
all.effect: If target cannot be pushed full distance: +1d10+5 damage.

all.name: Earth Render
all.effect: After damage or miss: replace up to 2 unoccupied tiles in Burst 2 of target with Broken (2 rounds, or until user dies/removes as Trigger).

all.name: Lagging Spin
all.effect: Ignores 4 DEF per MP spent moving away from start tile. If all MP spent moving away: +2 dice.

all.name: Gravity Well
all.effect: Next attack this turn: before accuracy, choose non-Splash target. Pull another entity in target's Burst 2 to tile in target's Burst 1.

all.name: Shockwave Slam
all.effect: Splash hits foes in target's Star. Original target: Push 2 in chosen direction. Splash targets: Push 2 away from original.

all.name: Collision Course
all.effect: Original target: Push to tile in their Range 5. Subsequent: Push to tile in their Range 3. Can Push user/allies via Unstoppable Force (no damage). Each target once.

all.name: Aftershock
all.effect: Reaction: after user pushes target. Move up to tiles pushed in that direction. Then deal 1d10+6 to foes in user's Burst 1.

all.name: Fissure
all.effect: Regardless of hit: push target. Tiles target exits while pushed become permanent Broken (unremovable, unignorable). Foes entering Burst 1 of Broken: 2d8 damage, once/turn per foe. User may remove any as Trigger on their turns.

all.name: Heavy Weapon
all.effect: Cannot leave foe's Melee without teleporting. Tomahawk ability at max listed range: gains Apex. Apex includes final row/column of Beam.

all.name: Razor Rust
all.effect: Target: 3 MP/1. Apex: inflict 5 Cripple/1.

all.name: Tomahawk Toss
all.effect: X = 4 - range used at. Apex: Pull 3

all.name: Plate Crusher
all.effect: When user moves foe with non-Apex Tomahawk: foe takes 2 damage per tile. Apex attacks ignore 5 DEF.

all.name: Kip Up
all.effect: Push regardless of hit. May negate Push: teleport 1 tile away from target. Ignores outside damage factors, ATK/MAG, DEF.

all.name: Repulse Slice
all.effect: No Push on Apex. Apex: per tile target moves toward user next turn: Plate Crusher values +1.

all.name: Continental Crash
all.effect: After Push: place Broken tile in target's Melee (3 rounds). User may remove as Trigger. Foes ending turn in tile's Melee: 10 damage. Apex: hits foes in target's Splash 1.

all.name: Discipline
all.effect: Start of target's next turn: gain +3X DEF/1 (X = 3 - range used). Apex: if last attack had Apex, next attack applies that Apex effects (excluding extra hits).

all.name: Kinetic Impact
all.effect: If target cannot be moved full distance: +1 dice. Apex: -2 Push, +2 dice faces.

all.name: Two Handed
all.effect: If user didn't push target last turn: +2 Push. Apex: if target can't be moved full distance: inflict 7 Bleed/1.

all.name: Elastic Collision
all.effect: Before targeting: move up to MP in straight line (half diagonals). X = 1 + tiles moved. Apex: +2 CR.

all.name: Supreme Strikes
all.effect: 1 Push per hit. May target in two directions, or +1 hit in one direction. Each direction: accuracy and Apex independently. Apex: +2 hits in this direction.

all.name: Fleet Footwork
all.effect: Once per turn: after Apex attack, teleport user or target up to 2 tiles.

all.name: Line Out
all.effect: If next attack can target a foe in Apex: range may be treated as Pierce instead of Line.

all.name: Right to Rule
all.effect: Start with 3 Campaigns (max 3). Each: +2 DEF. Lose 1 when dealing or receiving 10+ damage at once.\nAttack with 0 Campaigns: +1 dice, +1 ACC.

all.name: Coronation
all.effect: Reaction/Trigger: when reaching 0 Campaigns, or start of turn with 0. Right to Rule max +1. Gain max Campaigns.

all.name: Besiege
all.effect: Before accuracy: sacrifice up to 10 HP. Gain equal Shield/1. 1.5x if target >50% HP.

all.name: Bastion
all.effect: Foe attacks entering user's Cone 1: lose 2 dice/1. While in Melee of current tile: +4 DEF.

all.name: Catapult Campaign
all.effect: Cannot use at Range 2. Target >75% HP: inflict 5 Bleed/1. May self-inflict 10 Bleed/1 to double Bleed.

all.name: Ambush
all.effect: Lose all Campaigns. Coronation disabled until next turn. Per Campaign lost: gain +0.5 MP/1

all.name: Entrench
all.effect: If less than 6 bonus DEF: gain +3 DEF/1. Lose +1 Campaign per RtR instance/1.

all.name: Crusade
all.effect: Until next turn: gain +1 MP

all.name: War of Attrition
all.effect: Before damage: inflict inverse of user's active RtR bonuses/1.

all.name: Shock and Awe
all.effect: If 3+ Campaigns: attacks on user immune to positive outside factors/1.

all.name: The Art of War
all.effect: Choose War or Peace.\nWar: Physical. If 0 Campaigns: +dice faces = 1.5x Campaign max.\nPeace: Magical. Until next Standard/Full: target has -X/3 MP, -2X ATK/MAG (X = user's Campaigns).

all.name: Last Stand
all.effect: When user would take >55-3X damage (X = Campaign max): attacker takes 3d8+2, damage reduced by 3X/1.

all.name: Declaration of War
all.effect: Gain +1.5 DEF per Campaign. Start with 0 or 4 Campaigns (choice).

all.name: Imperial Tyranny
all.effect: Foes in Star 3: -0.5 DEF and -0.5 ATK/MAG per Campaign. If 0 Campaigns: foes attacking user take 10% recoil.

all.name: Resolute Blade
all.effect: Gain/lose 1 Resolve per HP lost/gained (min 0). On miss or kill: regain Resolve spent on that attack. If Resolve > 100 before attack: Advantage dice. Max 20 Resolve from self-damage per round.

all.name: Cursed Slice
all.effect: +1 CR. Target's next Standard/Full: 5% recoil. Spend 10 Resolve up to 5x: +1 CR and +5% recoil per spend.

all.name: Lunge
all.effect: Move adjacent to target (even on miss). Spend 20 Resolve up to 3x: -1 MR per spend. After damage: choose +10% damage dealt and taken/1.

all.name: Blade of Woe
all.effect: Before damage: inflict 5 Curse/1 on user and target. First Resolve spend after taking 55+ damage while Cursed: resolve effect +1/3.

all.name: Fallen Blade
all.effect: At 25%, 50%, 75% HP missing: gain 1 Enrage (once each). +1 dice per Enrage.

all.name: Kensei
all.effect: Start of next turn: gain Resolve = X% of Resolve gained since use. X = 150 - user's max HP (max 20%).

all.name: Lotus Strike
all.effect: Spend all Resolve. X hits = Resolve/30. 5*X% recoil (no Resolve from recoil).

all.name: Delirium
all.effect: Spend 25 Resolve per debuff. X = Enrage: inflict -X ACC/1, -X CR/1, -X dice/1, -5X DEF/1.\nSpend 30 more: if cleansed or prevented, target gains disadvantage dice/1.

all.name: Provoke
all.effect: If target doesn't deal 45+ to user next turn: Resolve gain x1.75/1. Resolve gained since Provoke also x1.75.

all.name: Bloodspill
all.effect: Spend 40 Resolve: Burst 1 or Cone 2. Spend 70: Burst 2 or Cone 3. Per kill: no use consumed, +1 Enrage, advantage threshold -20.

all.name: Bushido
all.effect: Choose up to 2 allies. Gain Resolve = 50% of damage they took from attacks that didn't target user/1.

all.name: Rising Sun
all.effect: Spend up to 100 Resolve: gain X% of damage as Shield/1 (X = Resolve/1.5). If first ability this turn: turn continues until another non-Standard/Full. While Shield active: healing doesn't reduce Resolve.

all.name: Giant Slayer
all.effect: If the user has less HP than the target, they may spend up to X Resolve, where X is the difference between the user's and target's HP. For every 10 Resolve spent, gain +2+Y damage, where Y is current Enrage.

all.name: Zanshin
all.effect: Max 150 Resolve. When exceeding max: next attack gains +1 ACC/1, +1 CR/1. Fallen Blade: every 1/6 HP.

all.name: Fudoshin
all.effect: Zanshin's exceed bonuses doubled. Enrage dice doubled on crit.

all.name: Allez
all.effect: Reaction: once between turns on attack involving user. Remove 1 dice, store Focus = half of removed dice faces.

all.name: Point-in-Line
all.effect: inflict -2 dice faces/1. If debuff not active: gain +2 dice faces/1. Spend Focus: increase one effect by half.

all.name: Thrust
all.effect: Move to tile in target's Melee. If damage removed by outside factors: inflict 2 Bleed/1. Spend Focus: +Bleed or +1 duration.

all.name: Deflect
all.effect: Reaction: when foe attacks user. Attack loses 10% damage, store as Focus. If attack moves user: Pull 2. Ignores non-Rapier outside factors.

all.name: Counter
all.effect: Reaction/Standard: when foe deals 40+ to user. Ignores ATK/MAG/DEF and non-Rapier outside factors. Active Rapier effects +1 round. Next spent Focus x1.5.

all.name: En Garde
all.effect: Spend up to 2 Focus. Per Focus: target gains HP or +DEF/1 equal to its value. May move 2 tiles after next reaction.

all.name: Feint
all.effect: Targets take half of out-of-turn damage from user/1. Spend Focus: target gains Focus*2% recoil/1.

all.name: Parry
all.effect: Reaction: on attack involving user (no Rapier reaction since last turn). Attack loses all damage and dice buffs. Store Focus = removed buff's value.

all.name: Patinando
all.effect: Per dice 4+: +1 Push. Per dice <4: inflict 3 Cripple/1 (stacking). After damage: spend Focus to replace dice with its value.

all.name: Moulinet
all.effect: Target gains +4 DMG/1 or +4 DEF/1. Spend Focus: heal 3 HP per ability target uses next turn. If no Focus spent: next Focus gains half-value Focus.

all.name: Redoublement
all.effect: Spend any Focus: +1 hit per Focus. Each Focus hit: +CR equal to Focus value.

all.name: One for All
all.effect: Ignores 1/4 DEF. May change splash: Star 2 (1/2 DEF) or Line 2 (3/4 DEF). Per target: gain Focus = DEF ignored.

all.name: All for One
all.effect: Reaction: when user spends Focus. If targeting same player as previous Focus spend: gain half-value Focus.

all.name: Terraform
all.effect: Place up to 3 Forest or 3 Water tiles in Cone 1 or cardinal Line 3.

all.name: Rototill
all.effect: Physical or Magical. If target on non-Normal tile: lose Pull 3, gain +1 ACC and +1 dice.

all.name: Bioturbation
all.effect: If non-Normal tile in Burst 1: move to same tile type within Range 8. Pass through players (cannot end farther from target). Players passed through: -7 DEF/1, -1 EVA/1.

all.name: Blackthorn
all.effect: Physical or Magical. Before damage: targets invert positive tile effects/1. +4 dice on secondary targets.

all.name: Bloom
all.effect: Normal tiles grant +1 ACC to user and allies/1. If last Standard was Physical: +4 MAG. If Magical: +4 ATK.

all.name: Cryosphere
all.effect: Replace up to 3 Water/Stop/Stone tiles in Pierce 5 or Burst 1 with Ice/2. Foes ending turn in melee of Ice: 15 damage. Replaced Stops cannot be fully surrounded.

all.name: Hydrolysis
all.effect: +2 dice faces per foe on Water or Lava.

all.name: Wildfire
all.effect: If target on Forest: set Wildfire on that tile and adjacent Forest tiles.\nWildfire: lasts 2 rounds. Start of turn on Wildfire: 3d4 damage, -7 damage on next Standard/Full.

all.name: Nature's Madness
all.effect: Immune to Air tiles. Augmented by X = number of certain tile types in Burst 1. After damage: convert used tiles to Normal.\nAir/Sticky/Boost: +X Range and damage (max 3). If X>1: +1 target.\nForest/Water/Lava/Ice: choose type, inflict X status/1. If X>3: extend 1 round.

all.name: Windstorm
all.effect: Push targets in cone direction. Place 4 Air, 4 Sticky, or 1 Boost tile(s) in range. Existing Windstorm tiles become Normal. May be non-damaging Standard on tiles.

all.name: Flower Crown
all.effect: Forest: +10% DMG/1. Water: heal 5d4 HP. Standard: doubles to 20% and 10d4. Cannot target players on neither.

all.name: Scorched Earth
all.effect: Before Push: tiles in target's Star 1 become Lava. Counts as user damage. Once per turn per entity.

all.name: All-Terrain Master
all.effect: Terraform: Every Turn, up to Twice place Normal/Sticky/Air instead of Water/Forest. End-of-turn tile bonus/1:\nNormal: +1 ACC. Forest: +10% DMG. Water: 5d4 heal. Air: attacks ignore Air, +1 Range. Boost: +6 CR. Sticky: +2 EVA, -1 range on incoming. Lava: +1 Standard (ignores ATK/MAG/DEF).

all.name: The Serenity of Nature
all.effect: If attacked or attacked: sacrifice 50-100 HP and max HP. Summon Nature Spirit in Melee (acts after user). Win requires both defeated. Disabled after use.\nNature Spirit: 125% sacrificed HP | 17 ATK/MAG | 5 DEF | 1 EVA | 4 MP. Moves: Basic Abilities, Terraform (1 tile), Rototill, Bioturbation, Wildfire, Bloom, Flower Crown.

all.name: Attuned
all.effect: Start with 5 Mana. Start of turn: gain 5 per Spellbook attack used last turn (cap 10). Gain 2 per non-Spellbook Standard/Full last turn. Mana spent only on hit.

all.name: Fireball
all.effect: Spend 2 Mana. May spend more: +1 base dice per extra Mana. If any damage dice roll 1: inflict 3 Burn/1.

all.name: Hex
all.effect: Spend 3 Mana. Next Standard/Full on each target: +2 ACC

all.name: Plague
all.effect: Spend 3 Mana. Choose Bleed, Burn, Curse, or Poison. inflict 3 [status]/1. Spend +1 Mana: /2.

all.name: Spellweave
all.effect: The user chooses any number of distinct usable Spellbook moves to "Spellweave", consuming a use of each move. Their next Spellbook attack this turn adds the base rolls and all secondary effects (including Mana costs) of the Spellwoven moves to its own.

all.name: Sandstorm
all.effect: Spend 3 Mana. Targets: -25% damage on next Standard/Full. Push in Beam direction.

all.name: Faith
all.effect: Spend 2 Mana. Heal target equal to roll instead of damage. If Spellwoven: remains attack, targeting becomes Ally/Allies (only players attacked by foe last round).

all.name: Scourge
all.effect: Spend 4 Mana. Choose one non-Basic, non-Lv 1, non-EX move per target. Targets cannot use selected moves/1.

all.name: Tornado
all.effect: Spend 1 Mana. Move up to half MP (round down) and swap with target via teleport. Cannot move after.

all.name: Fog
all.effect: Spend 3 Mana. Targets cannot target beyond this move's range/1. Half MAG beyond Range 2.

all.name: Maelstrom
all.effect: Spend 6 Mana. Choose 2 effects: +5 damage, +2 ACC, +5 DEF/1 on hit, or +3 MP/2 on hit.

all.name: Ichorous
all.effect: Start with 10 Mana (instead of 5). Gain 1 when hit. Infinite Mana capacity. Start of turn (after Attuned): take 3x Mana above 10 as damage.

all.name: Catalysis
all.effect: Spellbook moves (including Spellweave): ignore Frequency for rest of turn. Spellwoven: spend 2 Mana before accuracy to add targets from woven ability's targeting, once per woven move.

all.name: Conduit
all.effect: Talisman buffs/debuffs are permanent but only active when channeled. Buffs that would be removed become un-channeled. Dice channeled with DMG.

all.name: Resonate
all.effect: Restores a use after Standard/Full Talisman ability. Gain one buff: +3 DMG, +3 PDEF, +3 MDEF, or +1 ACC.

all.name: Smite
all.effect: Before accuracy: choose a buff to channel/1. May be non-damaging Swift on self.

all.name: Divine Merit
all.effect: Target gains +2d4+1 damage on next attack. If on self: channel DMG next turn. Cannot target same target twice.

all.name: Serpent's Gate
all.effect: Before accuracy: channel ACC and CR until next turn. Per accuracy 11+: +1 dice. If not: -1 dice.

all.name: Compass
all.effect: Gain +2 ACC. If miss while channeled: gain +3 CR.

all.name: Sanctuary
all.effect: Next channeling: +1 round.

all.name: Absolution
all.effect: Choose a target. Inflict target's debuffs on all other targets/1. Cleanse allies in range.

all.name: Seal of Solomon
all.effect: Choose a channeled buff: invert and apply as debuff/1. inflict Confusion/1.

all.name: Providence
all.effect: Choose PDEF or MDEF to channel and apply to allies in range/1. May be non-damaging Standard.

all.name: Transcendence
all.effect: Before accuracy: convert +ACC to +CR, +DMG to +PDEF or +MDEF (and vice versa). Converted buffs channeled/1.

all.name: Echo of Light
all.effect: Next turn: channeled buffs doubled.

all.name: Heaven's Will
all.effect: Resonate: Trigger, up to 2x/turn. If buff removed by foe: apply as debuff to foes in Star 2/1.

all.name: Judgment
all.effect: inflict Evil Eye permanently.\nEvil Eye: debuffs on player last +1 round. Start of turn: take d4+2 per debuff. Talisman heals equal damage dealt.

all.name: Card Flip
all.effect: Roll d3 after damage. 1: 0.8x damage. 3: 1.3x damage. Outside factors also affected.

all.name: Discard
all.effect: Roll d20. 15+: store reroll (Once/Trigger) for any Cards effect.

all.name: Roulette
all.effect: Roll 1d8 for status on foe, then d3. 1 on d3: inflict on self instead. 1=10 Bleed/1, 2=10 Poison/1, 3=10 Burn/1, 4=6 Cripple/1, 5=Root/1, 6=Seal/1, 7=Stun/1, 8=Confusion/1.

all.name: Gamble
all.effect: Roll d7. 1: subtract target ATK and MAG. 2: subtract target's higher offense. 3: subtract user ATK. 4: add user ATK. 5: add target's higher offense. 6: add user MAG again. 7: add user ATK and target ATK/MAG. Adds user MAG

all.name: Double or Nothing
all.effect: Roll d2. 1: target cannot use Swift/Free until end of user's next turn. 2: target gains +1 Swift (or multiple Free) until user's next turn. Self: must use at start of turn.

all.name: Blackjack
all.effect: On a successful hit, roll 2d10, treating 1s as either 1 or 11 (user's choice). The user may choose to roll additional 1d10s to add to the roll. If the total is 17-20, this attack gains 1 base dice. On a total of 21, this attack instead gains 3 base dice and activates Jackpot. On a total of 22 or higher, the attack instead loses 2 base dice.

all.name: Craps
all.effect: Bomb dice. Per Bomb trigger: choose another foe in target's Splash 1 (once per foe). 5+ Bomb: Jackpot. Immune to non-Cards positive damage factors. Crit extra dice: no Bomb.

all.name: Jackpot
all.effect: When rolling max on all dice (total >= 8): gain +7 ATK/MAG/1, +7 DEF/1, +1 EVA/1, +1 ACC/1, +2 MP/1. Hi-Lo: activates on max dice. Refreshes duration, does not stack.

all.name: Slots Spin
all.effect: Roll 3d4. Per 4: +1 dice. No 4s: -1 dice. All 4s: +1 more dice.

all.name: Hi-Lo
all.effect: Roll d10. Predict higher or lower, then roll again. Correct: +2 base dice, continue (max 5). Wrong: stop, lose half base dice. Same roll: reroll.

all.name: Stacked Deck
all.effect:
In place of an accuracy roll, roll a 1d14 for an effect. 
1. The opponent is healed by the roll, 
2. The user takes 2x damage from all sources for one round,
3. The attack misses, 
4. After damage, the user and target swap their current HP (can overheal, foes with over 200 HP are considered to have 200 HP for this effect), 
5. For one round, attacks automatically hit the user,
6. The user and target gain a random position change,
7. The user and target are both Stunned/1,
8. 50% of this attack's damage is dealt to a random foe instead,
9. For one round, the user's attacks automatically hit,
10. The user gains a 1/Any/Global Once/Reaction: "Reroll one accuracy roll.",
11. Cleanse all statuses and numerical debuffs from the user & reset their other moves' frequencies,
12. Target is Sealed/1, 
13. Next turn, the user may choose numbers for their cards effects, rather than rolling dice for them,
14. This attack has unremovable thrice base dice.

all.name: Card Counter
all.effect: Once per turn: reroll Cards dice effect (Craps: reroll damage dice).

all.name: High Roller
all.effect: Per remaining Standard: roll 1d5. Targeting amount = roll - 1 (1: lost).

all.name: Lunar Phase
all.effect: Start of first turn: choose Phase. Start of each turn: shift Phase. Cannot be disabled.\nNew Moon: +1 Range. Waxing: +2 dice faces. Full Moon: -1 dice on attacks targeting user. Waning: +1 dice. Cycle repeats.

all.name: Moonblast
all.effect: Next Phase effect value +1.

all.name: Dark Reflection
all.effect: inflict inverse of user's Phase/1.

all.name: Holy Light
all.effect: If Moonblast or Celestial Blessing active: target's statuses (except Seal/Stun) +1 round.

all.name: Lunar Shift
all.effect: Shift to next Phase. If Moonblast active: transfer to new Phase.

all.name: Harvest Moon
all.effect: New/Full Moon: heal 1d10+2. Otherwise: no Phase shift next turn. May be non-attack Standard.

all.name: Tidal Wave
all.effect: inflict Confusion/1. New Moon: +AoE range.

all.name: Double Tide
all.effect: Crit on 16+. If at least 1 crit: gain Moonblast effect.

all.name: Blood Moon
all.effect: Waxing/Waning: inflict 2d6 Poison/1. Otherwise: inflict 3d4 Bleed/1.

all.name: Celestial Blessing
all.effect: Until next turn: targets gain user's next Phase effect. User's Phase disabled next turn.

all.name: Gravity Crash
all.effect:
Effect varies by Phase.
New Moon: Homing 4, target cannot use limited moves/1.
Waxing: Push 1d6, inflict 4 Cripple/2.
Full Moon: foes deal 75% to allies in Range 5/1.
Waning: Bomb dice.

all.name: Far Side of the Moon
all.effect: Choose another Phase (doesn't shift). Active when original Phase not affected by Moonblast/Celestial Blessing. May use for Lunar Rod effects.

all.name: Fatal Moonlight
all.effect:
Two effects if user has 2 Phases.
New Moon: Seal/1 on max range target.
Waxing: permanent +2d6 DEF.
Full Moon: +2 targets.
Waning: ignores negative damage factors.

all.name: Future Sight
all.effect: Delay attacks always land if they hit (even if dead).\nDelay: damage and effects delayed X rounds, land at start of user's turn. Damage rolled on use.

all.name: Augur
all.effect: Delay-1: +5 DMG or +3 CR. Delay-2: both.

all.name: Eventide
all.effect: Delay-1. Target gains 3 Curse until Eventide lands. Delay-2: Curse -DEF +2.

all.name: Echo Burst
all.effect: Delay-1: lose Splash, gain +5 DEF until lands. Cannot stack.

all.name: Omen
all.effect: Next attack: +1 delay

all.name: Corruption
all.effect: On hit: target takes 5% of max HP over 100 damage. Up to Delay-2: +5*Delay%. Until lands: damaging statuses deal bonus = half on-hit damage.

all.name: Astral Touch
all.effect: If target kills user within 1 round: reduce delays on them by 1. If target dies within 1 round: transfer one delay to new target in original's Range 7.

all.name: Foresight
all.effect: Reaction: when user attacked, after damage rolled. Remove 10% damage. Add to: 1) delayed attacks, or 2) user's HP x number of delayed attacks.

all.name: Dawn Break
all.effect: Delay-2. Until lands: attacks on target have -1 MR. +1 Delay: +1 more -1 MR.

all.name: Oracle
all.effect: Add or remove 1 delay from any number of delayed attacks. May be self-targeting non-damaging Movement+Swift.

all.name: Scry
all.effect: Delay-1: Cone +1. Choose target: +10*X% of total delay on target to attack (X = targets).

all.name: Prophecy
all.effect: Per delayed move that landed start of turn: +2.5 ACC, +2 DMG. Delay-1/2: lose prior bonuses, gain +8 DMG per delayed move landing with Prophecy. Updates when delays used.

all.name: Fateweave
all.effect: Choose Delay 1-5. Per foe dying on landing turn: permanent +2 ACC, +4 CR. After lands: delays <= 2 land immediately on user death. Disabled after hit. Ignores ATK/MAG and outside factors. Gains use on miss.

all.name: Psychic Overlord
all.effect: When foe dies to Delay damage: heal half overkill, gain +4 MAG. Choose foe with unlanded Delay: inflict -2 EVA/1 and -25% damage/1.

all.name: Scoundrel
all.effect: When the user rolls 13 or below on their damage roll of a Cutlass attack (excluding base modifier and ATK/MAG/DEF), the user gains 1 Coin. Any number of Coins can be spent when the user uses a Cutlass move that's effect contains "chooses", the user then chooses an additional option.

all.name: Dirty Trick
all.effect: Choose Push/Pull, Splash, Buff, or Status. Target's Standard attacks lack chosen attribute/1.

all.name: Fancy Footwork
all.effect: Choose Trip or Slip. Trip: target must move 2+ tiles per direction/1. Slip: teleport to entity's Melee within Range 4.

all.name: Scallywag Slice
all.effect: Choose Outwit or Befuddle. Outwit: +1 CR, target's CR = 1 on first hit of next Standard. Befuddle: target ignores positive tile effects/1.

all.name: Blinding Sheen
all.effect: Spend 1 Coin: inflict -DEF equal to damage this turn. Ignores outside factors, ATK/MAG, DEF.

all.name: Swindler
all.effect: When spending Coin: roll 1d2. 1: -1 dice, +DMG = half removed dice size. 2: base rolls 13 or lower treated as 16.

all.name: Boot Pin
all.effect: Choose: inflict 6 Poison/2 or 6 Cripple/2. Start of turn: gain +3 DMG/1 per 6 damage from these statuses. Target may remove one status as Swift.

all.name: Shady Bet
all.effect: If gaining Coin from this attack: gain Trick Coin instead (choose Swindler effect). May spend Coin to gain Trick Coin (ignores Scoundrel).

all.name: Buy Time
all.effect: Spend 1 Coin: next Cutlass attack effect +1 round.

all.name: High Ground
all.effect: Choose Pistol or Taunt. Pistol: AoE/Foes/Pierce 5, targets' Items become Movement/1. Taunt: targets' AoE become Pierce, must target user/1.

all.name: Swashbuckler
all.effect: Choose Cruel, Sly, or Daring. Cruel: +1 dice. Sly: before accuracy, end target's duration buffs/debuffs. Daring: 10 Shield/1.

all.name: Deathly Crew
all.effect: Coin kill: gain 1 Trick Coin. Until spent: +4 DEF, +1 CR. Max 1 Trick Coin from this effect.

all.name: Captain's Order
all.effect: Target chooses Plank or Marooning. Plank: Push 2, 4 damage per ongoing Cutlass effect on target. Marooning: target's next Standard: 25% recoil.

all.name: Bloodthirst
all.effect: Max 10 Blood. End of turn: gain 2. When hit: gain 1. At 10 Blood: next attack auto-hits, lose all Blood, double damage if already hits.\nThirst N: active when N+ Blood on move select (mandatory).

all.name: Twin Fangs
all.effect: Per hit: lose 2 Blood.\nThirst 5: +3 MR, Double Hit.

all.name: Otherworldly Attraction
all.effect: Accuracy per target. Statuses from this move ignored when moving toward user.\ninflict Slow/1.\nThirst 4: inflict Cripple 4/1.

all.name: The Urge
all.effect:
Passive bonuses:
Thirst 3: +1 MP.
Thirst 4: immune to Slow, Root, Seal, Stun. Half Confusion/Cripple damage.
Thirst 6: +1 base dice.

all.name: Draw Blood
all.effect: Ignores ATK/DEF. Auto-hits (rolls accuracy). +1 MP this turn. If 5+ damage: +1 Blood, next attack this turn +1 base dice.

all.name: Uninvited Guest
all.effect: If first attack on target: gain 2 Blood.\nIf one attacked other last turn but not reciprocated: +8 CR.

all.name: Blood Wave
all.effect: If attacked multiple times last turn: gain 1 Blood before Thirst.\nThirst 3: inflict -X DEF/2 (X = Blood).\nThirst 5: may become AoE/Foes/Beam 5.

all.name: Indulge
all.effect: Ignores target DEF.\nThirst 7: on hit, lose half Blood (round up), heal 30% damage, cannot gain Blood until next turn.\nThirst 10: no effects.

all.name: Blood Whirl
all.effect: Accuracy per target. Lose X Blood (X = targets hit).\nThirst 4: Star 2.\nThirst 7: before accuracy, teleport up to 2 tiles.

all.name: Night Visitor
all.effect: Requires foe damaged this game not in melee. Before accuracy: teleport to melee of target.\nThirst 5: hits foes in Star 1 after teleport, inflict Slow/1.\nThirst 9: usable in melee, Star 2, lose 1 Blood +1 per hit.

all.name: Sky Turns Red
all.effect: The user's next 2 Fangs attacks on foes cannot cause the user to lose Blood and gain "Thirst X: This move ignores X DEF, and heals equal to 5 * X% of the damage dealt to one target." (X is equal to the user's Blood).\nThis effect ends if the user reaches 10 Blood, if they use Indulge (before accuracy), or if they use a Free action to end it early.

all.name: Nocturnal Predator
all.effect: No normal turn. Extra turn after each foe's turn. Duration/frequencies count on normal turn. MP halved on extra turns.

all.name: Sanguine Explosion
all.effect: Reaction: when reaching 10 Blood. inflict Slow/1. Also usable without use on foe death: originates from foe, Burst 2, loses Push.

all.name: Ramping Magic
all.effect: When targeting 2+ foes with Scissors: AoE +1, Push/Pull +1. Once between turns.

all.name: Lasting Cuts
all.effect: inflict 3 Cripple/1. If already Crippled: Cripple +2, duration set to 1.

all.name: Savage Spin-out
all.effect: Splash: Beam 1 behind target. Original: Pull 3. Splash targets: Push 1.

all.name: Silk Cocoon
all.effect: Create Silk Cocoon (Star tile) on unoccupied tile. Replaces existing. Acts like Ice (25 HP). User deals max 15 damage to it. Scissors effects ignore its Ice Clause. Tiles in Burst 1: +1 MP to enter. Does not stack. Range cannot be increased.

all.name: Debilitate
all.effect: Ignores 4 DEF, +4 per Ramping Magic proc. If ignores all target MDEF: triggers Ramping Magic.

all.name: Piercing Jab
all.effect: Per 30 damage taken since last turn: +1 dice, range upgrade (Pierce -> Beam -> Cone).

all.name: Enchanted Blade
all.effect: inflict 4 Curse/1 or 4 Bleed/1. Multiple targets: both (damage does not stack).

all.name: Handle Bash
all.effect: Pull 1 or Push 1. Teleport to Beam 2 in attack direction (Push) or opposite (Pull). Next turn: target's actions cost 1 MP.

all.name: Weaver's Whirl
all.effect: gain 2d8 Shield/1. When Shield breaks: foes in Star 1: inflict -2 MP/1 (max -4).

all.name: Thirteenfold Cut
all.effect: Choose up to 3: inflict -5 DEF/1. Targets may negate. Per negation: user gains +4 DEF/1.

all.name: Guillotine
all.effect: Starts at 0 uses. Gains use on Ramping Magic proc. +1 dice per Ramping Magic proc, -1 dice per target.

all.name: Jammed Blades
all.effect: Silk Cocoon: Every Turn, immune to damage, disappears start of next turn. Piercing Jab: max 3 dice.

all.name: Silken Suit
all.effect: First time damaging or damaged by a foe: take 20% less damage/1.

None.name: Duet
None.effect: Apply Duet to one player. Bard abilities also originate from that player. May end Duet. Effects stack in overlap; Bard attack targets take +1 hit.

None.name: Rising Hope
None.effect: gain +1 ACC/1 and +1 CR/1. Max 2 Rising Hopes affecting a player.

None.name: Primadonna
None.effect: If origin has more MAG: gain +4 MAG/1 and -3 MDEF/1. If not: gain +4 ATK/1 and -3 MDEF/1. Targets with both ATK and MAG buffed also gain +1 dice/1, doubled on crit.

None.name: Fantasia
None.effect: Choose: +3 ATK/MAG, +1 ACC/CR, or +4 DEF. Until next turn, Rising Hope becomes Star 2 and grants all selected Fantasia bonuses. Cannot choose same bonus more than once.

None.name: Staccato
None.effect: Reaction: When a foe attacks user or Duet ally (after damage). Hits target and foes in Star 2 of user and Duet ally. inflict -2 DEF/1 and -1 EVA/1 per hit. If attacker kills Duet ally: gain permanent +2 MP, +2 ACC, +2 CR. Ignores outside damage factors.

None.name: Ironclad
None.effect: When attacked for 40+: inflict 2 Cripple/1 on attacker. If 55+ (before effect): nullify 10% damage, deal it back to attacker.

None.name: Mantrap
None.effect: Reaction: When foe ends turn within or enters tile's Star 1: inflict 3 Cripple/1 and -4 DMG/1, then remove.

None.name: Smokescreen
None.effect: Until next turn: attacks entering Burst 2 have -2 Range, -7 DMG. Attacks used within Burst 2 have -2 Range.

None.name: Tinker's Dam
None.effect: Create Stone wall on target and Line 2 in chosen direction. Removed after 2 rounds, or Free action on user's turn. Foes ending turn with Stone in Melee: take 5 damage and inflict 3 Burn/1. Stone acts like Ice, 30 HP to break, 1 EVA.

None.name: Reforge
None.effect: Choose one base stat (except HP). Foe: reduce by 1/3/1, cannot receive buffs to that stat. Ally: multiply by 1.5/1.

None.name: Mending Mantel
None.effect: Place Hearth tile. When user or allies end turn in its Star 3: gain +5 DEF/1 and heal 5 HP. Hearth acts like Stone. Removed when user dies.

None.name: First Aid
None.effect: Heal target for rolled amount. If ally: may use as Standard to add ATK or MAG. Can only target if attacked in last round.

None.name: Ward
None.effect: Cannot be inflicted with debuffs or statuses/1.

None.name: Heaven's Wind
None.effect: Swap targets.

None.name: Martyrdom
None.effect: Gain +15% healing/1. Healed targets gain +1 EVA and +1 MP/1 (max +3). Per dead ally: +15% healing.

None.name: Vestments
None.effect: Choose primary and secondary target (may be same)./1: primary heals 1/4 of damage secondary takes. Self as primary costs 2 uses. Max 1 Vestments per primary.

None.name: Pas de Deux
None.effect: Target takes turn immediately after user. Target cannot use Pas de Deux that turn. If Standard: target loses Movement. Juggernaut target: only 1 Standard.

None.name: Emboîté
None.effect: Targets' abilities on cooldown: use 1 round earlier (E3T->EoT, EoT->Every Turn).

None.name: Fouetté
None.effect: Until next turn: target may use one Once/Twice/Thrice move without expending a use. Cannot target Reactions or Triggers.

None.name: En Pointe
None.effect: May use Class and Item Swift actions as Free. When targeting ally with Dancer action: gain copy of this passive until end of next turn.

None.name: Divertissement
None.effect: Target's next Standard/Full attack next turn: gain +dice faces equal to actions used that turn (max +5). Unaffected by En Pointe.

None.name: Qi Force
None.effect: After non-Free/Swift attack: gain 1 Qi (max 5). Gain +2 ATK/MAG per Qi. Max 2 Qi between turns. Ally dies: gain 1 Qi.

None.name: Eightfold Shield
None.effect: Spend 2+ Qi: gain +1d4+1 DEF per Qi spent./1

None.name: Conversion
None.effect: Spend 1-3 Qi. This turn: attacks become opposite damage type, swap ATK and MAG. Per Qi spent: ignore 5 DEF and gain +1 Range.

None.name: Nirvana
None.effect: Spend any Qi. Next attack: gain +1 dice and +2 DMG per Qi spent.

None.name: Aegis
None.effect: Reaction: When ally in Homing 4 damaged by attack. Move adjacent to ally. Redirect 25% of attack damage to user. User not considered target if not already.

None.name: Pavise
None.effect: Until next turn: when user or ally in Burst 2 hit by attack, damaged players gain +3 DEF/1 per damaged player.

None.name: Impasse
None.effect: Choose: ally/self, or foe. Ally/self: cannot be inflicted with Push/Pull or stat reduction by foes/1. Foe: remove target's buffs.

None.name: Radiance
None.effect: Until next turn: user takes 80% damage from attacks. Aegis redirects 50%.

None.name: Oathkeeper
None.effect: User and target gain Oath of Mercy. Start of turn: heal 2 HP and gain +1 ATK/MAG (max +5). Ends on death. Does not stack.

None.name: Rewind
None.effect: Reaction: When user or foe attacking user rolls attack damage. Reroll up to 3 damage dice. Rerolled dice cannot trigger or negate Bomb dice.

None.name: Warp
None.effect: Teleport to tile in Range 4. Inflict -5 DEF/1 on foes in tile's Burst 1. This turn: attacks pass through players.

None.name: Superposition
None.effect: Roll d20 and store (max 1). Reaction: before user accuracy check, substitute stored roll. Reaction: when foe attacks in Range 4 after accuracy, replace accuracy with stored roll (cannot cause miss).

None.name: Fractal Division
None.effect: This turn: next single-target attack targets 2 foes in Range 4. Loses Splash. User picks target for secondary effects.

None.name: Time's Edge
None.effect: This turn: gain +1 Standard (MR -3). Next 2 Standard/Full: 25% ATK/MAG. If first deals damage, second ignores outside damage factors and ATK/MAG/DEF. Only Reactions and Triggers between these actions.

None.name: Adrenaline
None.effect: Backstep penalty: -1 MP (instead of -2). May use Basic Movement multiple times per turn.

None.name: Lightspeed
None.effect: If target Dashes before user's next turn: choose Glide or Rushdown. Glide: move 2 tiles per MP (max 12). Rushdown: after Dash, Standard in Melee (max 10 tiles, immune to AoO).

None.name: Outmaneuver
None.effect: Spend any MP. Until next turn: attacks from max range gain +1 ACC per 2 MP spent.

None.name: Quick Thinking
None.effect: After last Standard: spend MP, move 1 tile per 2 MP. Ignores Backstep penalty.

None.name: Tunneling
None.effect: This turn: move through tiles and foes as Normal tiles. Cannot end turn on obstructions or Broken tiles.

None.name: Wormhole
None.effect: Place Wormhole on target tile. Swift: user or ally spends half MP (rounded up) to teleport to Wormhole. Expires on use or after 2 rounds.

None.name: Hunter's Mark
None.effect: When Crossbow attack resolves: targets gain 1 Mark. Attacks deal +1d4 damage per Mark on target. Marks only apply to their user's abilities.

None.name: Bolt Compaction
None.effect: This turn: Standard Crossbow attacks lose secondary effects. Next turn: first Standard attack gains +1 dice and the negated effects.

None.name: Shadow Quiver
None.effect: Next Standard attack becomes Magical, treats non-player obstructions as Air, ignores non-targets. Loses 2 damage per Air tile passed through.

None.name: Final Hour
None.effect: Next attack: Hunter's Mark gains +4 dice faces.

None.name: Bolt Arsenal
None.effect:
When using single-target Standard Crossbow attack: choose one Bolt.
Bounty Bolt: target gains half the Marks of latest slain foe.
Split-Head Bolt: targets another foe, loses Splash.
Reeling Bolt: Pull target to tile in user's Line 3-6.
Each Bolt: once until refresh. Swift: refresh Bolts.

None.name: Quiver of Thunder
None.effect: Foes: can only target entities in their Line 8/1. If attack user in Melee: gain +1 Mark.

None.name: Bound Bow
None.effect: Physical attacks become Magical when targeting at Range 3+. Once per turn: when attacking at Range 1-2, gain +3 DEF/1.

None.name: Dispell Bow
None.effect: This turn: +2 MP, ranged attacks Range becomes 3. Next turn: +1 MP, ranged attacks Range becomes 6.

None.name: Sniper's Focus
None.effect: This turn: Standard actions become Full. Range 7+ effects trigger at Range 4+.

None.name: Bound Gauntlet
None.effect: After Physical attack: deal magic damage equal to damage dealt (after DEF) to different foe in Melee. After Magical attack: next Physical attack ignores 5 DEF and cannot miss.

None.name: Tactical Sniper
None.effect: Game start: designate Bounty. Attacks on Bounty: treat obstructions as Air, +1 Range. Melee on Bounty: +1 dice. Bounty dies: designate new Bounty.

None.name: Hawkeye
None.effect: Gain +2 ACC on all attacks. Trigger before Standard: sacrifice up to 5 ACC, gain equal CR until next turn.

None.name: Crimson Pact
None.effect: When user damages a foe: sacrifice 10% of damage dealt as HP (if able). Gain permanent bonus damage equal to HP sacrificed. CP gained from effect-derived sources.

None.name: Sanctified Blade
None.effect: Next single-target attack: CP sacrifice +10%. If foe targeted user since last turn: +5%.

None.name: Black Magic
None.effect: Per 5 CP: +1 DEF. Per 7 CP: +1 ACC. Per 10 CP: +1 dice.

None.name: Covenant
None.effect: Target shares user's Black Magic buffs and gains CP passive/1. CP gained by target applies to user instead.

None.name: Oblation
None.effect: Next attack this turn: double damage from CP.

None.name: Total Depravity
None.effect: CP sacrifice +5%. Start of turn: if attacked last turn, take damage equal to CP. Cannot kill user.

None.name: Bloodbind
None.effect: Twice per turn before attacking. Sacrifice any CP. Per CP: +1 DMG this turn, heal 1 HP on Standard/Full hit.

None.name: Reaper's Touch
None.effect: When user damages a foe: heal 1/8 of damage dealt.

None.name: Phantasmal Shield
None.effect: Target heals 15% of damage taken/1. Per Standard/Full hit on target: -5% (min 0%).

None.name: Immortal Coil
None.effect: First death: set to 1 HP, take turn immediately. Immune to damage during bonus turn. Then take overkill damage. Turn order resumes.

None.name: Quietus
None.effect: Attacks auto-hit and kill targets below 25% HP.

None.name: Whittle
None.effect: Sacrifice 10 HP: create Totem tile on target (removes existing). Range Burst 1. Type: Blood, Bone, or Soul (starts Blood). Cannot be overwritten.

None.name: Totem of Blood
None.effect: Totem becomes Blood. Within Homing 6 of Blood Totem: may originate Totem moves from it. gain +5 DMG, -1 Range.

None.name: Totem of Bone
None.effect: Totem becomes Bone. Within range: +5 DEF, immune to AoE and Splash from foes outside range.

None.name: Totem of Soul
None.effect: Totem becomes Soul. User and allies: sacrifice 8 HP (Every Turn Free) within range. gain +1 MP

None.name: Effigial Pyre
None.effect: Destroy Totem: inflict 13 Burn/1 on foes in tile's Burst 1. Current Totem type loses effects for game. Totem range becomes Burst 2.

None.name: Animatus
None.effect: Non-Animated Totem on unoccupied tile: becomes Animated. Sacrifice any HP: becomes Totem's HP, gained as Shield/1. Animated Totem is allied entity, shares user's DEF. Removed when user or Totem at 0 HP.\nWith Animated Totem: move up to MP, deal 3d10 to foes in Totem range.

None.name: Egregore
None.effect: When user kills foe: Animated Totem gains overkill as HP. If not Animated: becomes Animated with HP = overkill. Choose one active ability from foe: Animated Totems may use it for rest of game (replaces Animatus damage).

None.name: Triumvirate
None.effect: Swap subweapons (Standard). Gladius: +1 dice. Scutum: ranged attacks on user lose 5 damage. Pilum: Melee attacks gain +3 Range. Swapping from effects: always occurs. Start in Gladius.

None.name: Iberian Steel
None.effect: Subweapons are used on weapon attack/standard. Next attack in least-used subweapon: +1 dice. If 2+ fewer uses: also +2 ACC.

None.name: Invigorate
None.effect: Bonus varies by subweapon.\nGladius: +5 DMG/1. Scutum: 7 Shield/1. Pilum: +1 ACC/1 and +1 CR/1.

None.name: Dual Wield
None.effect: Before moving: MP halved

None.name: Hastiliarius
None.effect: Subweapon bonuses:\nGladius: +0.5X dice. Scutum: +X DEF. Pilum: +0.5X ACC.\nX = uses of least used subweapon.

None.name: Adaptive
None.effect: When user misses Standard/Full: buffs apply to next Standard/Full, which gains +2 ACC, 10% of missed damage, and ignores 5 DEF.

None.name: Fair Fight
None.effect: Next single-target target becomes Duel Partner/2. Ends on death or user damages other foe. User deals/takes 30 less damage from non-DP foes. If DP has allies or is monster: 5 instead.

None.name: Defiance
None.effect: Reaction: when foe statuses user or targets outside Range 4. Teleport to unoccupied tile in their Melee. Next Standard/Full: +2 ACC

None.name: Paragon
None.effect: Adaptive numerical bonuses tripled. Turns: gain 5X Shield, attacks +5X% damage. X = times targeted by foes since last turn.

None.name: Martial Mastery
None.effect: Move up to MP+1, all tiles except final treated as Normal. This turn: attacks ignore obstructions and DEF, invert foe's negative outside damage factors.

None.name: Wear Down
None.effect: Per MP target uses next turn: gain +3 DEF until next turn.

None.name: Guard
None.effect: Next Tonfa move: replace instances of the user with this target.

None.name: Yin Yang
None.effect: Choose Yin or Yang.\nYin: Physical/Melee. If target doesn't damage user next turn: target takes 1d8+5.\nYang: Magical/Homing 4. Foes take 1d8+5 when damaging user/1.

None.name: Hold Over
None.effect: Declare range type. If foes target user with attacks of that range type outside Melee: user may AoO/1.

None.name: Aikido
None.effect: When user uses 2 attacks of same damage type in one turn: gain +2 DEF and ATK/MAG of opposite type. Resets if effect doesn't occur.

None.name: Tempest Sweep
None.effect: Choose Honte or Gyakute.\nHonte: Physical. Next turn: Tonfa effects lasting 1 round/turn last +1 round/turn.\nGyakute: Magical. Next Tonfa attack gains Star 2 Splash.

None.name: Bloodlust
None.effect: When user deals or takes 15+ damage: gain 1 Rage.

None.name: Vindictive
None.effect: Gain 2 Rage on kill or miss.

None.name: Swing Cycle
None.effect: Start of turn: spend 2 Rage to reset cooldowns/frequencies of last 2 attacks.\nChain Axe becomes EoT. Start with 1 Rage.

None.name: Unstoppable Force
None.effect: If foe blocks target from full Push: that foe is hit and targeted. Pushed towards where target would have reached.

None.name: Masonry
None.effect: If unoccupied: tile becomes Stone (acts like Ice, 30 HP, 1 EVA). Removed after 2 rounds. Can be Pushed/Pulled (no damage).

None.name: Stonemason
None.effect: Hammer effects ignore Ice Clause on player-created tiles.

None.name: Gravity Well
None.effect: Next attack this turn: before accuracy, choose non-Splash target. Pull another entity in target's Burst 2 to tile in target's Burst 1.

None.name: Aftershock
None.effect: Reaction: after user pushes target. Move up to tiles pushed in that direction. Then deal 1d10+6 to foes in user's Burst 1.

None.name: Heavy Weapon
None.effect: Cannot leave foe's Melee without teleporting. Tomahawk ability at max listed range: gains Apex. Apex includes final row/column of Beam.

None.name: Plate Crusher
None.effect: When user moves foe with non-Apex Tomahawk: foe takes 2 damage per tile. Apex attacks ignore 5 DEF.

None.name: Discipline
None.effect: Start of target's next turn: gain +3X DEF/1 (X = 3 - range used). Apex: if last attack had Apex, next attack applies that Apex effects (excluding extra hits).

None.name: Fleet Footwork
None.effect: Once per turn: after Apex attack, teleport user or target up to 2 tiles.

None.name: Line Out
None.effect: If next attack can target a foe in Apex: range may be treated as Pierce instead of Line.

None.name: Right to Rule
None.effect: Start with 3 Campaigns (max 3). Each: +2 DEF. Lose 1 when dealing or receiving 10+ damage at once.\nAttack with 0 Campaigns: +1 dice, +1 ACC.

None.name: Coronation
None.effect: Reaction/Trigger: when reaching 0 Campaigns, or start of turn with 0. Right to Rule max +1. Gain max Campaigns.

None.name: Crusade
None.effect: Until next turn: gain +1 MP

None.name: The Art of War
None.effect: Choose War or Peace.\nWar: Physical. If 0 Campaigns: +dice faces = 1.5x Campaign max.\nPeace: Magical. Until next Standard/Full: target has -X/3 MP, -2X ATK/MAG (X = user's Campaigns).

None.name: Declaration of War
None.effect: Gain +1.5 DEF per Campaign. Start with 0 or 4 Campaigns (choice).

None.name: Imperial Tyranny
None.effect: Foes in Star 3: -0.5 DEF and -0.5 ATK/MAG per Campaign. If 0 Campaigns: foes attacking user take 10% recoil.

None.name: Resolute Blade
None.effect: Gain/lose 1 Resolve per HP lost/gained (min 0). On miss or kill: regain Resolve spent on that attack. If Resolve > 100 before attack: Advantage dice. Max 20 Resolve from self-damage per round.

None.name: Fallen Blade
None.effect: At 25%, 50%, 75% HP missing: gain 1 Enrage (once each). +1 dice per Enrage.

None.name: Kensei
None.effect: Start of next turn: gain Resolve = X% of Resolve gained since use. X = 150 - user's max HP (max 20%).

None.name: Delirium
None.effect: Spend 25 Resolve per debuff. X = Enrage: inflict -X ACC/1, -X CR/1, -X dice/1, -5X DEF/1.\nSpend 30 more: if cleansed or prevented, target gains disadvantage dice/1.

None.name: Bushido
None.effect: Choose up to 2 allies. Gain Resolve = 50% of damage they took from attacks that didn't target user/1.

None.name: Zanshin
None.effect: Max 150 Resolve. When exceeding max: next attack gains +1 ACC/1, +1 CR/1. Fallen Blade: every 1/6 HP.

None.name: Fudoshin
None.effect: Zanshin's exceed bonuses doubled. Enrage dice doubled on crit.

None.name: Allez
None.effect: Reaction: once between turns on attack involving user. Remove 1 dice, store Focus = half of removed dice faces.

None.name: Deflect
None.effect: Reaction: when foe attacks user. Attack loses 10% damage, store as Focus. If attack moves user: Pull 2. Ignores non-Rapier outside factors.

None.name: En Garde
None.effect: Spend up to 2 Focus. Per Focus: target gains HP or +DEF/1 equal to its value. May move 2 tiles after next reaction.

None.name: Parry
None.effect: Reaction: on attack involving user (no Rapier reaction since last turn). Attack loses all damage and dice buffs. Store Focus = removed buff's value.

None.name: All for One
None.effect: Reaction: when user spends Focus. If targeting same player as previous Focus spend: gain half-value Focus.

None.name: Terraform
None.effect: Place up to 3 Forest or 3 Water tiles in Cone 1 or cardinal Line 3.

None.name: Rototill
None.effect: Physical or Magical. If target on non-Normal tile: lose Pull 3, gain +1 ACC and +1 dice.

None.name: Blackthorn
None.effect: Physical or Magical. Before damage: targets invert positive tile effects/1. +4 dice on secondary targets.

None.name: Bloom
None.effect: Normal tiles grant +1 ACC to user and allies/1. If last Standard was Physical: +4 MAG. If Magical: +4 ATK.

None.name: Cryosphere
None.effect: Replace up to 3 Water/Stop/Stone tiles in Pierce 5 or Burst 1 with Ice/2. Foes ending turn in melee of Ice: 15 damage. Replaced Stops cannot be fully surrounded.

None.name: Flower Crown
None.effect: Forest: +10% DMG/1. Water: heal 5d4 HP. Standard: doubles to 20% and 10d4. Cannot target players on neither.

None.name: All-Terrain Master
None.effect: Terraform: Every Turn, up to Twice place Normal/Sticky/Air instead of Water/Forest. End-of-turn tile bonus/1:\nNormal: +1 ACC. Forest: +10% DMG. Water: 5d4 heal. Air: attacks ignore Air, +1 Range. Boost: +6 CR. Sticky: +2 EVA, -1 range on incoming. Lava: +1 Standard (ignores ATK/MAG/DEF).

None.name: The Serenity of Nature
None.effect: If attacked or attacked: sacrifice 50-100 HP and max HP. Summon Nature Spirit in Melee (acts after user). Win requires both defeated. Disabled after use.\nNature Spirit: 125% sacrificed HP | 17 ATK/MAG | 5 DEF | 1 EVA | 4 MP. Moves: Basic Abilities, Terraform (1 tile), Rototill, Bioturbation, Wildfire, Bloom, Flower Crown.

None.name: Attuned
None.effect: Start with 5 Mana. Start of turn: gain 5 per Spellbook attack used last turn (cap 10). Gain 2 per non-Spellbook Standard/Full last turn. Mana spent only on hit.

None.name: Spellweave
None.effect: The user chooses any number of distinct usable Spellbook moves to "Spellweave", consuming a use of each move. Their next Spellbook attack this turn adds the base rolls and all secondary effects (including Mana costs) of the Spellwoven moves to its own.

None.name: Faith
None.effect: Spend 2 Mana. Heal target equal to roll instead of damage. If Spellwoven: remains attack, targeting becomes Ally/Allies (only players attacked by foe last round).

None.name: Tornado
None.effect: Spend 1 Mana. Move up to half MP (round down) and swap with target via teleport. Cannot move after.

None.name: Ichorous
None.effect: Start with 10 Mana (instead of 5). Gain 1 when hit. Infinite Mana capacity. Start of turn (after Attuned): take 3x Mana above 10 as damage.

None.name: Catalysis
None.effect: Spellbook moves (including Spellweave): ignore Frequency for rest of turn. Spellwoven: spend 2 Mana before accuracy to add targets from woven ability's targeting, once per woven move.

None.name: Conduit
None.effect: Talisman buffs/debuffs are permanent but only active when channeled. Buffs that would be removed become un-channeled. Dice channeled with DMG.

None.name: Resonate
None.effect: Restores a use after Standard/Full Talisman ability. Gain one buff: +3 DMG, +3 PDEF, +3 MDEF, or +1 ACC.

None.name: Divine Merit
None.effect: Target gains +2d4+1 damage on next attack. If on self: channel DMG next turn. Cannot target same target twice.

None.name: Sanctuary
None.effect: Next channeling: +1 round.

None.name: Heaven's Will
None.effect: Resonate: Trigger, up to 2x/turn. If buff removed by foe: apply as debuff to foes in Star 2/1.

None.name: Double or Nothing
None.effect: Roll d2. 1: target cannot use Swift/Free until end of user's next turn. 2: target gains +1 Swift (or multiple Free) until user's next turn. Self: must use at start of turn.

None.name: Jackpot
None.effect: When rolling max on all dice (total >= 8): gain +7 ATK/MAG/1, +7 DEF/1, +1 EVA/1, +1 ACC/1, +2 MP/1. Hi-Lo: activates on max dice. Refreshes duration, does not stack.

None.name: Card Counter
None.effect: Once per turn: reroll Cards dice effect (Craps: reroll damage dice).

None.name: High Roller
None.effect: Per remaining Standard: roll 1d5. Targeting amount = roll - 1 (1: lost).

None.name: Lunar Phase
None.effect: Start of first turn: choose Phase. Start of each turn: shift Phase. Cannot be disabled.\nNew Moon: +1 Range. Waxing: +2 dice faces. Full Moon: -1 dice on attacks targeting user. Waning: +1 dice. Cycle repeats.

None.name: Lunar Shift
None.effect: Shift to next Phase. If Moonblast active: transfer to new Phase.

None.name: Celestial Blessing
None.effect: Until next turn: targets gain user's next Phase effect. User's Phase disabled next turn.

None.name: Far Side of the Moon
None.effect: Choose another Phase (doesn't shift). Active when original Phase not affected by Moonblast/Celestial Blessing. May use for Lunar Rod effects.

None.name: Future Sight
None.effect: Delay attacks always land if they hit (even if dead).\nDelay: damage and effects delayed X rounds, land at start of user's turn. Damage rolled on use.

None.name: Omen
None.effect: Next attack: +1 delay

None.name: Astral Touch
None.effect: If target kills user within 1 round: reduce delays on them by 1. If target dies within 1 round: transfer one delay to new target in original's Range 7.

None.name: Foresight
None.effect: Reaction: when user attacked, after damage rolled. Remove 10% damage. Add to: 1) delayed attacks, or 2) user's HP x number of delayed attacks.

None.name: Psychic Overlord
None.effect: When foe dies to Delay damage: heal half overkill, gain +4 MAG. Choose foe with unlanded Delay: inflict -2 EVA/1 and -25% damage/1.

None.name: Scoundrel
None.effect: When the user rolls 13 or below on their damage roll of a Cutlass attack (excluding base modifier and ATK/MAG/DEF), the user gains 1 Coin. Any number of Coins can be spent when the user uses a Cutlass move that's effect contains "chooses", the user then chooses an additional option.

None.name: Swindler
None.effect: When spending Coin: roll 1d2. 1: -1 dice, +DMG = half removed dice size. 2: base rolls 13 or lower treated as 16.

None.name: Buy Time
None.effect: Spend 1 Coin: next Cutlass attack effect +1 round.

None.name: Deathly Crew
None.effect: Coin kill: gain 1 Trick Coin. Until spent: +4 DEF, +1 CR. Max 1 Trick Coin from this effect.

None.name: Bloodthirst
None.effect: Max 10 Blood. End of turn: gain 2. When hit: gain 1. At 10 Blood: next attack auto-hits, lose all Blood, double damage if already hits.\nThirst N: active when N+ Blood on move select (mandatory).

None.name: The Urge
None.effect:
Passive bonuses:
Thirst 3: +1 MP.
Thirst 4: immune to Slow, Root, Seal, Stun. Half Confusion/Cripple damage.
Thirst 6: +1 base dice.

None.name: Sky Turns Red
