None.effect: The user's next 2 Fangs attacks on foes cannot cause the user to lose Blood and gain "Thirst X: This move ignores X DEF, and heals equal to 5 * X% of the damage dealt to one target." (X is equal to the user's Blood).\nThis effect ends if the user reaches 10 Blood, if they use Indulge (before accuracy), or if they use a Free action to end it early.

None.name: Nocturnal Predator
None.effect: No normal turn. Extra turn after each foe's turn. Duration/frequencies count on normal turn. MP halved on extra turns.

None.name: Ramping Magic
None.effect: When targeting 2+ foes with Scissors: AoE +1, Push/Pull +1. Once between turns.

None.name: Silk Cocoon
None.effect: Create Silk Cocoon (Star tile) on unoccupied tile. Replaces existing. Acts like Ice (25 HP). User deals max 15 damage to it. Scissors effects ignore its Ice Clause. Tiles in Burst 1: +1 MP to enter. Does not stack. Range cannot be increased.

None.name: Weaver's Whirl
None.effect: gain 2d8 Shield/1. When Shield breaks: foes in Star 1: inflict -2 MP/1 (max -4).

None.name: Jammed Blades
None.effect: Silk Cocoon: Every Turn, immune to damage, disappears start of next turn. Piercing Jab: max 3 dice.

None.name: Silken Suit
None.effect: First time damaging or damaged by a foe: take 20% less damage/1.

Magical.name: Dissonance
Magical.effect: inflict 3 Bleed/1. Ignores ATK/MAG, half DEF, and outside damage factors. If target hit twice, +3 DMG/1.

Magical.name: Soulstep
Magical.effect: Move up to MP. Targeting before or after movement. Ignores outside damage factors, DEF, and ATK/MAG.

Magical.name: Cursed Bolts
Magical.effect: inflict 3X Curse/1 (X = Marks on target). If target has 3+ Marks: ignores negative outside damage factors.

Magical.name: Tornado Bolt
Magical.effect: Push X (X = 1 + Marks on target). If target cannot be pushed full distance: gain +1 Mark.

Magical.name: Arcane Shot
Magical.effect: If target under Range 3: Push 3. If target at Range 7+: ignores up to 10 DEF.

Magical.name: Hook Shot
Magical.effect: If +2 CR: Pull user within Range 2 of target, or target within Range 2 of user. Not an attack on Allies.

Magical.name: Salvo
Magical.effect: May target different foes per hit. Adds ATK/MAG and applies damage effects to each.

Magical.name: Surge
Magical.effect: Per crit: next multi-hit attack gains +1 hit.

Magical.name: Sagittarian Pride
Magical.effect: Hits = number of moves targets used since user's last turn.

Magical.name: Bloodrush
Magical.effect: If used from max range: gain +5 DMG/1 and +1 MP/1.

Magical.name: Defile
Magical.effect: inflict 3 Curse/1. When foe takes Curse damage: user takes equal CP.

Magical.name: Purloin Youth
Magical.effect: Attacks targeting user: 10% recoil/1. User sacrifices half recoil to CP.

Magical.name: Pentagram
Magical.effect: Start of next turn: foes in user's Burst 1 take 2d6+3 + user's CP damage.

Magical.name: Massacre
Magical.effect: If kill: gain 2x CP and +1 use of Massacre. If not: no CP sacrifice.

Magical.name: Exsanguinate
Magical.effect: If CP from this move grants Black Magic bonus: +1 to that bonus.

Magical.name: Siphon Soul
Magical.effect: Before accuracy: heal HP equal to CP.

Magical.name: Reap
Magical.effect: Reaper's Touch heals 1/5 instead of 1/8 on this attack.

Magical.name: Hades' Toll
Magical.effect: Reaper's Touch heal +50% on attacks against target/2.

Magical.name: Haunted Swing
Magical.effect: Targets at full HP: +5 damage. Heal 5 HP per target triggered.

Magical.name: Wither Soul
Magical.effect: Per debuff or status on target: Reaper's Touch heals +3 HP.

Magical.name: Pestilent Strike
Magical.effect: inflict X Poison/1 (X = Reaper's Touch healing from this attack). If X >= 6: halve poison, extend 1 round.

Magical.name: Coup de Grâce
Magical.effect: If kill: heal 10 HP, gain +5 damage to next attack.

Magical.name: Spirit Break
Magical.effect: inflict -3 DEF/1. gain +3 DMG/1.

Magical.name: Memento Mori
Magical.effect: Delay-1. May delay up to +2 more turns. Per extra delay: Reaper's Touch heals +1/8 of damage.

Magical.name: Stroke of Midnight
Magical.effect: Before damage: Reaper's Touch healing becomes +damage on this attack/1. Other Scythe healing becomes +DMG/1.

Magical.name: Phantom Blade
Magical.effect: Reaper's Touch heal on this attack = HP healed from Scythe abilities (except Phantom Blade) last round.

Magical.name: Void's Call
Magical.effect: Pull targets towards Totem tile instead of user.

Magical.name: Left-Hand Path
Magical.effect: User moves along line from origin until hitting obstruction. If no Totem: inflict -2 EVA/1 and -3 DEF/1.

Magical.name: Heredity
Magical.effect: Totem moves adjacent to target. Heal HP sacrificed to create it. If no Totem: place one on target's tile.

Magical.name: Feral Spark
Magical.effect: Target: 10% recoil/1. User's current Totem type numerical effects doubled.

Magical.name: Blasphemy
Magical.effect: inflict 6 Curse/1. While Cursed: targeting an ally extends Curse 1 round.

Magical.name: Sacrificial Lamb
Magical.effect: Before accuracy: players in Totem range sacrifice 5 HP. Per sacrifice: +1 target, +1 base dice, -1 MR.

Magical.name: Ancestral Wrath
Magical.effect:
Requires Totem within Range 5. Targets within Totem range. Effects by type:
Blood: targets cannot leave Totem range/1.
Bone: cleanse debuffs/statuses on allies, cleanse buffs on foes in range.
Soul: heal allies in range for 1/3 of damage dealt.

Magical.name: Spurn
Magical.effect: If target can attack from Melee next turn but doesn't: user may AoO them at end of turn.

Magical.name: Dazing Hook
Magical.effect: Range cannot be reduced. If target attacked user outside Melee last round: inflict Confusion/1 and Inverse Bomb dice/1.

Magical.name: Gale Force
Magical.effect: Regardless of accuracy: teleport any targets to any unoccupied tiles in range. Not an attack on Allies or when Movement.

Magical.name: Besiege
Magical.effect: Before accuracy: sacrifice up to 10 HP. Gain equal Shield/1. 1.5x if target >50% HP.

Magical.name: Bastion
Magical.effect: Foe attacks entering user's Cone 1: lose 2 dice/1. While in Melee of current tile: +4 DEF.

Magical.name: Entrench
Magical.effect: If less than 6 bonus DEF: gain +3 DEF/1. Lose +1 Campaign per RtR instance/1.

Magical.name: Shock and Awe
Magical.effect: If 3+ Campaigns: attacks on user immune to positive outside factors/1.

Magical.name: Last Stand
Magical.effect: When user would take >55-3X damage (X = Campaign max): attacker takes 3d8+2, damage reduced by 3X/1.

Magical.name: Blade of Woe
Magical.effect: Before damage: inflict 5 Curse/1 on user and target. First Resolve spend after taking 55+ damage while Cursed: resolve effect +1/3.

Magical.name: Provoke
Magical.effect: If target doesn't deal 45+ to user next turn: Resolve gain x1.75/1. Resolve gained since Provoke also x1.75.

Magical.name: Rising Sun
Magical.effect: Spend up to 100 Resolve: gain X% of damage as Shield/1 (X = Resolve/1.5). If first ability this turn: turn continues until another non-Standard/Full. While Shield active: healing doesn't reduce Resolve.

Magical.name: Bioturbation
Magical.effect: If non-Normal tile in Burst 1: move to same tile type within Range 8. Pass through players (cannot end farther from target). Players passed through: -7 DEF/1, -1 EVA/1.

Magical.name: Wildfire
Magical.effect: If target on Forest: set Wildfire on that tile and adjacent Forest tiles.\nWildfire: lasts 2 rounds. Start of turn on Wildfire: 3d4 damage, -7 damage on next Standard/Full.

Magical.name: Windstorm
Magical.effect: Push targets in cone direction. Place 4 Air, 4 Sticky, or 1 Boost tile(s) in range. Existing Windstorm tiles become Normal. May be non-damaging Standard on tiles.

Magical.name: Fireball
Magical.effect: Spend 2 Mana. May spend more: +1 base dice per extra Mana. If any damage dice roll 1: inflict 3 Burn/1.

Magical.name: Hex
Magical.effect: Spend 3 Mana. Next Standard/Full on each target: +2 ACC

Magical.name: Plague
Magical.effect: Spend 3 Mana. Choose Bleed, Burn, Curse, or Poison. inflict 3 [status]/1. Spend +1 Mana: /2.

Magical.name: Sandstorm
Magical.effect: Spend 3 Mana. Targets: -25% damage on next Standard/Full. Push in Beam direction.

Magical.name: Scourge
Magical.effect: Spend 4 Mana. Choose one non-Basic, non-Lv 1, non-EX move per target. Targets cannot use selected moves/1.

Magical.name: Fog
Magical.effect: Spend 3 Mana. Targets cannot target beyond this move's range/1. Half MAG beyond Range 2.

Magical.name: Maelstrom
Magical.effect: Spend 6 Mana. Choose 2 effects: +5 damage, +2 ACC, +5 DEF/1 on hit, or +3 MP/2 on hit.

Magical.name: Smite
Magical.effect: Before accuracy: choose a buff to channel/1. May be non-damaging Swift on self.

Magical.name: Serpent's Gate
Magical.effect: Before accuracy: channel ACC and CR until next turn. Per accuracy 11+: +1 dice. If not: -1 dice.

Magical.name: Compass
Magical.effect: Gain +2 ACC. If miss while channeled: gain +3 CR.

Magical.name: Absolution
Magical.effect: Choose a target. Inflict target's debuffs on all other targets/1. Cleanse allies in range.

Magical.name: Seal of Solomon
Magical.effect: Choose a channeled buff: invert and apply as debuff/1. inflict Confusion/1.

Magical.name: Providence
Magical.effect: Choose PDEF or MDEF to channel and apply to allies in range/1. May be non-damaging Standard.

Magical.name: Transcendence
Magical.effect: Before accuracy: convert +ACC to +CR, +DMG to +PDEF or +MDEF (and vice versa). Converted buffs channeled/1.

Magical.name: Echo of Light
Magical.effect: Next turn: channeled buffs doubled.

Magical.name: Judgment
Magical.effect: inflict Evil Eye permanently.\nEvil Eye: debuffs on player last +1 round. Start of turn: take d4+2 per debuff. Talisman heals equal damage dealt.

Magical.name: Card Flip
Magical.effect: Roll d3 after damage. 1: 0.8x damage. 3: 1.3x damage. Outside factors also affected.

Magical.name: Discard
Magical.effect: Roll d20. 15+: store reroll (Once/Trigger) for any Cards effect.

Magical.name: Roulette
Magical.effect: Roll 1d8 for status on foe, then d3. 1 on d3: inflict on self instead. 1=10 Bleed/1, 2=10 Poison/1, 3=10 Burn/1, 4=6 Cripple/1, 5=Root/1, 6=Seal/1, 7=Stun/1, 8=Confusion/1.

Magical.name: Gamble
Magical.effect: Roll d7. 1: subtract target ATK and MAG. 2: subtract target's higher offense. 3: subtract user ATK. 4: add user ATK. 5: add target's higher offense. 6: add user MAG again. 7: add user ATK and target ATK/MAG. Adds user MAG

Magical.name: Blackjack
Magical.effect: On a successful hit, roll 2d10, treating 1s as either 1 or 11 (user's choice). The user may choose to roll additional 1d10s to add to the roll. If the total is 17-20, this attack gains 1 base dice. On a total of 21, this attack instead gains 3 base dice and activates Jackpot. On a total of 22 or higher, the attack instead loses 2 base dice.

Magical.name: Craps
Magical.effect: Bomb dice. Per Bomb trigger: choose another foe in target's Splash 1 (once per foe). 5+ Bomb: Jackpot. Immune to non-Cards positive damage factors. Crit extra dice: no Bomb.

Magical.name: Slots Spin
Magical.effect: Roll 3d4. Per 4: +1 dice. No 4s: -1 dice. All 4s: +1 more dice.

Magical.name: Hi-Lo
Magical.effect: Roll d10. Predict higher or lower, then roll again. Correct: +2 base dice, continue (max 5). Wrong: stop, lose half base dice. Same roll: reroll.

Magical.name: Stacked Deck
Magical.effect:
In place of an accuracy roll, roll a 1d14 for an effect. 
1. The opponent is healed by the roll, 
2. The user takes 2x damage from all sources for one round,
3. The attack misses, 
4. After damage, the user and target swap their current HP (can overheal, foes with over 200 HP are considered to have 200 HP for this effect), 
5. For one round, attacks automatically hit the user,
6. The user and target gain a random position change,
7. The user and target are both Stunned/1,
8. 50% of this attack's damage is dealt to a random foe instead,
9. For one round, the user's attacks automatically hit,
10. The user gains a 1/Any/Global Once/Reaction: "Reroll one accuracy roll.",
11. Cleanse all statuses and numerical debuffs from the user & reset their other moves' frequencies,
12. Target is Sealed/1, 
13. Next turn, the user may choose numbers for their cards effects, rather than rolling dice for them,
14. This attack has unremovable thrice base dice.

Magical.name: Moonblast
Magical.effect: Next Phase effect value +1.

Magical.name: Dark Reflection
Magical.effect: inflict inverse of user's Phase/1.

Magical.name: Holy Light
Magical.effect: If Moonblast or Celestial Blessing active: target's statuses (except Seal/Stun) +1 round.

Magical.name: Harvest Moon
Magical.effect: New/Full Moon: heal 1d10+2. Otherwise: no Phase shift next turn. May be non-attack Standard.

Magical.name: Tidal Wave
Magical.effect: inflict Confusion/1. New Moon: +AoE range.

Magical.name: Double Tide
Magical.effect: Crit on 16+. If at least 1 crit: gain Moonblast effect.

Magical.name: Blood Moon
Magical.effect: Waxing/Waning: inflict 2d6 Poison/1. Otherwise: inflict 3d4 Bleed/1.

Magical.name: Gravity Crash
Magical.effect:
Effect varies by Phase.
New Moon: Homing 4, target cannot use limited moves/1.
Waxing: Push 1d6, inflict 4 Cripple/2.
Full Moon: foes deal 75% to allies in Range 5/1.
Waning: Bomb dice.

Magical.name: Fatal Moonlight
Magical.effect:
Two effects if user has 2 Phases.
New Moon: Seal/1 on max range target.
Waxing: permanent +2d6 DEF.
Full Moon: +2 targets.
Waning: ignores negative damage factors.

Magical.name: Augur
Magical.effect: Delay-1: +5 DMG or +3 CR. Delay-2: both.

Magical.name: Eventide
Magical.effect: Delay-1. Target gains 3 Curse until Eventide lands. Delay-2: Curse -DEF +2.

Magical.name: Echo Burst
Magical.effect: Delay-1: lose Splash, gain +5 DEF until lands. Cannot stack.

Magical.name: Corruption
Magical.effect: On hit: target takes 5% of max HP over 100 damage. Up to Delay-2: +5*Delay%. Until lands: damaging statuses deal bonus = half on-hit damage.

Magical.name: Dawn Break
Magical.effect: Delay-2. Until lands: attacks on target have -1 MR. +1 Delay: +1 more -1 MR.

Magical.name: Oracle
Magical.effect: Add or remove 1 delay from any number of delayed attacks. May be self-targeting non-damaging Movement+Swift.

Magical.name: Scry
Magical.effect: Delay-1: Cone +1. Choose target: +10*X% of total delay on target to attack (X = targets).

Magical.name: Prophecy
Magical.effect: Per delayed move that landed start of turn: +2.5 ACC, +2 DMG. Delay-1/2: lose prior bonuses, gain +8 DMG per delayed move landing with Prophecy. Updates when delays used.

Magical.name: Fateweave
Magical.effect: Choose Delay 1-5. Per foe dying on landing turn: permanent +2 ACC, +4 CR. After lands: delays <= 2 land immediately on user death. Disabled after hit. Ignores ATK/MAG and outside factors. Gains use on miss.

Magical.name: Otherworldly Attraction
Magical.effect: Accuracy per target. Statuses from this move ignored when moving toward user.\ninflict Slow/1.\nThirst 4: inflict Cripple 4/1.

Magical.name: Indulge
Magical.effect: Ignores target DEF.\nThirst 7: on hit, lose half Blood (round up), heal 30% damage, cannot gain Blood until next turn.\nThirst 10: no effects.

Magical.name: Sanguine Explosion
Magical.effect: Reaction: when reaching 10 Blood. inflict Slow/1. Also usable without use on foe death: originates from foe, Burst 2, loses Push.

Magical.name: Lasting Cuts
Magical.effect: inflict 3 Cripple/1. If already Crippled: Cripple +2, duration set to 1.

Magical.name: Savage Spin-out
Magical.effect: Splash: Beam 1 behind target. Original: Pull 3. Splash targets: Push 1.

Magical.name: Debilitate
Magical.effect: Ignores 4 DEF, +4 per Ramping Magic proc. If ignores all target MDEF: triggers Ramping Magic.

Magical.name: Piercing Jab
Magical.effect: Per 30 damage taken since last turn: +1 dice, range upgrade (Pierce -> Beam -> Cone).

Magical.name: Enchanted Blade
Magical.effect: inflict 4 Curse/1 or 4 Bleed/1. Multiple targets: both (damage does not stack).

Magical.name: Handle Bash
Magical.effect: Pull 1 or Push 1. Teleport to Beam 2 in attack direction (Push) or opposite (Pull). Next turn: target's actions cost 1 MP.

Magical.name: Thirteenfold Cut
Magical.effect: Choose up to 3: inflict -5 DEF/1. Targets may negate. Per negation: user gains +4 DEF/1.

Magical.name: Guillotine
Magical.effect: Starts at 0 uses. Gains use on Ramping Magic proc. +1 dice per Ramping Magic proc, -1 dice per target.

Physical.name: Arrow Flurry
Physical.effect: If target has Mark: Splash 1. If target has 3+ Marks: Splash 2 instead.

Physical.name: Arrow Net
Physical.effect: Before damage: target takes 3 damage each time they gain a Mark from user/1.

Physical.name: Pierce
Physical.effect: If target has 1+ Marks: ignores EVA and 1/4 DEF. If 2+ Marks: also ignores negative ACC modifiers and ignores 1/2 DEF.

Physical.name: Quick Scope
Physical.effect: Ignores ATK/MAG, half DEF, and outside damage factors (except Hunter's Mark).

Physical.name: Explosive Shot
Physical.effect: The target holds a "Bomb". If a foe with a Bomb targets another foe (including their allies) they transfer the Bomb to one of their targets.\nAfter one round or when the holder dies, the Bomb detonates and deals Xd4 Bomb damage to foes in the Bomb's Burst 1. X = the foe who held the Bomb with the most Marks.

Physical.name: Serrated Arrows
Physical.effect: inflict X Bleed/1 (X = half of Hunter's Mark damage from this attack).

Physical.name: Swift Shot
Physical.effect: If target is at Range 7+: crit on 14+. If target is under Range 3: gain +1 MP/2.

Physical.name: Crippling Shot
Physical.effect:
Effect varies by range.
1-2: inflict Slow/1.
3+: inflict 2 Cripple/1 on accuracy 14+.
7+: inflict Cripple regardless of accuracy.

Physical.name: Blessed Arrow
Physical.effect: Allies in target's Star 2: healing and buffs x1.25/1. Foes in target's Star 2: debuffs x1.25/1. Does not stack. As non-damaging Standard: 1/Tile/Range 10.

Physical.name: Scatter Shot
Physical.effect: If target is at Range 7+: Splash 1.

Physical.name: Chase Arrow
Physical.effect: Targets within 8 tiles. May target foes on path to original target (path cannot exceed range). Damage to path foes: ignores ATK/MAG and DEF.

Physical.name: Volley
Physical.effect: If target is 7+ tiles away: +1 hit. If foes in Splash 1 of target: +2 hits. Bonus hits target random foes in Splash 1 (including original). Each: half target DEF, ignores ATK/MAG.

Physical.name: Fireworks
Physical.effect: If target at Range 7+: Bomb dice. If target under Range 3: Bound Bow becomes +5 DEF/1 and +1 MP/1 until user attacks at Range 3+.

Physical.name: Blitz
Physical.effect: Crit on 18+. Per hit: gain +4 damage on next attack.

Physical.name: Windmill
Physical.effect: Non-Foe targets: gain +X ACC or CR/1 (X = players in range). As Swift: buffs halved. Attack only as Standard against Foes.

Physical.name: Splinter
Physical.effect: Per crit: next attack gains -1.5 dice faces and +1 base dice. Dice faces round up

Physical.name: Trick Shot
Physical.effect: If +ACC: Splash 1. If +4+ ACC: becomes Magical, Splash 2.

Physical.name: Venom Shot
Physical.effect: Non-Hawkeye +ACC treated as +CR. inflict Poison/1 (X = 2 * +CR). If 12+: halve poison, extend 1 round.

Physical.name: Arrow Storm
Physical.effect: Crit on 18+.

Physical.name: Shrapnel Tip
Physical.effect: Per crit: gains +1 hit (MR 3, 2d3+0).

Physical.name: Overdraw
Physical.effect: Next attack gains one bonus:\nIf single-hit: non-duration numbers doubled (including X).\nIf multi-hit: +ACC treated as +dice faces on accuracy rolls.

Physical.name: Exercitus
Physical.effect: Gladius: swap to Scutum. Scutum: Push 3, swap to Pilum. Pilum: inflict 4 Cripple/1, swap to Gladius.

Physical.name: Disengage
Physical.effect: Gladius: inflict -2d6 DEF/1, Push 1. Scutum: half AoE damage/1, push back 1. Switch to Pilum.

Physical.name: Forward Jab
Physical.effect: Requires Pilum. +1 base dice

Physical.name: Breach
Physical.effect: Switch to Gladius or Scutum. Gladius: foes entering melee take 3d8 damage/1. Scutum: user and allies in Burst 2 cannot have DEF ignored/1.

Physical.name: Phalanx
Physical.effect: Requires Scutum. Reaction: when foe hits user or ally in user's melee. If target in melee: +1 dice, swap to Gladius. If not: swap to Pilum. Ignores outside factors, ATK/MAG, half DEF.

Physical.name: Shield Wall
Physical.effect: Requires Gladius or Pilum. Switch to Scutum. Flat modifier on base rolls targeting user becomes negative/1. May be non-damaging Standard.

Physical.name: Deus Vult
Physical.effect: Requires Scutum. Before accuracy: immune to statuses and debuffs/1, remove existing.

Physical.name: Weapon Crash
Physical.effect:
Varies by subweapon.
Gladius: 1/Foe/Melee, +3 dice faces.
Scutum: AoE/Foes/Cone 2, attacks on user immune to positive outside factors/1.
Pilum: AoE/Foes/Pierce 5, -3 MR.
Dual Wield: pick one range and one effect.

Physical.name: Impede
Physical.effect: Pilum: steal targets' buffs (duration 1). Switch to Scutum.\nScutum: becomes AoE/Foes/Beam 4. Switch to Gladius.\nGladius: gain +1 MP/1, reduce other cooldowns 1 round. Switch to Pilum.

Physical.name: Thwack
Physical.effect: Only Stun can prevent use. +1 dice per 5 ATK or MAG (whichever higher) target has above 20.

Physical.name: Grave of Titans
Physical.effect: Ignores DEF. Per 10 max HP target has above 120: +3 DMG, -1 MR. If damage reduced by foes: next Standard/Full gains +1 ACC/1, +1 CR/1, and +1 dice.

Physical.name: Inertial Shift
Physical.effect: If foe moved or attempted to move user last round: +2 dice, becomes Homing 8 (Pull 7).

Physical.name: Pole Vault
Physical.effect: Teleport to unoccupied tile in range (ignores range reduction, even on miss). Targets foes in Splash. If no foes: not an attack.

Physical.name: Hardwood Slam
Physical.effect:
Choose status if condition met. -2 MR (Poison), +2 dice (Confusion), or heal 5 HP (Bleed).
5 Poison/2: if user ACC negative or target EVA increased.
Confusion/2: if target's ACC caused them to hit or trigger effect on user/allies.
6 Bleed/2: if target crit or had +dice on attack on user/allies.

Physical.name: Exploit Feign
Physical.effect: inflict -4 DEF/1 or -4 DMG/1. If user debuffed by foe: cleanse before accuracy, +1 hit, debuff doubled.

Physical.name: Stance Breaker
Physical.effect: If target gained >5 DEF, HP or Shield last round: advantage dice. gain 75% of highest as Shield/1.

Physical.name: Calamitous Trance
Physical.effect: If target dealt 50+ to user last round: +3 dice. If 75+: +4 dice faces. -1 MR per hit on user since last turn. Confusion/2 when MR < 4.

Physical.name: Disarm

Swift.effect: Create Stone wall on target and Line 2 in chosen direction. Removed after 2 rounds, or Free action on user's turn. Foes ending turn with Stone in Melee: take 5 damage and inflict 3 Burn/1. Stone acts like Ice, 30 HP to break, 1 EVA.

Swift.name: First Aid
Swift.effect: Heal target for rolled amount. If ally: may use as Standard to add ATK or MAG. Can only target if attacked in last round.

Swift.name: Ward
Swift.effect: Cannot be inflicted with debuffs or statuses/1.

Swift.name: Heaven's Wind
Swift.effect: Swap targets.

Swift.name: Emboîté
Swift.effect: Targets' abilities on cooldown: use 1 round earlier (E3T->EoT, EoT->Every Turn).

Swift.name: Fouetté
Swift.effect: Until next turn: target may use one Once/Twice/Thrice move without expending a use. Cannot target Reactions or Triggers.

Swift.name: Divertissement
Swift.effect: Target's next Standard/Full attack next turn: gain +dice faces equal to actions used that turn (max +5). Unaffected by En Pointe.

Swift.name: Radiance
Swift.effect: Until next turn: user takes 80% damage from attacks. Aegis redirects 50%.

Swift.name: Fractal Division
Swift.effect: This turn: next single-target attack targets 2 foes in Range 4. Loses Splash. User picks target for secondary effects.

Swift.name: Tunneling
Swift.effect: This turn: move through tiles and foes as Normal tiles. Cannot end turn on obstructions or Broken tiles.

Swift.name: Quick Scope
Swift.effect: Ignores ATK/MAG, half DEF, and outside damage factors (except Hunter's Mark).

Swift.name: Shadow Quiver
Swift.effect: Next Standard attack becomes Magical, treats non-player obstructions as Air, ignores non-targets. Loses 2 damage per Air tile passed through.

Swift.name: Sanctified Blade
Swift.effect: Next single-target attack: CP sacrifice +10%. If foe targeted user since last turn: +5%.

Swift.name: Oblation
Swift.effect: Next attack this turn: double damage from CP.

Swift.name: Phantasmal Shield
Swift.effect: Target heals 15% of damage taken/1. Per Standard/Full hit on target: -5% (min 0%).

Swift.name: Effigial Pyre
Swift.effect: Destroy Totem: inflict 13 Burn/1 on foes in tile's Burst 1. Current Totem type loses effects for game. Totem range becomes Burst 2.

Swift.name: Invigorate
Swift.effect: Bonus varies by subweapon.\nGladius: +5 DMG/1. Scutum: 7 Shield/1. Pilum: +1 ACC/1 and +1 CR/1.

Swift.name: Dual Wield
Swift.effect: Before moving: MP halved

Swift.name: Gravity Well
Swift.effect: Next attack this turn: before accuracy, choose non-Splash target. Pull another entity in target's Burst 2 to tile in target's Burst 1.

Swift.name: Crusade
Swift.effect: Until next turn: gain +1 MP

Swift.name: Delirium
Swift.effect: Spend 25 Resolve per debuff. X = Enrage: inflict -X ACC/1, -X CR/1, -X dice/1, -5X DEF/1.\nSpend 30 more: if cleansed or prevented, target gains disadvantage dice/1.

Swift.name: Bushido
Swift.effect: Choose up to 2 allies. Gain Resolve = 50% of damage they took from attacks that didn't target user/1.

Swift.name: Cryosphere
Swift.effect: Replace up to 3 Water/Stop/Stone tiles in Pierce 5 or Burst 1 with Ice/2. Foes ending turn in melee of Ice: 15 damage. Replaced Stops cannot be fully surrounded.

Swift.name: The Serenity of Nature
Swift.effect: If attacked or attacked: sacrifice 50-100 HP and max HP. Summon Nature Spirit in Melee (acts after user). Win requires both defeated. Disabled after use.\nNature Spirit: 125% sacrificed HP | 17 ATK/MAG | 5 DEF | 1 EVA | 4 MP. Moves: Basic Abilities, Terraform (1 tile), Rototill, Bioturbation, Wildfire, Bloom, Flower Crown.

Swift.name: Sanctuary
Swift.effect: Next channeling: +1 round.

Swift.name: Blinding Sheen
Swift.effect: Spend 1 Coin: inflict -DEF equal to damage this turn. Ignores outside factors, ATK/MAG, DEF.

Swift.name: Draw Blood
Swift.effect: Ignores ATK/DEF. Auto-hits (rolls accuracy). +1 MP this turn. If 5+ damage: +1 Blood, next attack this turn +1 base dice.

Swift.name: Sky Turns Red
Swift.effect: The user's next 2 Fangs attacks on foes cannot cause the user to lose Blood and gain "Thirst X: This move ignores X DEF, and heals equal to 5 * X% of the damage dealt to one target." (X is equal to the user's Blood).\nThis effect ends if the user reaches 10 Blood, if they use Indulge (before accuracy), or if they use a Free action to end it early.

Swift.name: Weaver's Whirl
Swift.effect: gain 2d8 Shield/1. When Shield breaks: foes in Star 1: inflict -2 MP/1 (max -4).

Reaction.name: Staccato
Reaction.effect: Reaction: When a foe attacks user or Duet ally (after damage). Hits target and foes in Star 2 of user and Duet ally. inflict -2 DEF/1 and -1 EVA/1 per hit. If attacker kills Duet ally: gain permanent +2 MP, +2 ACC, +2 CR. Ignores outside damage factors.

Reaction.name: Aegis
Reaction.effect: Reaction: When ally in Homing 4 damaged by attack. Move adjacent to ally. Redirect 25% of attack damage to user. User not considered target if not already.

Reaction.name: Rewind
Reaction.effect: Reaction: When user or foe attacking user rolls attack damage. Reroll up to 3 damage dice. Rerolled dice cannot trigger or negate Bomb dice.

Reaction.name: Phalanx
Reaction.effect: Requires Scutum. Reaction: when foe hits user or ally in user's melee. If target in melee: +1 dice, swap to Gladius. If not: swap to Pilum. Ignores outside factors, ATK/MAG, half DEF.

Reaction.name: Defiance
Reaction.effect: Reaction: when foe statuses user or targets outside Range 4. Teleport to unoccupied tile in their Melee. Next Standard/Full: +2 ACC

Reaction.name: Figure 8
Reaction.effect: Reaction: when foe willingly moves out of user's Range 2 from Melee

Reaction.name: Aftershock
Reaction.effect: Reaction: after user pushes target. Move up to tiles pushed in that direction. Then deal 1d10+6 to foes in user's Burst 1.

Reaction.name: Allez
Reaction.effect: Reaction: once between turns on attack involving user. Remove 1 dice, store Focus = half of removed dice faces.

Reaction.name: Deflect
Reaction.effect: Reaction: when foe attacks user. Attack loses 10% damage, store as Focus. If attack moves user: Pull 2. Ignores non-Rapier outside factors.

Reaction.name: Parry
Reaction.effect: Reaction: on attack involving user (no Rapier reaction since last turn). Attack loses all damage and dice buffs. Store Focus = removed buff's value.

Reaction.name: All for One
Reaction.effect: Reaction: when user spends Focus. If targeting same player as previous Focus spend: gain half-value Focus.

Reaction.name: Card Counter
Reaction.effect: Once per turn: reroll Cards dice effect (Craps: reroll damage dice).

Reaction.name: Foresight
Reaction.effect: Reaction: when user attacked, after damage rolled. Remove 10% damage. Add to: 1) delayed attacks, or 2) user's HP x number of delayed attacks.

Reaction.name: Sanguine Explosion
Reaction.effect: Reaction: when reaching 10 Blood. inflict Slow/1. Also usable without use on foe death: originates from foe, Burst 2, loses Push.

Movement.name: Reforge
Movement.effect: Choose one base stat (except HP). Foe: reduce by 1/3/1, cannot receive buffs to that stat. Ally: multiply by 1.5/1.

Movement.name: Soulstep
Movement.effect: Move up to MP. Targeting before or after movement. Ignores outside damage factors, DEF, and ATK/MAG.

Movement.name: Warp
Movement.effect: Teleport to tile in Range 4. Inflict -5 DEF/1 on foes in tile's Burst 1. This turn: attacks pass through players.

Movement.name: Quick Thinking
Movement.effect: After last Standard: spend MP, move 1 tile per 2 MP. Ignores Backstep penalty.

Movement.name: Martial Mastery
Movement.effect: Move up to MP+1, all tiles except final treated as Normal. This turn: attacks ignore obstructions and DEF, invert foe's negative outside damage factors.

Full.name: Mending Mantel
Full.effect: Place Hearth tile. When user or allies end turn in its Star 3: gain +5 DEF/1 and heal 5 HP. Hearth acts like Stone. Removed when user dies.

Full.name: Sacrificial Lamb
Full.effect: Before accuracy: players in Totem range sacrifice 5 HP. Per sacrifice: +1 target, +1 base dice, -1 MR.

Full.name: Ancestral Wrath
Full.effect:
Requires Totem within Range 5. Targets within Totem range. Effects by type:
Blood: targets cannot leave Totem range/1.
Bone: cleanse debuffs/statuses on allies, cleanse buffs on foes in range.
Soul: heal allies in range for 1/3 of damage dealt.

Full.name: Dazing Hook
Full.effect: Range cannot be reduced. If target attacked user outside Melee last round: inflict Confusion/1 and Inverse Bomb dice/1.

Full.name: Collision Course
Full.effect: Original target: Push to tile in their Range 5. Subsequent: Push to tile in their Range 3. Can Push user/allies via Unstoppable Force (no damage). Each target once.

Full.name: Elastic Collision
Full.effect: Before targeting: move up to MP in straight line (half diagonals). X = 1 + tiles moved. Apex: +2 CR.

Full.name: Night Visitor
Full.effect: Requires foe damaged this game not in melee. Before accuracy: teleport to melee of target.\nThirst 5: hits foes in Star 1 after teleport, inflict Slow/1.\nThirst 9: usable in melee, Star 2, lose 1 Blood +1 per hit.

Standard.name: Superposition
Standard.effect: Roll d20 and store (max 1). Reaction: before user accuracy check, substitute stored roll. Reaction: when foe attacks in Range 4 after accuracy, replace accuracy with stored roll (cannot cause miss).

Standard.name: Arrow Flurry
Standard.effect: If target has Mark: Splash 1. If target has 3+ Marks: Splash 2 instead.

Standard.name: Cursed Bolts
Standard.effect: inflict 3X Curse/1 (X = Marks on target). If target has 3+ Marks: ignores negative outside damage factors.

Standard.name: Arrow Net
Standard.effect: Before damage: target takes 3 damage each time they gain a Mark from user/1.

Standard.name: Pierce
Standard.effect: If target has 1+ Marks: ignores EVA and 1/4 DEF. If 2+ Marks: also ignores negative ACC modifiers and ignores 1/2 DEF.

Standard.name: Explosive Shot
Standard.effect: The target holds a "Bomb". If a foe with a Bomb targets another foe (including their allies) they transfer the Bomb to one of their targets.\nAfter one round or when the holder dies, the Bomb detonates and deals Xd4 Bomb damage to foes in the Bomb's Burst 1. X = the foe who held the Bomb with the most Marks.

Standard.name: Tornado Bolt
Standard.effect: Push X (X = 1 + Marks on target). If target cannot be pushed full distance: gain +1 Mark.

Standard.name: Serrated Arrows
Standard.effect: inflict X Bleed/1 (X = half of Hunter's Mark damage from this attack).

Standard.name: Swift Shot
Standard.effect: If target is at Range 7+: crit on 14+. If target is under Range 3: gain +1 MP/2.

Standard.name: Crippling Shot
Standard.effect:
Effect varies by range.
1-2: inflict Slow/1.
3+: inflict 2 Cripple/1 on accuracy 14+.
7+: inflict Cripple regardless of accuracy.

Standard.name: Blessed Arrow
Standard.effect: Allies in target's Star 2: healing and buffs x1.25/1. Foes in target's Star 2: debuffs x1.25/1. Does not stack. As non-damaging Standard: 1/Tile/Range 10.

Standard.name: Scatter Shot
Standard.effect: If target is at Range 7+: Splash 1.

Standard.name: Arcane Shot
Standard.effect: If target under Range 3: Push 3. If target at Range 7+: ignores up to 10 DEF.

Standard.name: Chase Arrow
Standard.effect: Targets within 8 tiles. May target foes on path to original target (path cannot exceed range). Damage to path foes: ignores ATK/MAG and DEF.

Standard.name: Volley
Standard.effect: If target is 7+ tiles away: +1 hit. If foes in Splash 1 of target: +2 hits. Bonus hits target random foes in Splash 1 (including original). Each: half target DEF, ignores ATK/MAG.

Standard.name: Fireworks
Standard.effect: If target at Range 7+: Bomb dice. If target under Range 3: Bound Bow becomes +5 DEF/1 and +1 MP/1 until user attacks at Range 3+.

Standard.name: Blitz
Standard.effect: Crit on 18+. Per hit: gain +4 damage on next attack.

Standard.name: Hook Shot
Standard.effect: If +2 CR: Pull user within Range 2 of target, or target within Range 2 of user. Not an attack on Allies.

Standard.name: Splinter
Standard.effect: Per crit: next attack gains -1.5 dice faces and +1 base dice. Dice faces round up

Standard.name: Salvo
Standard.effect: May target different foes per hit. Adds ATK/MAG and applies damage effects to each.

Standard.name: Trick Shot
Standard.effect: If +ACC: Splash 1. If +4+ ACC: becomes Magical, Splash 2.

Standard.name: Surge
Standard.effect: Per crit: next multi-hit attack gains +1 hit.

Standard.name: Venom Shot
Standard.effect: Non-Hawkeye +ACC treated as +CR. inflict Poison/1 (X = 2 * +CR). If 12+: halve poison, extend 1 round.

Standard.name: Sagittarian Pride
Standard.effect: Hits = number of moves targets used since user's last turn.

Standard.name: Arrow Storm
Standard.effect: Crit on 18+.

Standard.name: Shrapnel Tip
Standard.effect: Per crit: gains +1 hit (MR 3, 2d3+0).

Standard.name: Overdraw
Standard.effect: Next attack gains one bonus:\nIf single-hit: non-duration numbers doubled (including X).\nIf multi-hit: +ACC treated as +dice faces on accuracy rolls.

Standard.name: Bloodrush
Standard.effect: If used from max range: gain +5 DMG/1 and +1 MP/1.

Standard.name: Defile
Standard.effect: inflict 3 Curse/1. When foe takes Curse damage: user takes equal CP.

Standard.name: Purloin Youth
Standard.effect: Attacks targeting user: 10% recoil/1. User sacrifices half recoil to CP.

Standard.name: Pentagram
Standard.effect: Start of next turn: foes in user's Burst 1 take 2d6+3 + user's CP damage.

Standard.name: Massacre
Standard.effect: If kill: gain 2x CP and +1 use of Massacre. If not: no CP sacrifice.

Standard.name: Exsanguinate
Standard.effect: If CP from this move grants Black Magic bonus: +1 to that bonus.

Standard.name: Siphon Soul
Standard.effect: Before accuracy: heal HP equal to CP.

Standard.name: Reap
Standard.effect: Reaper's Touch heals 1/5 instead of 1/8 on this attack.

Standard.name: Hades' Toll
Standard.effect: Reaper's Touch heal +50% on attacks against target/2.

Standard.name: Haunted Swing
Standard.effect: Targets at full HP: +5 damage. Heal 5 HP per target triggered.

Standard.name: Wither Soul
Standard.effect: Per debuff or status on target: Reaper's Touch heals +3 HP.

Standard.name: Pestilent Strike
Standard.effect: inflict X Poison/1 (X = Reaper's Touch healing from this attack). If X >= 6: halve poison, extend 1 round.

Standard.name: Coup de Grâce
Standard.effect: If kill: heal 10 HP, gain +5 damage to next attack.

Standard.name: Spirit Break
Standard.effect: inflict -3 DEF/1. gain +3 DMG/1.

Standard.name: Memento Mori
Standard.effect: Delay-1. May delay up to +2 more turns. Per extra delay: Reaper's Touch heals +1/8 of damage.

Standard.name: Stroke of Midnight
Standard.effect: Before damage: Reaper's Touch healing becomes +damage on this attack/1. Other Scythe healing becomes +DMG/1.

Standard.name: Phantom Blade
Standard.effect: Reaper's Touch heal on this attack = HP healed from Scythe abilities (except Phantom Blade) last round.

Standard.name: Void's Call
Standard.effect: Pull targets towards Totem tile instead of user.

Standard.name: Left-Hand Path
Standard.effect: User moves along line from origin until hitting obstruction. If no Totem: inflict -2 EVA/1 and -3 DEF/1.

Standard.name: Heredity
Standard.effect: Totem moves adjacent to target. Heal HP sacrificed to create it. If no Totem: place one on target's tile.

Standard.name: Feral Spark
Standard.effect: Target: 10% recoil/1. User's current Totem type numerical effects doubled.

Standard.name: Blasphemy
Standard.effect: inflict 6 Curse/1. While Cursed: targeting an ally extends Curse 1 round.

Standard.name: Exercitus
Standard.effect: Gladius: swap to Scutum. Scutum: Push 3, swap to Pilum. Pilum: inflict 4 Cripple/1, swap to Gladius.

Standard.name: Disengage
Standard.effect: Gladius: inflict -2d6 DEF/1, Push 1. Scutum: half AoE damage/1, push back 1. Switch to Pilum.

Standard.name: Forward Jab
Standard.effect: Requires Pilum. +1 base dice

Standard.name: Breach
Standard.effect: Switch to Gladius or Scutum. Gladius: foes entering melee take 3d8 damage/1. Scutum: user and allies in Burst 2 cannot have DEF ignored/1.

Standard.name: Shield Wall
Standard.effect: Requires Gladius or Pilum. Switch to Scutum. Flat modifier on base rolls targeting user becomes negative/1. May be non-damaging Standard.

Standard.name: Deus Vult
Standard.effect: Requires Scutum. Before accuracy: immune to statuses and debuffs/1, remove existing.

Standard.name: Weapon Crash
Standard.effect:
Varies by subweapon.
Gladius: 1/Foe/Melee, +3 dice faces.
Scutum: AoE/Foes/Cone 2, attacks on user immune to positive outside factors/1.
Pilum: AoE/Foes/Pierce 5, -3 MR.
Dual Wield: pick one range and one effect.

Standard.name: Impede
Standard.effect: Pilum: steal targets' buffs (duration 1). Switch to Scutum.\nScutum: becomes AoE/Foes/Beam 4. Switch to Gladius.\nGladius: gain +1 MP/1, reduce other cooldowns 1 round. Switch to Pilum.

Standard.name: Thwack
Standard.effect: Only Stun can prevent use. +1 dice per 5 ATK or MAG (whichever higher) target has above 20.

Standard.name: Grave of Titans
Standard.effect: Ignores DEF. Per 10 max HP target has above 120: +3 DMG, -1 MR. If damage reduced by foes: next Standard/Full gains +1 ACC/1, +1 CR/1, and +1 dice.

Standard.name: Inertial Shift
Standard.effect: If foe moved or attempted to move user last round: +2 dice, becomes Homing 8 (Pull 7).

Standard.name: Pole Vault
Standard.effect: Teleport to unoccupied tile in range (ignores range reduction, even on miss). Targets foes in Splash. If no foes: not an attack.

Standard.name: Hardwood Slam
Standard.effect:
Choose status if condition met. -2 MR (Poison), +2 dice (Confusion), or heal 5 HP (Bleed).
5 Poison/2: if user ACC negative or target EVA increased.
Confusion/2: if target's ACC caused them to hit or trigger effect on user/allies.
6 Bleed/2: if target crit or had +dice on attack on user/allies.

Standard.name: Exploit Feign
Standard.effect: inflict -4 DEF/1 or -4 DMG/1. If user debuffed by foe: cleanse before accuracy, +1 hit, debuff doubled.

Standard.name: Stance Breaker
Standard.effect: If target gained >5 DEF, HP or Shield last round: advantage dice. gain 75% of highest as Shield/1.

Standard.name: Calamitous Trance
Standard.effect: If target dealt 50+ to user last round: +3 dice. If 75+: +4 dice faces. -1 MR per hit on user since last turn. Confusion/2 when MR < 4.

Standard.name: Disarm
Standard.effect: Each target's next Standard/Full on user: -1 dice

Standard.name: Spurn
Standard.effect: If target can attack from Melee next turn but doesn't: user may AoO them at end of turn.

Standard.name: Reversal
Standard.effect: If target can end turn on different tile type but doesn't: gain +2 ACC/1, next attack ignores half DEF.

Standard.name: Yin Yang
Standard.effect: Choose Yin or Yang.\nYin: Physical/Melee. If target doesn't damage user next turn: target takes 1d8+5.\nYang: Magical/Homing 4. Foes take 1d8+5 when damaging user/1.

Standard.name: Standoff
Standard.effect: If target ends next turn in user's Melee: user may AoO (ignores ATK/MAG).

Standard.name: Tempest Sweep
Standard.effect: Choose Honte or Gyakute.\nHonte: Physical. Next turn: Tonfa effects lasting 1 round/turn last +1 round/turn.\nGyakute: Magical. Next Tonfa attack gains Star 2 Splash.

Standard.name: Feral Chop
Standard.effect: X = 2.5 * user's Rage.

Standard.name: Chain Axe
Standard.effect: Bloodlust grants +1 Rage per damage instance/1.

Standard.name: Power Swing
Standard.effect: Spend X Rage: -X MR

Standard.name: Wide Slash
Standard.effect: Up to 2x: spend 2 Rage for +1 range.

Standard.name: Knockback
Standard.effect: inflict Slow/1. Spend 1 Rage: +1 Push and/or inflict Cripple 6/1 instead.

Standard.name: Franciscate
Standard.effect: Gain +2 MP

Standard.name: Gash
Standard.effect: Spend Rage: inflict 5 Bleed/X (X = Rage spent).

Standard.name: Sever
Standard.effect: Spend Rage: +1 hit and +1 MR per Rage.

Standard.name: Amped Strike
Standard.effect: +damage = 4 * user's Rage. Lose all Rage.

Standard.name: Wrath
Standard.effect: Spend 2 Rage per effect (cost +1 each use). Choose: +4d10 base roll, Splash 2, or -3 MR. -2 ACC on Tile.

Standard.name: Cyclone Sweep
Standard.effect: +dice = number of targets hit.

Standard.name: Storm Strike
Standard.effect: Teleport to tile in target's Splash 1. inflict Slow/1.

Standard.name: Seismic Smash
Standard.effect: inflict 2 Cripple/2.

Standard.name: Crush
Standard.effect: If target cannot be pushed full distance: +1d10+5 damage.

Standard.name: Earth Render
Standard.effect: After damage or miss: replace up to 2 unoccupied tiles in Burst 2 of target with Broken (2 rounds, or until user dies/removes as Trigger).

Standard.name: Lagging Spin
Standard.effect: Ignores 4 DEF per MP spent moving away from start tile. If all MP spent moving away: +2 dice.

Standard.name: Shockwave Slam
Standard.effect: Splash hits foes in target's Star. Original target: Push 2 in chosen direction. Splash targets: Push 2 away from original.

Standard.name: Fissure
Standard.effect: Regardless of hit: push target. Tiles target exits while pushed become permanent Broken (unremovable, unignorable). Foes entering Burst 1 of Broken: 2d8 damage, once/turn per foe. User may remove any as Trigger on their turns.

Standard.name: Razor Rust
Standard.effect: Target: 3 MP/1. Apex: inflict 5 Cripple/1.

Standard.name: Tomahawk Toss
Standard.effect: X = 4 - range used at. Apex: Pull 3

Standard.name: Repulse Slice
Standard.effect: No Push on Apex. Apex: per tile target moves toward user next turn: Plate Crusher values +1.

Standard.name: Continental Crash
Standard.effect: After Push: place Broken tile in target's Melee (3 rounds). User may remove as Trigger. Foes ending turn in tile's Melee: 10 damage. Apex: hits foes in target's Splash 1.

Standard.name: Kinetic Impact
Standard.effect: If target cannot be moved full distance: +1 dice. Apex: -2 Push, +2 dice faces.

Standard.name: Two Handed
Standard.effect: If user didn't push target last turn: +2 Push. Apex: if target can't be moved full distance: inflict 7 Bleed/1.

Standard.name: Supreme Strikes
Standard.effect: 1 Push per hit. May target in two directions, or +1 hit in one direction. Each direction: accuracy and Apex independently. Apex: +2 hits in this direction.

Standard.name: Besiege
Standard.effect: Before accuracy: sacrifice up to 10 HP. Gain equal Shield/1. 1.5x if target >50% HP.

Standard.name: Bastion
Standard.effect: Foe attacks entering user's Cone 1: lose 2 dice/1. While in Melee of current tile: +4 DEF.

Standard.name: Catapult Campaign
Standard.effect: Cannot use at Range 2. Target >75% HP: inflict 5 Bleed/1. May self-inflict 10 Bleed/1 to double Bleed.

Standard.name: Ambush
Standard.effect: Lose all Campaigns. Coronation disabled until next turn. Per Campaign lost: gain +0.5 MP/1

Standard.name: Entrench
Standard.effect: If less than 6 bonus DEF: gain +3 DEF/1. Lose +1 Campaign per RtR instance/1.

Standard.name: War of Attrition
Standard.effect: Before damage: inflict inverse of user's active RtR bonuses/1.

Standard.name: Shock and Awe
Standard.effect: If 3+ Campaigns: attacks on user immune to positive outside factors/1.

Standard.name: The Art of War
Standard.effect: Choose War or Peace.\nWar: Physical. If 0 Campaigns: +dice faces = 1.5x Campaign max.\nPeace: Magical. Until next Standard/Full: target has -X/3 MP, -2X ATK/MAG (X = user's Campaigns).

Standard.name: Last Stand
Standard.effect: When user would take >55-3X damage (X = Campaign max): attacker takes 3d8+2, damage reduced by 3X/1.

Standard.name: Cursed Slice
Standard.effect: +1 CR. Target's next Standard/Full: 5% recoil. Spend 10 Resolve up to 5x: +1 CR and +5% recoil per spend.

Standard.name: Lunge
Standard.effect: Move adjacent to target (even on miss). Spend 20 Resolve up to 3x: -1 MR per spend. After damage: choose +10% damage dealt and taken/1.

Standard.name: Blade of Woe
Standard.effect: Before damage: inflict 5 Curse/1 on user and target. First Resolve spend after taking 55+ damage while Cursed: resolve effect +1/3.

Standard.name: Lotus Strike
Standard.effect: Spend all Resolve. X hits = Resolve/30. 5*X% recoil (no Resolve from recoil).

Standard.name: Provoke
Standard.effect: If target doesn't deal 45+ to user next turn: Resolve gain x1.75/1. Resolve gained since Provoke also x1.75.

Standard.name: Bloodspill
Standard.effect: Spend 40 Resolve: Burst 1 or Cone 2. Spend 70: Burst 2 or Cone 3. Per kill: no use consumed, +1 Enrage, advantage threshold -20.

Standard.name: Rising Sun
Standard.effect: Spend up to 100 Resolve: gain X% of damage as Shield/1 (X = Resolve/1.5). If first ability this turn: turn continues until another non-Standard/Full. While Shield active: healing doesn't reduce Resolve.

Standard.name: Giant Slayer
Standard.effect: If the user has less HP than the target, they may spend up to X Resolve, where X is the difference between the user's and target's HP. For every 10 Resolve spent, gain +2+Y damage, where Y is current Enrage.

Standard.name: Point-in-Line
Standard.effect: inflict -2 dice faces/1. If debuff not active: gain +2 dice faces/1. Spend Focus: increase one effect by half.

Standard.name: Thrust
Standard.effect: Move to tile in target's Melee. If damage removed by outside factors: inflict 2 Bleed/1. Spend Focus: +Bleed or +1 duration.

Standard.name: Feint
Standard.effect: Targets take half of out-of-turn damage from user/1. Spend Focus: target gains Focus*2% recoil/1.

Standard.name: Patinando
Standard.effect: Per dice 4+: +1 Push. Per dice <4: inflict 3 Cripple/1 (stacking). After damage: spend Focus to replace dice with its value.

Standard.name: Moulinet
Standard.effect: Target gains +4 DMG/1 or +4 DEF/1. Spend Focus: heal 3 HP per ability target uses next turn. If no Focus spent: next Focus gains half-value Focus.

Standard.name: Redoublement
Standard.effect: Spend any Focus: +1 hit per Focus. Each Focus hit: +CR equal to Focus value.

Standard.name: One for All
Standard.effect: Ignores 1/4 DEF. May change splash: Star 2 (1/2 DEF) or Line 2 (3/4 DEF). Per target: gain Focus = DEF ignored.

Standard.name: Rototill
Standard.effect: Physical or Magical. If target on non-Normal tile: lose Pull 3, gain +1 ACC and +1 dice.

Standard.name: Bioturbation

Range.effect: Roll d3 after damage. 1: 0.8x damage. 3: 1.3x damage. Outside factors also affected.

Range.name: Discard
Range.effect: Roll d20. 15+: store reroll (Once/Trigger) for any Cards effect.

Range.name: Roulette
Range.effect: Roll 1d8 for status on foe, then d3. 1 on d3: inflict on self instead. 1=10 Bleed/1, 2=10 Poison/1, 3=10 Burn/1, 4=6 Cripple/1, 5=Root/1, 6=Seal/1, 7=Stun/1, 8=Confusion/1.

Range.name: Gamble
Range.effect: Roll d7. 1: subtract target ATK and MAG. 2: subtract target's higher offense. 3: subtract user ATK. 4: add user ATK. 5: add target's higher offense. 6: add user MAG again. 7: add user ATK and target ATK/MAG. Adds user MAG

Range.name: Double or Nothing
Range.effect: Roll d2. 1: target cannot use Swift/Free until end of user's next turn. 2: target gains +1 Swift (or multiple Free) until user's next turn. Self: must use at start of turn.

Range.name: Blackjack
Range.effect: On a successful hit, roll 2d10, treating 1s as either 1 or 11 (user's choice). The user may choose to roll additional 1d10s to add to the roll. If the total is 17-20, this attack gains 1 base dice. On a total of 21, this attack instead gains 3 base dice and activates Jackpot. On a total of 22 or higher, the attack instead loses 2 base dice.

Range.name: Craps
Range.effect: Bomb dice. Per Bomb trigger: choose another foe in target's Splash 1 (once per foe). 5+ Bomb: Jackpot. Immune to non-Cards positive damage factors. Crit extra dice: no Bomb.

Range.name: Slots Spin
Range.effect: Roll 3d4. Per 4: +1 dice. No 4s: -1 dice. All 4s: +1 more dice.

Range.name: Hi-Lo
Range.effect: Roll d10. Predict higher or lower, then roll again. Correct: +2 base dice, continue (max 5). Wrong: stop, lose half base dice. Same roll: reroll.

Range.name: Moonblast
Range.effect: Next Phase effect value +1.

Range.name: Dark Reflection
Range.effect: inflict inverse of user's Phase/1.

Range.name: Holy Light
Range.effect: If Moonblast or Celestial Blessing active: target's statuses (except Seal/Stun) +1 round.

Range.name: Harvest Moon
Range.effect: New/Full Moon: heal 1d10+2. Otherwise: no Phase shift next turn. May be non-attack Standard.

Range.name: Double Tide
Range.effect: Crit on 16+. If at least 1 crit: gain Moonblast effect.

Range.name: Blood Moon
Range.effect: Waxing/Waning: inflict 2d6 Poison/1. Otherwise: inflict 3d4 Bleed/1.

Range.name: Fatal Moonlight
Range.effect:
Two effects if user has 2 Phases.
New Moon: Seal/1 on max range target.
Waxing: permanent +2d6 DEF.
Full Moon: +2 targets.
Waning: ignores negative damage factors.

Range.name: Augur
Range.effect: Delay-1: +5 DMG or +3 CR. Delay-2: both.

Range.name: Eventide
Range.effect: Delay-1. Target gains 3 Curse until Eventide lands. Delay-2: Curse -DEF +2.

Range.name: Astral Touch
Range.effect: If target kills user within 1 round: reduce delays on them by 1. If target dies within 1 round: transfer one delay to new target in original's Range 7.

Range.name: Dawn Break
Range.effect: Delay-2. Until lands: attacks on target have -1 MR. +1 Delay: +1 more -1 MR.

Range.name: Fancy Footwork
Range.effect: Choose Trip or Slip. Trip: target must move 2+ tiles per direction/1. Slip: teleport to entity's Melee within Range 4.

Range.name: Blinding Sheen
Range.effect: Spend 1 Coin: inflict -DEF equal to damage this turn. Ignores outside factors, ATK/MAG, DEF.

Range.name: Boot Pin
Range.effect: Choose: inflict 6 Poison/2 or 6 Cripple/2. Start of turn: gain +3 DMG/1 per 6 damage from these statuses. Target may remove one status as Swift.

Range.name: Otherworldly Attraction
Range.effect: Accuracy per target. Statuses from this move ignored when moving toward user.\ninflict Slow/1.\nThirst 4: inflict Cripple 4/1.

Range.name: Savage Spin-out
Range.effect: Splash: Beam 1 behind target. Original: Pull 3. Splash targets: Push 1.

Melee.name: Reforge
Melee.effect: Choose one base stat (except HP). Foe: reduce by 1/3/1, cannot receive buffs to that stat. Ally: multiply by 1.5/1.

Melee.name: Pas de Deux
Melee.effect: Target takes turn immediately after user. Target cannot use Pas de Deux that turn. If Standard: target loses Movement. Juggernaut target: only 1 Standard.

Melee.name: Soulstep
Melee.effect: Move up to MP. Targeting before or after movement. Ignores outside damage factors, DEF, and ATK/MAG.

Melee.name: Eightfold Shield
Melee.effect: Spend 2+ Qi: gain +1d4+1 DEF per Qi spent./1

Melee.name: Impasse
Melee.effect: Choose: ally/self, or foe. Ally/self: cannot be inflicted with Push/Pull or stat reduction by foes/1. Foe: remove target's buffs.

Melee.name: Purloin Youth
Melee.effect: Attacks targeting user: 10% recoil/1. User sacrifices half recoil to CP.

Melee.name: Massacre
Melee.effect: If kill: gain 2x CP and +1 use of Massacre. If not: no CP sacrifice.

Melee.name: Exsanguinate
Melee.effect: If CP from this move grants Black Magic bonus: +1 to that bonus.

Melee.name: Reap
Melee.effect: Reaper's Touch heals 1/5 instead of 1/8 on this attack.

Melee.name: Phantasmal Shield
Melee.effect: Target heals 15% of damage taken/1. Per Standard/Full hit on target: -5% (min 0%).

Melee.name: Phantom Blade
Melee.effect: Reaper's Touch heal on this attack = HP healed from Scythe abilities (except Phantom Blade) last round.

Melee.name: Exercitus
Melee.effect: Gladius: swap to Scutum. Scutum: Push 3, swap to Pilum. Pilum: inflict 4 Cripple/1, swap to Gladius.

Melee.name: Disengage
Melee.effect: Gladius: inflict -2d6 DEF/1, Push 1. Scutum: half AoE damage/1, push back 1. Switch to Pilum.

Melee.name: Deus Vult
Melee.effect: Requires Scutum. Before accuracy: immune to statuses and debuffs/1, remove existing.

Melee.name: Thwack
Melee.effect: Only Stun can prevent use. +1 dice per 5 ATK or MAG (whichever higher) target has above 20.

Melee.name: Inertial Shift
Melee.effect: If foe moved or attempted to move user last round: +2 dice, becomes Homing 8 (Pull 7).

Melee.name: Hardwood Slam
Melee.effect:
Choose status if condition met. -2 MR (Poison), +2 dice (Confusion), or heal 5 HP (Bleed).
5 Poison/2: if user ACC negative or target EVA increased.
Confusion/2: if target's ACC caused them to hit or trigger effect on user/allies.
6 Bleed/2: if target crit or had +dice on attack on user/allies.

Melee.name: Exploit Feign
Melee.effect: inflict -4 DEF/1 or -4 DMG/1. If user debuffed by foe: cleanse before accuracy, +1 hit, debuff doubled.

Melee.name: Calamitous Trance
Melee.effect: If target dealt 50+ to user last round: +3 dice. If 75+: +4 dice faces. -1 MR per hit on user since last turn. Confusion/2 when MR < 4.

Melee.name: Disarm
Melee.effect: Each target's next Standard/Full on user: -1 dice

Melee.name: Standoff
Melee.effect: If target ends next turn in user's Melee: user may AoO (ignores ATK/MAG).

Melee.name: Feral Chop
Melee.effect: X = 2.5 * user's Rage.

Melee.name: Power Swing
Melee.effect: Spend X Rage: -X MR

Melee.name: Knockback
Melee.effect: inflict Slow/1. Spend 1 Rage: +1 Push and/or inflict Cripple 6/1 instead.

Melee.name: Gash
Melee.effect: Spend Rage: inflict 5 Bleed/X (X = Rage spent).

Melee.name: Sever
Melee.effect: Spend Rage: +1 hit and +1 MR per Rage.

Melee.name: Amped Strike
Melee.effect: +damage = 4 * user's Rage. Lose all Rage.

Melee.name: Wrath
Melee.effect: Spend 2 Rage per effect (cost +1 each use). Choose: +4d10 base roll, Splash 2, or -3 MR. -2 ACC on Tile.

Melee.name: Seismic Smash
Melee.effect: inflict 2 Cripple/2.

Melee.name: Masonry
Melee.effect: If unoccupied: tile becomes Stone (acts like Ice, 30 HP, 1 EVA). Removed after 2 rounds. Can be Pushed/Pulled (no damage).

Melee.name: Crush
Melee.effect: If target cannot be pushed full distance: +1d10+5 damage.

Melee.name: Shockwave Slam
Melee.effect: Splash hits foes in target's Star. Original target: Push 2 in chosen direction. Splash targets: Push 2 away from original.

Melee.name: Collision Course
Melee.effect: Original target: Push to tile in their Range 5. Subsequent: Push to tile in their Range 3. Can Push user/allies via Unstoppable Force (no damage). Each target once.

Melee.name: Fissure
Melee.effect: Regardless of hit: push target. Tiles target exits while pushed become permanent Broken (unremovable, unignorable). Foes entering Burst 1 of Broken: 2d8 damage, once/turn per foe. User may remove any as Trigger on their turns.

Melee.name: The Art of War
Melee.effect: Choose War or Peace.\nWar: Physical. If 0 Campaigns: +dice faces = 1.5x Campaign max.\nPeace: Magical. Until next Standard/Full: target has -X/3 MP, -2X ATK/MAG (X = user's Campaigns).

Melee.name: Last Stand
Melee.effect: When user would take >55-3X damage (X = Campaign max): attacker takes 3d8+2, damage reduced by 3X/1.

Melee.name: Cursed Slice
Melee.effect: +1 CR. Target's next Standard/Full: 5% recoil. Spend 10 Resolve up to 5x: +1 CR and +5% recoil per spend.

Melee.name: Lotus Strike
Melee.effect: Spend all Resolve. X hits = Resolve/30. 5*X% recoil (no Resolve from recoil).

Melee.name: Delirium
Melee.effect: Spend 25 Resolve per debuff. X = Enrage: inflict -X ACC/1, -X CR/1, -X dice/1, -5X DEF/1.\nSpend 30 more: if cleansed or prevented, target gains disadvantage dice/1.

Melee.name: Rising Sun
Melee.effect: Spend up to 100 Resolve: gain X% of damage as Shield/1 (X = Resolve/1.5). If first ability this turn: turn continues until another non-Standard/Full. While Shield active: healing doesn't reduce Resolve.

Melee.name: Giant Slayer
Melee.effect: If the user has less HP than the target, they may spend up to X Resolve, where X is the difference between the user's and target's HP. For every 10 Resolve spent, gain +2+Y damage, where Y is current Enrage.

Melee.name: Patinando
Melee.effect: Per dice 4+: +1 Push. Per dice <4: inflict 3 Cripple/1 (stacking). After damage: spend Focus to replace dice with its value.

Melee.name: Redoublement
Melee.effect: Spend any Focus: +1 hit per Focus. Each Focus hit: +CR equal to Focus value.

Melee.name: The Serenity of Nature
Melee.effect: If attacked or attacked: sacrifice 50-100 HP and max HP. Summon Nature Spirit in Melee (acts after user). Win requires both defeated. Disabled after use.\nNature Spirit: 125% sacrificed HP | 17 ATK/MAG | 5 DEF | 1 EVA | 4 MP. Moves: Basic Abilities, Terraform (1 tile), Rototill, Bioturbation, Wildfire, Bloom, Flower Crown.

Melee.name: Stacked Deck
Melee.effect:
In place of an accuracy roll, roll a 1d14 for an effect. 
1. The opponent is healed by the roll, 
2. The user takes 2x damage from all sources for one round,
3. The attack misses, 
4. After damage, the user and target swap their current HP (can overheal, foes with over 200 HP are considered to have 200 HP for this effect), 
5. For one round, attacks automatically hit the user,
6. The user and target gain a random position change,
7. The user and target are both Stunned/1,
8. 50% of this attack's damage is dealt to a random foe instead,
9. For one round, the user's attacks automatically hit,
10. The user gains a 1/Any/Global Once/Reaction: "Reroll one accuracy roll.",
11. Cleanse all statuses and numerical debuffs from the user & reset their other moves' frequencies,
12. Target is Sealed/1, 
13. Next turn, the user may choose numbers for their cards effects, rather than rolling dice for them,
14. This attack has unremovable thrice base dice.

Melee.name: Gravity Crash
Melee.effect:
Effect varies by Phase.
New Moon: Homing 4, target cannot use limited moves/1.
Waxing: Push 1d6, inflict 4 Cripple/2.
Full Moon: foes deal 75% to allies in Range 5/1.
Waning: Bomb dice.

Melee.name: Dirty Trick
Melee.effect: Choose Push/Pull, Splash, Buff, or Status. Target's Standard attacks lack chosen attribute/1.

Melee.name: Scallywag Slice
Melee.effect: Choose Outwit or Befuddle. Outwit: +1 CR, target's CR = 1 on first hit of next Standard. Befuddle: target ignores positive tile effects/1.

Melee.name: Shady Bet
Melee.effect: If gaining Coin from this attack: gain Trick Coin instead (choose Swindler effect). May spend Coin to gain Trick Coin (ignores Scoundrel).

Melee.name: High Ground
Melee.effect: Choose Pistol or Taunt. Pistol: AoE/Foes/Pierce 5, targets' Items become Movement/1. Taunt: targets' AoE become Pierce, must target user/1.

Melee.name: Swashbuckler
Melee.effect: Choose Cruel, Sly, or Daring. Cruel: +1 dice. Sly: before accuracy, end target's duration buffs/debuffs. Daring: 10 Shield/1.

Melee.name: Captain's Order
Melee.effect: Target chooses Plank or Marooning. Plank: Push 2, 4 damage per ongoing Cutlass effect on target. Marooning: target's next Standard: 25% recoil.

Melee.name: Twin Fangs
Melee.effect: Per hit: lose 2 Blood.\nThirst 5: +3 MR, Double Hit.

Melee.name: Uninvited Guest
Melee.effect: If first attack on target: gain 2 Blood.\nIf one attacked other last turn but not reciprocated: +8 CR.

Melee.name: Indulge
Melee.effect: Ignores target DEF.\nThirst 7: on hit, lose half Blood (round up), heal 30% damage, cannot gain Blood until next turn.\nThirst 10: no effects.

Melee.name: Debilitate
Melee.effect: Ignores 4 DEF, +4 per Ramping Magic proc. If ignores all target MDEF: triggers Ramping Magic.

Line.name: Cursed Bolts
Line.effect: inflict 3X Curse/1 (X = Marks on target). If target has 3+ Marks: ignores negative outside damage factors.

Line.name: Tornado Bolt
Line.effect: Push X (X = 1 + Marks on target). If target cannot be pushed full distance: gain +1 Mark.

Line.name: Left-Hand Path
Line.effect: User moves along line from origin until hitting obstruction. If no Totem: inflict -2 EVA/1 and -3 DEF/1.

Line.name: Forward Jab
Line.effect: Requires Pilum. +1 base dice

Line.name: Dazing Hook
Line.effect: Range cannot be reduced. If target attacked user outside Melee last round: inflict Confusion/1 and Inverse Bomb dice/1.

Line.name: Franciscate
Line.effect: Gain +2 MP

Line.name: Earth Render
Line.effect: After damage or miss: replace up to 2 unoccupied tiles in Burst 2 of target with Broken (2 rounds, or until user dies/removes as Trigger).

Line.name: Tomahawk Toss
Line.effect: X = 4 - range used at. Apex: Pull 3

Line.name: Kip Up
Line.effect: Push regardless of hit. May negate Push: teleport 1 tile away from target. Ignores outside damage factors, ATK/MAG, DEF.

Line.name: Repulse Slice
Line.effect: No Push on Apex. Apex: per tile target moves toward user next turn: Plate Crusher values +1.

Line.name: Continental Crash
Line.effect: After Push: place Broken tile in target's Melee (3 rounds). User may remove as Trigger. Foes ending turn in tile's Melee: 10 damage. Apex: hits foes in target's Splash 1.

Line.name: Discipline
Line.effect: Start of target's next turn: gain +3X DEF/1 (X = 3 - range used). Apex: if last attack had Apex, next attack applies that Apex effects (excluding extra hits).

Line.name: Kinetic Impact
Line.effect: If target cannot be moved full distance: +1 dice. Apex: -2 Push, +2 dice faces.

Line.name: Two Handed
Line.effect: If user didn't push target last turn: +2 Push. Apex: if target can't be moved full distance: inflict 7 Bleed/1.

Line.name: Elastic Collision
Line.effect: Before targeting: move up to MP in straight line (half diagonals). X = 1 + tiles moved. Apex: +2 CR.

Line.name: Entrench
Line.effect: If less than 6 bonus DEF: gain +3 DEF/1. Lose +1 Campaign per RtR instance/1.

Line.name: Moulinet
Line.effect: Target gains +4 DMG/1 or +4 DEF/1. Spend Focus: heal 3 HP per ability target uses next turn. If no Focus spent: next Focus gains half-value Focus.

Line.name: One for All
Line.effect: Ignores 1/4 DEF. May change splash: Star 2 (1/2 DEF) or Line 2 (3/4 DEF). Per target: gain Focus = DEF ignored.

Line.name: Fireball
Line.effect: Spend 2 Mana. May spend more: +1 base dice per extra Mana. If any damage dice roll 1: inflict 3 Burn/1.

Line.name: Compass
Line.effect: Gain +2 ACC. If miss while channeled: gain +3 CR.

Pierce.name: Pierce
Pierce.effect: If target has 1+ Marks: ignores EVA and 1/4 DEF. If 2+ Marks: also ignores negative ACC modifiers and ignores 1/2 DEF.

Pierce.name: Sagittarian Pride
Pierce.effect: Hits = number of moves targets used since user's last turn.

Pierce.name: Overdraw
Pierce.effect: Next attack gains one bonus:\nIf single-hit: non-duration numbers doubled (including X).\nIf multi-hit: +ACC treated as +dice faces on accuracy rolls.

Pierce.name: Defile
Pierce.effect: inflict 3 Curse/1. When foe takes Curse damage: user takes equal CP.

Pierce.name: Impede
Pierce.effect: Pilum: steal targets' buffs (duration 1). Switch to Scutum.\nScutum: becomes AoE/Foes/Beam 4. Switch to Gladius.\nGladius: gain +1 MP/1, reduce other cooldowns 1 round. Switch to Pilum.

Pierce.name: Supreme Strikes
Pierce.effect: 1 Push per hit. May target in two directions, or +1 hit in one direction. Each direction: accuracy and Apex independently. Apex: +2 hits in this direction.

Pierce.name: Bastion
Pierce.effect: Foe attacks entering user's Cone 1: lose 2 dice/1. While in Melee of current tile: +4 DEF.

Pierce.name: Ambush
Pierce.effect: Lose all Campaigns. Coronation disabled until next turn. Per Campaign lost: gain +0.5 MP/1

Pierce.name: Point-in-Line
Pierce.effect: inflict -2 dice faces/1. If debuff not active: gain +2 dice faces/1. Spend Focus: increase one effect by half.

Pierce.name: Hydrolysis
Pierce.effect: +2 dice faces per foe on Water or Lava.

Pierce.name: Blood Wave
Pierce.effect: If attacked multiple times last turn: gain 1 Blood before Thirst.\nThirst 3: inflict -X DEF/2 (X = Blood).\nThirst 5: may become AoE/Foes/Beam 5.

Pierce.name: Piercing Jab
Pierce.effect: Per 30 damage taken since last turn: +1 dice, range upgrade (Pierce -> Beam -> Cone).

Beam.name: Haunted Swing
Beam.effect: Targets at full HP: +5 damage. Heal 5 HP per target triggered.

Beam.name: Blasphemy
Beam.effect: inflict 6 Curse/1. While Cursed: targeting an ally extends Curse 1 round.

Beam.name: Feint
Beam.effect: Targets take half of out-of-turn damage from user/1. Spend Focus: target gains Focus*2% recoil/1.

Beam.name: Sandstorm
Beam.effect: Spend 3 Mana. Targets: -25% damage on next Standard/Full. Push in Beam direction.

Beam.name: Absolution
Beam.effect: Choose a target. Inflict target's debuffs on all other targets/1. Cleanse allies in range.

Beam.name: Enchanted Blade
Beam.effect: inflict 4 Curse/1 or 4 Bleed/1. Multiple targets: both (damage does not stack).

Varies.name: Ancestral Wrath
Varies.effect:
Requires Totem within Range 5. Targets within Totem range. Effects by type:
Blood: targets cannot leave Totem range/1.
Bone: cleanse debuffs/statuses on allies, cleanse buffs on foes in range.
Soul: heal allies in range for 1/3 of damage dealt.

Varies.name: Weapon Crash
Varies.effect:
Varies by subweapon.
Gladius: 1/Foe/Melee, +3 dice faces.
Scutum: AoE/Foes/Cone 2, attacks on user immune to positive outside factors/1.
Pilum: AoE/Foes/Pierce 5, -3 MR.
Dual Wield: pick one range and one effect.

Varies.name: Yin Yang
Varies.effect: Choose Yin or Yang.\nYin: Physical/Melee. If target doesn't damage user next turn: target takes 1d8+5.\nYang: Magical/Homing 4. Foes take 1d8+5 when damaging user/1.

Every Turn.name: Duet
Every Turn.effect: Apply Duet to one player. Bard abilities also originate from that player. May end Duet. Effects stack in overlap; Bard attack targets take +1 hit.

Every Turn.name: Superposition
Every Turn.effect: Roll d20 and store (max 1). Reaction: before user accuracy check, substitute stored roll. Reaction: when foe attacks in Range 4 after accuracy, replace accuracy with stored roll (cannot cause miss).

Every Turn.name: Arrow Flurry
Every Turn.effect: If target has Mark: Splash 1. If target has 3+ Marks: Splash 2 instead.

Every Turn.name: Bolt Arsenal
Every Turn.effect:
When using single-target Standard Crossbow attack: choose one Bolt.
Bounty Bolt: target gains half the Marks of latest slain foe.
Split-Head Bolt: targets another foe, loses Splash.
Reeling Bolt: Pull target to tile in user's Line 3-6.
Each Bolt: once until refresh. Swift: refresh Bolts.

Every Turn.name: Swift Shot
Every Turn.effect: If target is at Range 7+: crit on 14+. If target is under Range 3: gain +1 MP/2.

Every Turn.name: Crippling Shot
Every Turn.effect:
Effect varies by range.
1-2: inflict Slow/1.
3+: inflict 2 Cripple/1 on accuracy 14+.
7+: inflict Cripple regardless of accuracy.

Every Turn.name: Blessed Arrow
Every Turn.effect: Allies in target's Star 2: healing and buffs x1.25/1. Foes in target's Star 2: debuffs x1.25/1. Does not stack. As non-damaging Standard: 1/Tile/Range 10.

Every Turn.name: Sniper's Focus
Every Turn.effect: This turn: Standard actions become Full. Range 7+ effects trigger at Range 4+.

Every Turn.name: Blitz
Every Turn.effect: Crit on 18+. Per hit: gain +4 damage on next attack.

Every Turn.name: Bloodrush
Every Turn.effect: If used from max range: gain +5 DMG/1 and +1 MP/1.

Every Turn.name: Bloodbind
Every Turn.effect: Twice per turn before attacking. Sacrifice any CP. Per CP: +1 DMG this turn, heal 1 HP on Standard/Full hit.

Every Turn.name: Reap
Every Turn.effect: Reaper's Touch heals 1/5 instead of 1/8 on this attack.

Every Turn.name: Whittle
Every Turn.effect: Sacrifice 10 HP: create Totem tile on target (removes existing). Range Burst 1. Type: Blood, Bone, or Soul (starts Blood). Cannot be overwritten.

Every Turn.name: Void's Call
Every Turn.effect: Pull targets towards Totem tile instead of user.

Every Turn.name: Animatus
Every Turn.effect: Non-Animated Totem on unoccupied tile: becomes Animated. Sacrifice any HP: becomes Totem's HP, gained as Shield/1. Animated Totem is allied entity, shares user's DEF. Removed when user or Totem at 0 HP.\nWith Animated Totem: move up to MP, deal 3d10 to foes in Totem range.

Every Turn.name: Exercitus
Every Turn.effect: Gladius: swap to Scutum. Scutum: Push 3, swap to Pilum. Pilum: inflict 4 Cripple/1, swap to Gladius.

Every Turn.name: Thwack
Every Turn.effect: Only Stun can prevent use. +1 dice per 5 ATK or MAG (whichever higher) target has above 20.

Every Turn.name: Disarm
Every Turn.effect: Each target's next Standard/Full on user: -1 dice

Every Turn.name: Figure 8
Every Turn.effect: Reaction: when foe willingly moves out of user's Range 2 from Melee

Every Turn.name: Feral Chop
Every Turn.effect: X = 2.5 * user's Rage.

Every Turn.name: Chain Axe
Every Turn.effect: Bloodlust grants +1 Rage per damage instance/1.

Every Turn.name: Cyclone Sweep
Every Turn.effect: +dice = number of targets hit.

Every Turn.name: Storm Strike
Every Turn.effect: Teleport to tile in target's Splash 1. inflict Slow/1.

Every Turn.name: Razor Rust
Every Turn.effect: Target: 3 MP/1. Apex: inflict 5 Cripple/1.

Every Turn.name: Coronation
Every Turn.effect: Reaction/Trigger: when reaching 0 Campaigns, or start of turn with 0. Right to Rule max +1. Gain max Campaigns.

Every Turn.name: Besiege
Every Turn.effect: Before accuracy: sacrifice up to 10 HP. Gain equal Shield/1. 1.5x if target >50% HP.

Every Turn.name: Cursed Slice
Every Turn.effect: +1 CR. Target's next Standard/Full: 5% recoil. Spend 10 Resolve up to 5x: +1 CR and +5% recoil per spend.

Every Turn.name: Lunge
Every Turn.effect: Move adjacent to target (even on miss). Spend 20 Resolve up to 3x: -1 MR per spend. After damage: choose +10% damage dealt and taken/1.

Every Turn.name: Allez
Every Turn.effect: Reaction: once between turns on attack involving user. Remove 1 dice, store Focus = half of removed dice faces.

Every Turn.name: Point-in-Line
Every Turn.effect: inflict -2 dice faces/1. If debuff not active: gain +2 dice faces/1. Spend Focus: increase one effect by half.

Every Turn.name: All for One
Every Turn.effect: Reaction: when user spends Focus. If targeting same player as previous Focus spend: gain half-value Focus.

Every Turn.name: Rototill
Every Turn.effect: Physical or Magical. If target on non-Normal tile: lose Pull 3, gain +1 ACC and +1 dice.

Every Turn.name: Bioturbation
Every Turn.effect: If non-Normal tile in Burst 1: move to same tile type within Range 8. Pass through players (cannot end farther from target). Players passed through: -7 DEF/1, -1 EVA/1.

Every Turn.name: Fireball
Every Turn.effect: Spend 2 Mana. May spend more: +1 base dice per extra Mana. If any damage dice roll 1: inflict 3 Burn/1.

Every Turn.name: Spellweave
Every Turn.effect: The user chooses any number of distinct usable Spellbook moves to "Spellweave", consuming a use of each move. Their next Spellbook attack this turn adds the base rolls and all secondary effects (including Mana costs) of the Spellwoven moves to its own.

Every Turn.name: Smite
Every Turn.effect: Before accuracy: choose a buff to channel/1. May be non-damaging Swift on self.

Every Turn.name: Card Flip
Every Turn.effect: Roll d3 after damage. 1: 0.8x damage. 3: 1.3x damage. Outside factors also affected.

Every Turn.name: Card Counter
Every Turn.effect: Once per turn: reroll Cards dice effect (Craps: reroll damage dice).

Every Turn.name: High Roller
Every Turn.effect: Per remaining Standard: roll 1d5. Targeting amount = roll - 1 (1: lost).

Every Turn.name: Moonblast
Every Turn.effect: Next Phase effect value +1.

Every Turn.name: Augur

Passive.name: Rising Hope

Passive.name: Black Magic
Passive.effect: Per 5 CP: +1 DEF. Per 7 CP: +1 ACC. Per 10 CP: +1 dice.

Passive.name: Reaper's Touch
Passive.effect: When user damages a foe: heal 1/8 of damage dealt.

Passive.name: Adaptive
Passive.effect: When user misses Standard/Full: buffs apply to next Standard/Full, which gains +2 ACC, 10% of missed damage, and ignores 5 DEF.

Passive.name: Paragon
Passive.effect: Adaptive numerical bonuses tripled. Turns: gain 5X Shield, attacks +5X% damage. X = times targeted by foes since last turn.

Passive.name: Aikido
Passive.effect: When user uses 2 attacks of same damage type in one turn: gain +2 DEF and ATK/MAG of opposite type. Resets if effect doesn't occur.

Passive.name: Bloodlust
Passive.effect: When user deals or takes 15+ damage: gain 1 Rage.

Passive.name: Vindictive
Passive.effect: Gain 2 Rage on kill or miss.

Passive.name: Swing Cycle
Passive.effect: Start of turn: spend 2 Rage to reset cooldowns/frequencies of last 2 attacks.\nChain Axe becomes EoT. Start with 1 Rage.

Passive.name: Stonemason
Passive.effect: Hammer effects ignore Ice Clause on player-created tiles.

Passive.name: Plate Crusher

Passive.name: Fleet Footwork

Passive.name: Declaration of War
Passive.effect: Gain +1.5 DEF per Campaign. Start with 0 or 4 Campaigns (choice).

Passive.name: Imperial Tyranny
Passive.effect: Foes in Star 3: -0.5 DEF and -0.5 ATK/MAG per Campaign. If 0 Campaigns: foes attacking user take 10% recoil.

Passive.name: Fallen Blade
Passive.effect: At 25%, 50%, 75% HP missing: gain 1 Enrage (once each). +1 dice per Enrage.

Passive.name: Zanshin
Passive.effect: Max 150 Resolve. When exceeding max: next attack gains +1 ACC/1, +1 CR/1. Fallen Blade: every 1/6 HP.

Passive.name: Fudoshin
Passive.effect: Zanshin's exceed bonuses doubled. Enrage dice doubled on crit.

Passive.name: All-Terrain Master
Passive.effect: Terraform: Every Turn, up to Twice place Normal/Sticky/Air instead of Water/Forest. End-of-turn tile bonus/1:\nNormal: +1 ACC. Forest: +10% DMG. Water: 5d4 heal. Air: attacks ignore Air, +1 Range. Boost: +6 CR. Sticky: +2 EVA, -1 range on incoming. Lava: +1 Standard (ignores ATK/MAG/DEF).

Passive.effect: Start of first turn: choose Phase. Start of each turn: shift Phase. Cannot be disabled.\nNew Moon: +1 Range. Waxing: +2 dice faces. Full Moon: -1 dice on attacks targeting user. Waning: +1 dice. Cycle repeats.

Passive.effect:
Passive bonuses:
Thirst 3: +1 MP.

Thirst 6: +1 base dice.
