Thrice/EoT.effect: Reaction: When foe ends turn within or enters tile's Star 1: inflict 3 Cripple/1 and -4 DMG/1, then remove.

Thrice/EoT.name: Handle Bash
Thrice/EoT.effect: Pull 1 or Push 1. Teleport to Beam 2 in attack direction (Push) or opposite (Pull). Next turn: target's actions cost 1 MP.

Once.name: Staccato
Once.effect: Reaction: When a foe attacks user or Duet ally (after damage). Hits target and foes in Star 2 of user and Duet ally. inflict -2 DEF/1 and -1 EVA/1 per hit. If attacker kills Duet ally: gain permanent +2 MP, +2 ACC, +2 CR. Ignores outside damage factors.

Once.name: Tinker's Dam
Once.effect: Create Stone wall on target and Line 2 in chosen direction. Removed after 2 rounds, or Free action on user's turn. Foes ending turn with Stone in Melee: take 5 damage and inflict 3 Burn/1. Stone acts like Ice, 30 HP to break, 1 EVA.

Once.name: Mending Mantel
Once.effect: Place Hearth tile. When user or allies end turn in its Star 3: gain +5 DEF/1 and heal 5 HP. Hearth acts like Stone. Removed when user dies.

Once.name: Emboîté
Once.effect: Targets' abilities on cooldown: use 1 round earlier (E3T->EoT, EoT->Every Turn).

Once.name: Fouetté
Once.effect: Until next turn: target may use one Once/Twice/Thrice move without expending a use. Cannot target Reactions or Triggers.

Once.name: Divertissement
Once.effect: Target's next Standard/Full attack next turn: gain +dice faces equal to actions used that turn (max +5). Unaffected by En Pointe.

Once.name: Nirvana
Once.effect: Spend any Qi. Next attack: gain +1 dice and +2 DMG per Qi spent.

Once.name: Oathkeeper
Once.effect: User and target gain Oath of Mercy. Start of turn: heal 2 HP and gain +1 ATK/MAG (max +5). Ends on death. Does not stack.

Once.name: Time's Edge
Once.effect: This turn: gain +1 Standard (MR -3). Next 2 Standard/Full: 25% ATK/MAG. If first deals damage, second ignores outside damage factors and ATK/MAG/DEF. Only Reactions and Triggers between these actions.

Once.name: Wormhole
Once.effect: Place Wormhole on target tile. Swift: user or ally spends half MP (rounded up) to teleport to Wormhole. Expires on use or after 2 rounds.

Once.name: Explosive Shot
Once.effect: The target holds a "Bomb". If a foe with a Bomb targets another foe (including their allies) they transfer the Bomb to one of their targets.\nAfter one round or when the holder dies, the Bomb detonates and deals Xd4 Bomb damage to foes in the Bomb's Burst 1. X = the foe who held the Bomb with the most Marks.

Once.name: Shadow Quiver
Once.effect: Next Standard attack becomes Magical, treats non-player obstructions as Air, ignores non-targets. Loses 2 damage per Air tile passed through.

Once.name: Final Hour
Once.effect: Next attack: Hunter's Mark gains +4 dice faces.

Once.name: Quiver of Thunder
Once.effect: Foes: can only target entities in their Line 8/1. If attack user in Melee: gain +1 Mark.

Once.name: Fireworks
Once.effect: If target at Range 7+: Bomb dice. If target under Range 3: Bound Bow becomes +5 DEF/1 and +1 MP/1 until user attacks at Range 3+.

Once.name: Arrow Storm
Once.effect: Crit on 18+.

Once.name: Sanctified Blade
Once.effect: Next single-target attack: CP sacrifice +10%. If foe targeted user since last turn: +5%.

Once.name: Massacre
Once.effect: If kill: gain 2x CP and +1 use of Massacre. If not: no CP sacrifice.

Once.name: Covenant
Once.effect: Target shares user's Black Magic buffs and gains CP passive/1. CP gained by target applies to user instead.

Once.name: Exsanguinate
Once.effect: If CP from this move grants Black Magic bonus: +1 to that bonus.

Once.name: Oblation
Once.effect: Next attack this turn: double damage from CP.

Once.name: Phantasmal Shield
Once.effect: Target heals 15% of damage taken/1. Per Standard/Full hit on target: -5% (min 0%).

Once.name: Phantom Blade
Once.effect: Reaper's Touch heal on this attack = HP healed from Scythe abilities (except Phantom Blade) last round.

Once.name: Effigial Pyre
Once.effect: Destroy Totem: inflict 13 Burn/1 on foes in tile's Burst 1. Current Totem type loses effects for game. Totem range becomes Burst 2.

Once.name: Ancestral Wrath
Once.effect:
Requires Totem within Range 5. Targets within Totem range. Effects by type:
Blood: targets cannot leave Totem range/1.
Bone: cleanse debuffs/statuses on allies, cleanse buffs on foes in range.
Soul: heal allies in range for 1/3 of damage dealt.

Once.name: Deus Vult
Once.effect: Requires Scutum. Before accuracy: immune to statuses and debuffs/1, remove existing.

Once.name: Weapon Crash
Once.effect:
Varies by subweapon.
Gladius: 1/Foe/Melee, +3 dice faces.
Scutum: AoE/Foes/Cone 2, attacks on user immune to positive outside factors/1.
Pilum: AoE/Foes/Pierce 5, -3 MR.
Dual Wield: pick one range and one effect.

Once.name: Calamitous Trance
Once.effect: If target dealt 50+ to user last round: +3 dice. If 75+: +4 dice faces. -1 MR per hit on user since last turn. Confusion/2 when MR < 4.

Once.name: Gale Force
Once.effect: Regardless of accuracy: teleport any targets to any unoccupied tiles in range. Not an attack on Allies or when Movement.

Once.name: Amped Strike
Once.effect: +damage = 4 * user's Rage. Lose all Rage.

Once.name: Collision Course
Once.effect: Original target: Push to tile in their Range 5. Subsequent: Push to tile in their Range 3. Can Push user/allies via Unstoppable Force (no damage). Each target once.

Once.name: Fissure
Once.effect: Regardless of hit: push target. Tiles target exits while pushed become permanent Broken (unremovable, unignorable). Foes entering Burst 1 of Broken: 2d8 damage, once/turn per foe. User may remove any as Trigger on their turns.

Once.name: Supreme Strikes
Once.effect: 1 Push per hit. May target in two directions, or +1 hit in one direction. Each direction: accuracy and Apex independently. Apex: +2 hits in this direction.

Once.name: Last Stand
Once.effect: When user would take >55-3X damage (X = Campaign max): attacker takes 3d8+2, damage reduced by 3X/1.

Once.name: Bushido
Once.effect: Choose up to 2 allies. Gain Resolve = 50% of damage they took from attacks that didn't target user/1.

Once.name: Rising Sun
Once.effect: Spend up to 100 Resolve: gain X% of damage as Shield/1 (X = Resolve/1.5). If first ability this turn: turn continues until another non-Standard/Full. While Shield active: healing doesn't reduce Resolve.

Once.name: Giant Slayer
Once.effect: If the user has less HP than the target, they may spend up to X Resolve, where X is the difference between the user's and target's HP. For every 10 Resolve spent, gain +2+Y damage, where Y is current Enrage.

Once.name: Parry
Once.effect: Reaction: on attack involving user (no Rapier reaction since last turn). Attack loses all damage and dice buffs. Store Focus = removed buff's value.

Once.name: Redoublement
Once.effect: Spend any Focus: +1 hit per Focus. Each Focus hit: +CR equal to Focus value.

Once.name: One for All
Once.effect: Ignores 1/4 DEF. May change splash: Star 2 (1/2 DEF) or Line 2 (3/4 DEF). Per target: gain Focus = DEF ignored.

Once.name: Scorched Earth
Once.effect: Before Push: tiles in target's Star 1 become Lava. Counts as user damage. Once per turn per entity.

Once.name: The Serenity of Nature
Once.effect: If attacked or attacked: sacrifice 50-100 HP and max HP. Summon Nature Spirit in Melee (acts after user). Win requires both defeated. Disabled after use.\nNature Spirit: 125% sacrificed HP | 17 ATK/MAG | 5 DEF | 1 EVA | 4 MP. Moves: Basic Abilities, Terraform (1 tile), Rototill, Bioturbation, Wildfire, Bloom, Flower Crown.

Once.name: Maelstrom
Once.effect: Spend 6 Mana. Choose 2 effects: +5 damage, +2 ACC, +5 DEF/1 on hit, or +3 MP/2 on hit.

Once.name: Resonate
Once.effect: Restores a use after Standard/Full Talisman ability. Gain one buff: +3 DMG, +3 PDEF, +3 MDEF, or +1 ACC.

Once.name: Sanctuary
Once.effect: Next channeling: +1 round.

Once.name: Echo of Light
Once.effect: Next turn: channeled buffs doubled.

Once.name: Judgment
Once.effect: inflict Evil Eye permanently.\nEvil Eye: debuffs on player last +1 round. Start of turn: take d4+2 per debuff. Talisman heals equal damage dealt.

Once.name: Slots Spin
Once.effect: Roll 3d4. Per 4: +1 dice. No 4s: -1 dice. All 4s: +1 more dice.

Once.name: Stacked Deck
Once.effect:
In place of an accuracy roll, roll a 1d14 for an effect. 
1. The opponent is healed by the roll, 
2. The user takes 2x damage from all sources for one round,
3. The attack misses, 
4. After damage, the user and target swap their current HP (can overheal, foes with over 200 HP are considered to have 200 HP for this effect), 
5. For one round, attacks automatically hit the user,
6. The user and target gain a random position change,
7. The user and target are both Stunned/1,
8. 50% of this attack's damage is dealt to a random foe instead,
9. For one round, the user's attacks automatically hit,
10. The user gains a 1/Any/Global Once/Reaction: "Reroll one accuracy roll.",
11. Cleanse all statuses and numerical debuffs from the user & reset their other moves' frequencies,
12. Target is Sealed/1, 
13. Next turn, the user may choose numbers for their cards effects, rather than rolling dice for them,
14. This attack has unremovable thrice base dice.

Once.name: Gravity Crash
Once.effect:
Effect varies by Phase.
New Moon: Homing 4, target cannot use limited moves/1.
Waxing: Push 1d6, inflict 4 Cripple/2.
Full Moon: foes deal 75% to allies in Range 5/1.
Waning: Bomb dice.

Once.name: Fatal Moonlight
Once.effect:
Two effects if user has 2 Phases.
New Moon: Seal/1 on max range target.
Waxing: permanent +2d6 DEF.
Full Moon: +2 targets.
Waning: ignores negative damage factors.

Once.name: Foresight
Once.effect: Reaction: when user attacked, after damage rolled. Remove 10% damage. Add to: 1) delayed attacks, or 2) user's HP x number of delayed attacks.

Once.name: Fateweave
Once.effect: Choose Delay 1-5. Per foe dying on landing turn: permanent +2 ACC, +4 CR. After lands: delays <= 2 land immediately on user death. Disabled after hit. Ignores ATK/MAG and outside factors. Gains use on miss.

Once.name: Shady Bet
Once.effect: If gaining Coin from this attack: gain Trick Coin instead (choose Swindler effect). May spend Coin to gain Trick Coin (ignores Scoundrel).

Once.name: Swashbuckler
Once.effect: Choose Cruel, Sly, or Daring. Cruel: +1 dice. Sly: before accuracy, end target's duration buffs/debuffs. Daring: 10 Shield/1.

Once.name: Indulge
Once.effect: Ignores target DEF.\nThirst 7: on hit, lose half Blood (round up), heal 30% damage, cannot gain Blood until next turn.\nThirst 10: no effects.

Once.name: Night Visitor
Once.effect: Requires foe damaged this game not in melee. Before accuracy: teleport to melee of target.\nThirst 5: hits foes in Star 1 after teleport, inflict Slow/1.\nThirst 9: usable in melee, Star 2, lose 1 Blood +1 per hit.

Once.name: Sky Turns Red
Once.effect: The user's next 2 Fangs attacks on foes cannot cause the user to lose Blood and gain "Thirst X: This move ignores X DEF, and heals equal to 5 * X% of the damage dealt to one target." (X is equal to the user's Blood).\nThis effect ends if the user reaches 10 Blood, if they use Indulge (before accuracy), or if they use a Free action to end it early.

Once.name: Sanguine Explosion
Once.effect: Reaction: when reaching 10 Blood. inflict Slow/1. Also usable without use on foe death: originates from foe, Burst 2, loses Push.

E3T.name: Smokescreen
E3T.effect: Until next turn: attacks entering Burst 2 have -2 Range, -7 DMG. Attacks used within Burst 2 have -2 Range.

E3T.name: Reforge
E3T.effect: Choose one base stat (except HP). Foe: reduce by 1/3/1, cannot receive buffs to that stat. Ally: multiply by 1.5/1.

E3T.name: Ward
E3T.effect: Cannot be inflicted with debuffs or statuses/1.

E3T.name: Martyrdom
E3T.effect: Gain +15% healing/1. Healed targets gain +1 EVA and +1 MP/1 (max +3). Per dead ally: +15% healing.

E3T.name: Pas de Deux
E3T.effect: Target takes turn immediately after user. Target cannot use Pas de Deux that turn. If Standard: target loses Movement. Juggernaut target: only 1 Standard.

E3T.name: Pavise
E3T.effect: Until next turn: when user or ally in Burst 2 hit by attack, damaged players gain +3 DEF/1 per damaged player.

E3T.name: Impasse
E3T.effect: Choose: ally/self, or foe. Ally/self: cannot be inflicted with Push/Pull or stat reduction by foes/1. Foe: remove target's buffs.

E3T.name: Arrow Net
E3T.effect: Before damage: target takes 3 damage each time they gain a Mark from user/1.

E3T.name: Dispell Bow
E3T.effect: This turn: +2 MP, ranged attacks Range becomes 3. Next turn: +1 MP, ranged attacks Range becomes 6.

E3T.name: Hook Shot
E3T.effect: If +2 CR: Pull user within Range 2 of target, or target within Range 2 of user. Not an attack on Allies.

E3T.name: Purloin Youth
E3T.effect: Attacks targeting user: 10% recoil/1. User sacrifices half recoil to CP.

E3T.name: Pentagram
E3T.effect: Start of next turn: foes in user's Burst 1 take 2d6+3 + user's CP damage.

E3T.name: Coup de Grâce
E3T.effect: If kill: heal 10 HP, gain +5 damage to next attack.

E3T.name: Blasphemy
E3T.effect: inflict 6 Curse/1. While Cursed: targeting an ally extends Curse 1 round.

E3T.name: Dual Wield
E3T.effect: Before moving: MP halved

E3T.name: Grave of Titans
E3T.effect: Ignores DEF. Per 10 max HP target has above 120: +3 DMG, -1 MR. If damage reduced by foes: next Standard/Full gains +1 ACC/1, +1 CR/1, and +1 dice.

E3T.name: Stance Breaker
E3T.effect: If target gained >5 DEF, HP or Shield last round: advantage dice. gain 75% of highest as Shield/1.

E3T.name: Yin Yang
E3T.effect: Choose Yin or Yang.\nYin: Physical/Melee. If target doesn't damage user next turn: target takes 1d8+5.\nYang: Magical/Homing 4. Foes take 1d8+5 when damaging user/1.

E3T.name: Dazing Hook
E3T.effect: Range cannot be reduced. If target attacked user outside Melee last round: inflict Confusion/1 and Inverse Bomb dice/1.

E3T.name: Gash
E3T.effect: Spend Rage: inflict 5 Bleed/X (X = Rage spent).

E3T.name: Earth Render
E3T.effect: After damage or miss: replace up to 2 unoccupied tiles in Burst 2 of target with Broken (2 rounds, or until user dies/removes as Trigger).

E3T.name: Lagging Spin
E3T.effect: Ignores 4 DEF per MP spent moving away from start tile. If all MP spent moving away: +2 dice.

E3T.name: Gravity Well
E3T.effect: Next attack this turn: before accuracy, choose non-Splash target. Pull another entity in target's Burst 2 to tile in target's Burst 1.

E3T.name: Discipline
E3T.effect: Start of target's next turn: gain +3X DEF/1 (X = 3 - range used). Apex: if last attack had Apex, next attack applies that Apex effects (excluding extra hits).

E3T.name: Kinetic Impact
E3T.effect: If target cannot be moved full distance: +1 dice. Apex: -2 Push, +2 dice faces.

E3T.name: Entrench
E3T.effect: If less than 6 bonus DEF: gain +3 DEF/1. Lose +1 Campaign per RtR instance/1.

E3T.name: War of Attrition
E3T.effect: Before damage: inflict inverse of user's active RtR bonuses/1.

E3T.name: Kensei
E3T.effect: Start of next turn: gain Resolve = X% of Resolve gained since use. X = 150 - user's max HP (max 20%).

E3T.name: Counter
E3T.effect: Reaction/Standard: when foe deals 40+ to user. Ignores ATK/MAG/DEF and non-Rapier outside factors. Active Rapier effects +1 round. Next spent Focus x1.5.

E3T.name: Feint
E3T.effect: Targets take half of out-of-turn damage from user/1. Spend Focus: target gains Focus*2% recoil/1.

E3T.name: Blackthorn
E3T.effect: Physical or Magical. Before damage: targets invert positive tile effects/1. +4 dice on secondary targets.

E3T.name: Bloom
E3T.effect: Normal tiles grant +1 ACC to user and allies/1. If last Standard was Physical: +4 MAG. If Magical: +4 ATK.

E3T.name: Plague
E3T.effect: Spend 3 Mana. Choose Bleed, Burn, Curse, or Poison. inflict 3 [status]/1. Spend +1 Mana: /2.

E3T.name: Scourge
E3T.effect: Spend 4 Mana. Choose one non-Basic, non-Lv 1, non-EX move per target. Targets cannot use selected moves/1.

E3T.name: Compass
E3T.effect: Gain +2 ACC. If miss while channeled: gain +3 CR.

E3T.name: Lunar Shift
E3T.effect: Shift to next Phase. If Moonblast active: transfer to new Phase.

E3T.name: Scallywag Slice
E3T.effect: Choose Outwit or Befuddle. Outwit: +1 CR, target's CR = 1 on first hit of next Standard. Befuddle: target ignores positive tile effects/1.

E3T.name: Captain's Order
E3T.effect: Target chooses Plank or Marooning. Plank: Push 2, 4 damage per ongoing Cutlass effect on target. Marooning: target's next Standard: 25% recoil.

E3T.name: Silk Cocoon
E3T.effect: Create Silk Cocoon (Star tile) on unoccupied tile. Replaces existing. Acts like Ice (25 HP). User deals max 15 damage to it. Scissors effects ignore its Ice Clause. Tiles in Burst 1: +1 MP to enter. Does not stack. Range cannot be increased.

E3T.name: Debilitate
E3T.effect: Ignores 4 DEF, +4 per Ramping Magic proc. If ignores all target MDEF: triggers Ramping Magic.

E3T.name: Piercing Jab
E3T.effect: Per 30 damage taken since last turn: +1 dice, range upgrade (Pierce -> Beam -> Cone).

E3T.name: Weaver's Whirl
E3T.effect: gain 2d8 Shield/1. When Shield breaks: foes in Star 1: inflict -2 MP/1 (max -4).

Twice.name: Vestments
Twice.effect: Choose primary and secondary target (may be same)./1: primary heals 1/4 of damage secondary takes. Self as primary costs 2 uses. Max 1 Vestments per primary.

Twice.name: Conversion
Twice.effect: Spend 1-3 Qi. This turn: attacks become opposite damage type, swap ATK and MAG. Per Qi spent: ignore 5 DEF and gain +1 Range.

Twice.name: Radiance
Twice.effect: Until next turn: user takes 80% damage from attacks. Aegis redirects 50%.

Twice.name: Sagittarian Pride
Twice.effect: Hits = number of moves targets used since user's last turn.

Twice.name: Heredity
Twice.effect: Totem moves adjacent to target. Heal HP sacrificed to create it. If no Totem: place one on target's tile.

Twice.name: Two Handed
Twice.effect: If user didn't push target last turn: +2 Push. Apex: if target can't be moved full distance: inflict 7 Bleed/1.

Twice.name: Patinando
Twice.effect: Per dice 4+: +1 Push. Per dice <4: inflict 3 Cripple/1 (stacking). After damage: spend Focus to replace dice with its value.

Twice.name: Transcendence
Twice.effect: Before accuracy: convert +ACC to +CR, +DMG to +PDEF or +MDEF (and vice versa). Converted buffs channeled/1.

Twice.name: Double Tide
Twice.effect: Crit on 16+. If at least 1 crit: gain Moonblast effect.

Twice.name: Astral Touch
Twice.effect: If target kills user within 1 round: reduce delays on them by 1. If target dies within 1 round: transfer one delay to new target in original's Range 7.

Twice.name: Buy Time
Twice.effect: Spend 1 Coin: next Cutlass attack effect +1 round.

Twice.name: Uninvited Guest
Twice.effect: If first attack on target: gain 2 Blood.\nIf one attacked other last turn but not reciprocated: +8 CR.

Twice/EoT.name: Soulstep
Twice/EoT.effect: Move up to MP. Targeting before or after movement. Ignores outside damage factors, DEF, and ATK/MAG.

Twice/EoT.name: Warp
Twice/EoT.effect: Teleport to tile in Range 4. Inflict -5 DEF/1 on foes in tile's Burst 1. This turn: attacks pass through players.

Twice/EoT.name: Fractal Division
Twice/EoT.effect: This turn: next single-target attack targets 2 foes in Range 4. Loses Splash. User picks target for secondary effects.

Twice/EoT.name: Bolt Compaction
Twice/EoT.effect: This turn: Standard Crossbow attacks lose secondary effects. Next turn: first Standard attack gains +1 dice and the negated effects.

Twice/EoT.name: Quick Scope
Twice/EoT.effect: Ignores ATK/MAG, half DEF, and outside damage factors (except Hunter's Mark).

Twice/EoT.name: Tornado Bolt
Twice/EoT.effect: Push X (X = 1 + Marks on target). If target cannot be pushed full distance: gain +1 Mark.

Twice/EoT.name: Arcane Shot
Twice/EoT.effect: If target under Range 3: Push 3. If target at Range 7+: ignores up to 10 DEF.

Twice/EoT.name: Chase Arrow
Twice/EoT.effect: Targets within 8 tiles. May target foes on path to original target (path cannot exceed range). Damage to path foes: ignores ATK/MAG and DEF.

Twice/EoT.name: Volley
Twice/EoT.effect: If target is 7+ tiles away: +1 hit. If foes in Splash 1 of target: +2 hits. Bonus hits target random foes in Splash 1 (including original). Each: half target DEF, ignores ATK/MAG.

Twice/EoT.name: Trick Shot
Twice/EoT.effect: If +ACC: Splash 1. If +4+ ACC: becomes Magical, Splash 2.

Twice/EoT.name: Venom Shot
Twice/EoT.effect: Non-Hawkeye +ACC treated as +CR. inflict Poison/1 (X = 2 * +CR). If 12+: halve poison, extend 1 round.

Twice/EoT.name: Siphon Soul
Twice/EoT.effect: Before accuracy: heal HP equal to CP.

Twice/EoT.name: Memento Mori
Twice/EoT.effect: Delay-1. May delay up to +2 more turns. Per extra delay: Reaper's Touch heals +1/8 of damage.

Twice/EoT.name: Phalanx
Twice/EoT.effect: Requires Scutum. Reaction: when foe hits user or ally in user's melee. If target in melee: +1 dice, swap to Gladius. If not: swap to Pilum. Ignores outside factors, ATK/MAG, half DEF.

Twice/EoT.name: Shield Wall
Twice/EoT.effect: Requires Gladius or Pilum. Switch to Scutum. Flat modifier on base rolls targeting user becomes negative/1. May be non-damaging Standard.

Twice/EoT.name: Pole Vault
Twice/EoT.effect: Teleport to unoccupied tile in range (ignores range reduction, even on miss). Targets foes in Splash. If no foes: not an attack.

Twice/EoT.name: Hardwood Slam
Twice/EoT.effect:
Choose status if condition met. -2 MR (Poison), +2 dice (Confusion), or heal 5 HP (Bleed).
5 Poison/2: if user ACC negative or target EVA increased.
Confusion/2: if target's ACC caused them to hit or trigger effect on user/allies.
6 Bleed/2: if target crit or had +dice on attack on user/allies.

Twice/EoT.name: Exploit Feign
Twice/EoT.effect: inflict -4 DEF/1 or -4 DMG/1. If user debuffed by foe: cleanse before accuracy, +1 hit, debuff doubled.

Twice/EoT.name: Martial Mastery
Twice/EoT.effect: Move up to MP+1, all tiles except final treated as Normal. This turn: attacks ignore obstructions and DEF, invert foe's negative outside damage factors.

Twice/EoT.name: Reversal
Twice/EoT.effect: If target can end turn on different tile type but doesn't: gain +2 ACC/1, next attack ignores half DEF.

Twice/EoT.name: Standoff
Twice/EoT.effect: If target ends next turn in user's Melee: user may AoO (ignores ATK/MAG).

Twice/EoT.name: Hold Over
Twice/EoT.effect: Declare range type. If foes target user with attacks of that range type outside Melee: user may AoO/1.

Twice/EoT.name: Bloodspill
Twice/EoT.effect: Spend 40 Resolve: Burst 1 or Cone 2. Spend 70: Burst 2 or Cone 3. Per kill: no use consumed, +1 Enrage, advantage threshold -20.

Twice/EoT.name: Cryosphere
Twice/EoT.effect: Replace up to 3 Water/Stop/Stone tiles in Pierce 5 or Burst 1 with Ice/2. Foes ending turn in melee of Ice: 15 damage. Replaced Stops cannot be fully surrounded.

Twice/EoT.name: Hydrolysis
Twice/EoT.effect: +2 dice faces per foe on Water or Lava.

Twice/EoT.name: Wildfire
Twice/EoT.effect: If target on Forest: set Wildfire on that tile and adjacent Forest tiles.\nWildfire: lasts 2 rounds. Start of turn on Wildfire: 3d4 damage, -7 damage on next Standard/Full.

Twice/EoT.name: Nature's Madness
Twice/EoT.effect: Immune to Air tiles. Augmented by X = number of certain tile types in Burst 1. After damage: convert used tiles to Normal.\nAir/Sticky/Boost: +X Range and damage (max 3). If X>1: +1 target.\nForest/Water/Lava/Ice: choose type, inflict X status/1. If X>3: extend 1 round.

Twice/EoT.name: Flower Crown
Twice/EoT.effect: Forest: +10% DMG/1. Water: heal 5d4 HP. Standard: doubles to 20% and 10d4. Cannot target players on neither.

Twice/EoT.name: Divine Merit
Twice/EoT.effect: Target gains +2d4+1 damage on next attack. If on self: channel DMG next turn. Cannot target same target twice.

Twice/EoT.name: Seal of Solomon
Twice/EoT.effect: Choose a channeled buff: invert and apply as debuff/1. inflict Confusion/1.

Twice/EoT.name: Gamble
Twice/EoT.effect: Roll d7. 1: subtract target ATK and MAG. 2: subtract target's higher offense. 3: subtract user ATK. 4: add user ATK. 5: add target's higher offense. 6: add user MAG again. 7: add user ATK and target ATK/MAG. Adds user MAG

Twice/EoT.name: Double or Nothing
Twice/EoT.effect: Roll d2. 1: target cannot use Swift/Free until end of user's next turn. 2: target gains +1 Swift (or multiple Free) until user's next turn. Self: must use at start of turn.

Twice/EoT.name: Blackjack
Twice/EoT.effect: On a successful hit, roll 2d10, treating 1s as either 1 or 11 (user's choice). The user may choose to roll additional 1d10s to add to the roll. If the total is 17-20, this attack gains 1 base dice. On a total of 21, this attack instead gains 3 base dice and activates Jackpot. On a total of 22 or higher, the attack instead loses 2 base dice.

Twice/EoT.name: Hi-Lo
Twice/EoT.effect: Roll d10. Predict higher or lower, then roll again. Correct: +2 base dice, continue (max 5). Wrong: stop, lose half base dice. Same roll: reroll.

Twice/EoT.name: Harvest Moon
Twice/EoT.effect: New/Full Moon: heal 1d10+2. Otherwise: no Phase shift next turn. May be non-attack Standard.

Twice/EoT.name: Celestial Blessing
Twice/EoT.effect: Until next turn: targets gain user's next Phase effect. User's Phase disabled next turn.

Twice/EoT.name: Corruption
Twice/EoT.effect: On hit: target takes 5% of max HP over 100 damage. Up to Delay-2: +5*Delay%. Until lands: damaging statuses deal bonus = half on-hit damage.

Twice/EoT.name: Boot Pin
Twice/EoT.effect: Choose: inflict 6 Poison/2 or 6 Cripple/2. Start of turn: gain +3 DMG/1 per 6 damage from these statuses. Target may remove one status as Swift.

Twice/EoT.name: Blood Wave
Twice/EoT.effect: If attacked multiple times last turn: gain 1 Blood before Thirst.\nThirst 3: inflict -X DEF/2 (X = Blood).\nThirst 5: may become AoE/Foes/Beam 5.

Thrice.name: Guard
Thrice.effect: Next Tonfa move: replace instances of the user with this target.

Twice / E3T.name: Repulse Slice
Twice / E3T.effect: No Push on Apex. Apex: per tile target moves toward user next turn: Plate Crusher values +1.

Twice / E3T.name: Elastic Collision
Twice / E3T.effect: Before targeting: move up to MP in straight line (half diagonals). X = 1 + tiles moved. Apex: +2 CR.

Twice / E3T.name: The Art of War
Twice / E3T.effect: Choose War or Peace.\nWar: Physical. If 0 Campaigns: +dice faces = 1.5x Campaign max.\nPeace: Magical. Until next Standard/Full: target has -X/3 MP, -2X ATK/MAG (X = user's Campaigns).

Twice / E3T.name: Moulinet
Twice / E3T.effect: Target gains +4 DMG/1 or +4 DEF/1. Spend Focus: heal 3 HP per ability target uses next turn. If no Focus spent: next Focus gains half-value Focus.

Twice / EoT.name: Continental Crash
Twice / EoT.effect: After Push: place Broken tile in target's Melee (3 rounds). User may remove as Trigger. Foes ending turn in tile's Melee: 10 damage. Apex: hits foes in target's Splash 1.

Twice / EoT.name: Shock and Awe
Twice / EoT.effect: If 3+ Campaigns: attacks on user immune to positive outside factors/1.

Thrice / E3T.name: Ambush
Thrice / E3T.effect: Lose all Campaigns. Coronation disabled until next turn. Per Campaign lost: gain +0.5 MP/1

Thrice / EoT.name: En Garde
Thrice / EoT.effect: Spend up to 2 Focus. Per Focus: target gains HP or +DEF/1 equal to its value. May move 2 tiles after next reaction.

Ally.name: Duet
Ally.effect: Apply Duet to one player. Bard abilities also originate from that player. May end Duet. Effects stack in overlap; Bard attack targets take +1 hit.

Ally.name: Pas de Deux
Ally.effect: Target takes turn immediately after user. Target cannot use Pas de Deux that turn. If Standard: target loses Movement. Juggernaut target: only 1 Standard.

Ally.name: Aegis
Ally.effect: Reaction: When ally in Homing 4 damaged by attack. Move adjacent to ally. Redirect 25% of attack damage to user. User not considered target if not already.

Ally.name: Oathkeeper
Ally.effect: User and target gain Oath of Mercy. Start of turn: heal 2 HP and gain +1 ATK/MAG (max +5). Ends on death. Does not stack.

Ally.name: Covenant
Ally.effect: Target shares user's Black Magic buffs and gains CP passive/1. CP gained by target applies to user instead.

Ally.name: Guard
Ally.effect: Next Tonfa move: replace instances of the user with this target.

Ally.name: Bushido
Ally.effect: Choose up to 2 allies. Gain Resolve = 50% of damage they took from attacks that didn't target user/1.

Ally.name: Tornado
Ally.effect: Spend 1 Mana. Move up to half MP (round down) and swap with target via teleport. Cannot move after.

Self and Allies.name: Rising Hope
Self and Allies.effect: gain +1 ACC/1 and +1 CR/1. Max 2 Rising Hopes affecting a player.

Self and Allies.name: Primadonna
Self and Allies.effect: If origin has more MAG: gain +4 MAG/1 and -3 MDEF/1. If not: gain +4 ATK/1 and -3 MDEF/1. Targets with both ATK and MAG buffed also gain +1 dice/1, doubled on crit.

Self and Allies.name: Ward
Self and Allies.effect: Cannot be inflicted with debuffs or statuses/1.

Self and Allies.name: Emboîté
Self and Allies.effect: Targets' abilities on cooldown: use 1 round earlier (E3T->EoT, EoT->Every Turn).

Self and Allies.name: Invigorate
Self and Allies.effect: Bonus varies by subweapon.\nGladius: +5 DMG/1. Scutum: 7 Shield/1. Pilum: +1 ACC/1 and +1 CR/1.

Self and Allies.name: En Garde
Self and Allies.effect: Spend up to 2 Focus. Per Focus: target gains HP or +DEF/1 equal to its value. May move 2 tiles after next reaction.

Self and Allies.name: Flower Crown
Self and Allies.effect: Forest: +10% DMG/1. Water: heal 5d4 HP. Standard: doubles to 20% and 10d4. Cannot target players on neither.

Self and Allies.name: Celestial Blessing
Self and Allies.effect: Until next turn: targets gain user's next Phase effect. User's Phase disabled next turn.

foes.name: Dissonance
foes.effect: inflict 3 Bleed/1. Ignores ATK/MAG, half DEF, and outside damage factors. If target hit twice, +3 DMG/1.

foes.name: Pierce
foes.effect: If target has 1+ Marks: ignores EVA and 1/4 DEF. If 2+ Marks: also ignores negative ACC modifiers and ignores 1/2 DEF.

foes.name: Quiver of Thunder
foes.effect: Foes: can only target entities in their Line 8/1. If attack user in Melee: gain +1 Mark.

foes.name: Sagittarian Pride
foes.effect: Hits = number of moves targets used since user's last turn.

foes.name: Overdraw
foes.effect: Next attack gains one bonus:\nIf single-hit: non-duration numbers doubled (including X).\nIf multi-hit: +ACC treated as +dice faces on accuracy rolls.

foes.name: Defile
foes.effect: inflict 3 Curse/1. When foe takes Curse damage: user takes equal CP.

foes.name: Pentagram
foes.effect: Start of next turn: foes in user's Burst 1 take 2d6+3 + user's CP damage.

foes.name: Haunted Swing
foes.effect: Targets at full HP: +5 damage. Heal 5 HP per target triggered.

foes.name: Wither Soul
foes.effect: Per debuff or status on target: Reaper's Touch heals +3 HP.

foes.name: Void's Call
foes.effect: Pull targets towards Totem tile instead of user.

foes.name: Blasphemy
foes.effect: inflict 6 Curse/1. While Cursed: targeting an ally extends Curse 1 round.

foes.name: Sacrificial Lamb
foes.effect: Before accuracy: players in Totem range sacrifice 5 HP. Per sacrifice: +1 target, +1 base dice, -1 MR.

foes.name: Ancestral Wrath
foes.effect:
Requires Totem within Range 5. Targets within Totem range. Effects by type:
Blood: targets cannot leave Totem range/1.
Bone: cleanse debuffs/statuses on allies, cleanse buffs on foes in range.
Soul: heal allies in range for 1/3 of damage dealt.

foes.name: Shield Wall
foes.effect: Requires Gladius or Pilum. Switch to Scutum. Flat modifier on base rolls targeting user becomes negative/1. May be non-damaging Standard.

foes.name: Impede
foes.effect: Pilum: steal targets' buffs (duration 1). Switch to Scutum.\nScutum: becomes AoE/Foes/Beam 4. Switch to Gladius.\nGladius: gain +1 MP/1, reduce other cooldowns 1 round. Switch to Pilum.

foes.name: Disarm
foes.effect: Each target's next Standard/Full on user: -1 dice

foes.name: Wide Slash
foes.effect: Up to 2x: spend 2 Rage for +1 range.

foes.name: Cyclone Sweep
foes.effect: +dice = number of targets hit.

foes.name: Lagging Spin
foes.effect: Ignores 4 DEF per MP spent moving away from start tile. If all MP spent moving away: +2 dice.

foes.name: Razor Rust
foes.effect: Target: 3 MP/1. Apex: inflict 5 Cripple/1.

foes.name: Supreme Strikes
foes.effect: 1 Push per hit. May target in two directions, or +1 hit in one direction. Each direction: accuracy and Apex independently. Apex: +2 hits in this direction.

foes.name: Bastion
foes.effect: Foe attacks entering user's Cone 1: lose 2 dice/1. While in Melee of current tile: +4 DEF.

foes.name: Ambush
foes.effect: Lose all Campaigns. Coronation disabled until next turn. Per Campaign lost: gain +0.5 MP/1

foes.name: War of Attrition
foes.effect: Before damage: inflict inverse of user's active RtR bonuses/1.

foes.name: Shock and Awe
foes.effect: If 3+ Campaigns: attacks on user immune to positive outside factors/1.

foes.name: Bloodspill
foes.effect: Spend 40 Resolve: Burst 1 or Cone 2. Spend 70: Burst 2 or Cone 3. Per kill: no use consumed, +1 Enrage, advantage threshold -20.

foes.name: Point-in-Line
foes.effect: inflict -2 dice faces/1. If debuff not active: gain +2 dice faces/1. Spend Focus: increase one effect by half.

foes.name: Feint
foes.effect: Targets take half of out-of-turn damage from user/1. Spend Focus: target gains Focus*2% recoil/1.

foes.name: Patinando
foes.effect: Per dice 4+: +1 Push. Per dice <4: inflict 3 Cripple/1 (stacking). After damage: spend Focus to replace dice with its value.

foes.name: Hydrolysis
foes.effect: +2 dice faces per foe on Water or Lava.

foes.name: Windstorm
foes.effect: Push targets in cone direction. Place 4 Air, 4 Sticky, or 1 Boost tile(s) in range. Existing Windstorm tiles become Normal. May be non-damaging Standard on tiles.

foes.name: Sandstorm
foes.effect: Spend 3 Mana. Targets: -25% damage on next Standard/Full. Push in Beam direction.

foes.name: Fog
foes.effect: Spend 3 Mana. Targets cannot target beyond this move's range/1. Half MAG beyond Range 2.

foes.name: Serpent's Gate
foes.effect: Before accuracy: channel ACC and CR until next turn. Per accuracy 11+: +1 dice. If not: -1 dice.

foes.name: Absolution
foes.effect: Choose a target. Inflict target's debuffs on all other targets/1. Cleanse allies in range.

foes.name: Providence
foes.effect: Choose PDEF or MDEF to channel and apply to allies in range/1. May be non-damaging Standard.

foes.name: Echo of Light
foes.effect: Next turn: channeled buffs doubled.

foes.name: Tidal Wave
foes.effect: inflict Confusion/1. New Moon: +AoE range.

foes.name: Blood Moon
foes.effect: Waxing/Waning: inflict 2d6 Poison/1. Otherwise: inflict 3d4 Bleed/1.

foes.name: Fatal Moonlight
foes.effect:
Two effects if user has 2 Phases.
New Moon: Seal/1 on max range target.
Waxing: permanent +2d6 DEF.
Full Moon: +2 targets.
Waning: ignores negative damage factors.

foes.name: Scry
foes.effect: Delay-1: Cone +1. Choose target: +10*X% of total delay on target to attack (X = targets).

foes.name: Fateweave
foes.effect: Choose Delay 1-5. Per foe dying on landing turn: permanent +2 ACC, +4 CR. After lands: delays <= 2 land immediately on user death. Disabled after hit. Ignores ATK/MAG and outside factors. Gains use on miss.

foes.name: Blood Wave
foes.effect: If attacked multiple times last turn: gain 1 Blood before Thirst.\nThirst 3: inflict -X DEF/2 (X = Blood).\nThirst 5: may become AoE/Foes/Beam 5.

foes.name: Blood Whirl
foes.effect: Accuracy per target. Lose X Blood (X = targets hit).\nThirst 4: Star 2.\nThirst 7: before accuracy, teleport up to 2 tiles.

foes.name: Sanguine Explosion
foes.effect: Reaction: when reaching 10 Blood. inflict Slow/1. Also usable without use on foe death: originates from foe, Burst 2, loses Push.

foes.name: Lasting Cuts
foes.effect: inflict 3 Cripple/1. If already Crippled: Cripple +2, duration set to 1.

foes.name: Piercing Jab
foes.effect: Per 30 damage taken since last turn: +1 dice, range upgrade (Pierce -> Beam -> Cone).

foes.name: Enchanted Blade
foes.effect: inflict 4 Curse/1 or 4 Bleed/1. Multiple targets: both (damage does not stack).

foes.name: Handle Bash
foes.effect: Pull 1 or Push 1. Teleport to Beam 2 in attack direction (Push) or opposite (Pull). Next turn: target's actions cost 1 MP.

foes.name: Thirteenfold Cut
foes.effect: Choose up to 3: inflict -5 DEF/1. Targets may negate. Per negation: user gains +4 DEF/1.

foes.name: Guillotine
foes.effect: Starts at 0 uses. Gains use on Ramping Magic proc. +1 dice per Ramping Magic proc, -1 dice per target.

Self.name: Fantasia
Self.effect: Choose: +3 ATK/MAG, +1 ACC/CR, or +4 DEF. Until next turn, Rising Hope becomes Star 2 and grants all selected Fantasia bonuses. Cannot choose same bonus more than once.

Self.name: Smokescreen
Self.effect: Until next turn: attacks entering Burst 2 have -2 Range, -7 DMG. Attacks used within Burst 2 have -2 Range.

Self.name: Martyrdom
Self.effect: Gain +15% healing/1. Healed targets gain +1 EVA and +1 MP/1 (max +3). Per dead ally: +15% healing.

Self.name: Conversion
Self.effect: Spend 1-3 Qi. This turn: attacks become opposite damage type, swap ATK and MAG. Per Qi spent: ignore 5 DEF and gain +1 Range.

Self.name: Nirvana
Self.effect: Spend any Qi. Next attack: gain +1 dice and +2 DMG per Qi spent.

Self.name: Pavise
Self.effect: Until next turn: when user or ally in Burst 2 hit by attack, damaged players gain +3 DEF/1 per damaged player.

Self.name: Radiance
Self.effect: Until next turn: user takes 80% damage from attacks. Aegis redirects 50%.

Self.name: Superposition
Self.effect: Roll d20 and store (max 1). Reaction: before user accuracy check, substitute stored roll. Reaction: when foe attacks in Range 4 after accuracy, replace accuracy with stored roll (cannot cause miss).

Self.name: Fractal Division
Self.effect: This turn: next single-target attack targets 2 foes in Range 4. Loses Splash. User picks target for secondary effects.

Self.name: Time's Edge
Self.effect: This turn: gain +1 Standard (MR -3). Next 2 Standard/Full: 25% ATK/MAG. If first deals damage, second ignores outside damage factors and ATK/MAG/DEF. Only Reactions and Triggers between these actions.

Self.name: Outmaneuver
Self.effect: Spend any MP. Until next turn: attacks from max range gain +1 ACC per 2 MP spent.

Self.name: Quick Thinking
Self.effect: After last Standard: spend MP, move 1 tile per 2 MP. Ignores Backstep penalty.

Self.name: Tunneling
Self.effect: This turn: move through tiles and foes as Normal tiles. Cannot end turn on obstructions or Broken tiles.

Self.name: Bolt Compaction
Self.effect: This turn: Standard Crossbow attacks lose secondary effects. Next turn: first Standard attack gains +1 dice and the negated effects.

Self.name: Shadow Quiver
Self.effect: Next Standard attack becomes Magical, treats non-player obstructions as Air, ignores non-targets. Loses 2 damage per Air tile passed through.

Self.name: Final Hour
Self.effect: Next attack: Hunter's Mark gains +4 dice faces.

Self.name: Bolt Arsenal
Self.effect:
When using single-target Standard Crossbow attack: choose one Bolt.
Bounty Bolt: target gains half the Marks of latest slain foe.
Split-Head Bolt: targets another foe, loses Splash.
Reeling Bolt: Pull target to tile in user's Line 3-6.
Each Bolt: once until refresh. Swift: refresh Bolts.

Self.name: Dispell Bow
Self.effect: This turn: +2 MP, ranged attacks Range becomes 3. Next turn: +1 MP, ranged attacks Range becomes 6.

Self.name: Sniper's Focus
Self.effect: This turn: Standard actions become Full. Range 7+ effects trigger at Range 4+.

Self.name: Bound Gauntlet
Self.effect: After Physical attack: deal magic damage equal to damage dealt (after DEF) to different foe in Melee. After Magical attack: next Physical attack ignores 5 DEF and cannot miss.

Self.name: Tactical Sniper
Self.effect: Game start: designate Bounty. Attacks on Bounty: treat obstructions as Air, +1 Range. Melee on Bounty: +1 dice. Bounty dies: designate new Bounty.

Self.name: Hawkeye
Self.effect: Gain +2 ACC on all attacks. Trigger before Standard: sacrifice up to 5 ACC, gain equal CR until next turn.

Self.name: Sanctified Blade
Self.effect: Next single-target attack: CP sacrifice +10%. If foe targeted user since last turn: +5%.

Self.name: Oblation
Self.effect: Next attack this turn: double damage from CP.

Self.name: Animatus
Self.effect: Non-Animated Totem on unoccupied tile: becomes Animated. Sacrifice any HP: becomes Totem's HP, gained as Shield/1. Animated Totem is allied entity, shares user's DEF. Removed when user or Totem at 0 HP.\nWith Animated Totem: move up to MP, deal 3d10 to foes in Totem range.

Self.name: Triumvirate
Self.effect: Swap subweapons (Standard). Gladius: +1 dice. Scutum: ranged attacks on user lose 5 damage. Pilum: Melee attacks gain +3 Range. Swapping from effects: always occurs. Start in Gladius.

Self.name: Iberian Steel
Self.effect: Subweapons are used on weapon attack/standard. Next attack in least-used subweapon: +1 dice. If 2+ fewer uses: also +2 ACC.

Self.name: Dual Wield
Self.effect: Before moving: MP halved

Self.name: Fair Fight
Self.effect: Next single-target target becomes Duel Partner/2. Ends on death or user damages other foe. User deals/takes 30 less damage from non-DP foes. If DP has allies or is monster: 5 instead.

Self.name: Hold Over
Self.effect: Declare range type. If foes target user with attacks of that range type outside Melee: user may AoO/1.

Self.name: Line Out
Self.effect: If next attack can target a foe in Apex: range may be treated as Pierce instead of Line.

Self.name: Right to Rule
Self.effect: Start with 3 Campaigns (max 3). Each: +2 DEF. Lose 1 when dealing or receiving 10+ damage at once.\nAttack with 0 Campaigns: +1 dice, +1 ACC.

Self.name: Coronation
Self.effect: Reaction/Trigger: when reaching 0 Campaigns, or start of turn with 0. Right to Rule max +1. Gain max Campaigns.

Self.name: Allez
Self.effect: Reaction: once between turns on attack involving user. Remove 1 dice, store Focus = half of removed dice faces.

Self.name: Parry
Self.effect: Reaction: on attack involving user (no Rapier reaction since last turn). Attack loses all damage and dice buffs. Store Focus = removed buff's value.

Self.name: All for One
Self.effect: Reaction: when user spends Focus. If targeting same player as previous Focus spend: gain half-value Focus.

Self.name: Spellweave
Self.effect: The user chooses any number of distinct usable Spellbook moves to "Spellweave", consuming a use of each move. Their next Spellbook attack this turn adds the base rolls and all secondary effects (including Mana costs) of the Spellwoven moves to its own.

Self.name: Resonate
Self.effect: Restores a use after Standard/Full Talisman ability. Gain one buff: +3 DMG, +3 PDEF, +3 MDEF, or +1 ACC.

Self.name: Sanctuary
Self.effect: Next channeling: +1 round.

Self.name: Card Counter
Self.effect: Once per turn: reroll Cards dice effect (Craps: reroll damage dice).

Self.name: High Roller
Self.effect: Per remaining Standard: roll 1d5. Targeting amount = roll - 1 (1: lost).

Self.name: Lunar Phase
Self.effect: Start of first turn: choose Phase. Start of each turn: shift Phase. Cannot be disabled.\nNew Moon: +1 Range. Waxing: +2 dice faces. Full Moon: -1 dice on attacks targeting user. Waning: +1 dice. Cycle repeats.

Self.name: Lunar Shift
Self.effect: Shift to next Phase. If Moonblast active: transfer to new Phase.

Self.name: Far Side of the Moon
Self.effect: Choose another Phase (doesn't shift). Active when original Phase not affected by Moonblast/Celestial Blessing. May use for Lunar Rod effects.

Self.name: Omen
Self.effect: Next attack: +1 delay

Self.name: Buy Time
Self.effect: Spend 1 Coin: next Cutlass attack effect +1 round.

Self.name: Draw Blood
Self.effect: Ignores ATK/DEF. Auto-hits (rolls accuracy). +1 MP this turn. If 5+ damage: +1 Blood, next attack this turn +1 base dice.

Foe.name: Staccato
Foe.effect: Reaction: When a foe attacks user or Duet ally (after damage). Hits target and foes in Star 2 of user and Duet ally. inflict -2 DEF/1 and -1 EVA/1 per hit. If attacker kills Duet ally: gain permanent +2 MP, +2 ACC, +2 CR. Ignores outside damage factors.

Foe.name: Soulstep
Foe.effect: Move up to MP. Targeting before or after movement. Ignores outside damage factors, DEF, and ATK/MAG.

Foe.name: Arrow Flurry
Foe.effect: If target has Mark: Splash 1. If target has 3+ Marks: Splash 2 instead.

Foe.name: Cursed Bolts
Foe.effect: inflict 3X Curse/1 (X = Marks on target). If target has 3+ Marks: ignores negative outside damage factors.

Foe.name: Arrow Net
Foe.effect: Before damage: target takes 3 damage each time they gain a Mark from user/1.

Foe.name: Quick Scope
Foe.effect: Ignores ATK/MAG, half DEF, and outside damage factors (except Hunter's Mark).

Foe.name: Explosive Shot
Foe.effect: The target holds a "Bomb". If a foe with a Bomb targets another foe (including their allies) they transfer the Bomb to one of their targets.\nAfter one round or when the holder dies, the Bomb detonates and deals Xd4 Bomb damage to foes in the Bomb's Burst 1. X = the foe who held the Bomb with the most Marks.

Foe.name: Tornado Bolt
Foe.effect: Push X (X = 1 + Marks on target). If target cannot be pushed full distance: gain +1 Mark.

Foe.name: Serrated Arrows
Foe.effect: inflict X Bleed/1 (X = half of Hunter's Mark damage from this attack).

Foe.name: Swift Shot
Foe.effect: If target is at Range 7+: crit on 14+. If target is under Range 3: gain +1 MP/2.

Foe.name: Crippling Shot
Foe.effect:
Effect varies by range.
1-2: inflict Slow/1.
3+: inflict 2 Cripple/1 on accuracy 14+.
7+: inflict Cripple regardless of accuracy.

Foe.name: Blessed Arrow
Foe.effect: Allies in target's Star 2: healing and buffs x1.25/1. Foes in target's Star 2: debuffs x1.25/1. Does not stack. As non-damaging Standard: 1/Tile/Range 10.

Foe.name: Arcane Shot
Foe.effect: If target under Range 3: Push 3. If target at Range 7+: ignores up to 10 DEF.

Foe.name: Chase Arrow
Foe.effect: Targets within 8 tiles. May target foes on path to original target (path cannot exceed range). Damage to path foes: ignores ATK/MAG and DEF.

Foe.name: Volley
Foe.effect: If target is 7+ tiles away: +1 hit. If foes in Splash 1 of target: +2 hits. Bonus hits target random foes in Splash 1 (including original). Each: half target DEF, ignores ATK/MAG.

Foe.name: Fireworks
Foe.effect: If target at Range 7+: Bomb dice. If target under Range 3: Bound Bow becomes +5 DEF/1 and +1 MP/1 until user attacks at Range 3+.

Foe.name: Blitz
Foe.effect: Crit on 18+. Per hit: gain +4 damage on next attack.

Foe.name: Splinter
Foe.effect: Per crit: next attack gains -1.5 dice faces and +1 base dice. Dice faces round up

Foe.name: Salvo
Foe.effect: May target different foes per hit. Adds ATK/MAG and applies damage effects to each.

Foe.name: Trick Shot
Foe.effect: If +ACC: Splash 1. If +4+ ACC: becomes Magical, Splash 2.

Foe.name: Surge
Foe.effect: Per crit: next multi-hit attack gains +1 hit.

Foe.name: Venom Shot
Foe.effect: Non-Hawkeye +ACC treated as +CR. inflict Poison/1 (X = 2 * +CR). If 12+: halve poison, extend 1 round.

Foe.name: Arrow Storm
Foe.effect: Crit on 18+.

Foe.name: Shrapnel Tip
Foe.effect: Per crit: gains +1 hit (MR 3, 2d3+0).

Foe.name: Bloodrush
Foe.effect: If used from max range: gain +5 DMG/1 and +1 MP/1.

Foe.name: Purloin Youth
Foe.effect: Attacks targeting user: 10% recoil/1. User sacrifices half recoil to CP.

Foe.name: Massacre
Foe.effect: If kill: gain 2x CP and +1 use of Massacre. If not: no CP sacrifice.

Foe.name: Exsanguinate
Foe.effect: If CP from this move grants Black Magic bonus: +1 to that bonus.

Foe.name: Siphon Soul
Foe.effect: Before accuracy: heal HP equal to CP.

Foe.name: Reap
Foe.effect: Reaper's Touch heals 1/5 instead of 1/8 on this attack.

Foe.name: Hades' Toll
Foe.effect: Reaper's Touch heal +50% on attacks against target/2.

Foe.name: Pestilent Strike
Foe.effect: inflict X Poison/1 (X = Reaper's Touch healing from this attack). If X >= 6: halve poison, extend 1 round.

Foe.name: Coup de Grâce
Foe.effect: If kill: heal 10 HP, gain +5 damage to next attack.

Foe.name: Spirit Break
Foe.effect: inflict -3 DEF/1. gain +3 DMG/1.

Foe.name: Memento Mori
Foe.effect: Delay-1. May delay up to +2 more turns. Per extra delay: Reaper's Touch heals +1/8 of damage.

Foe.name: Stroke of Midnight
Foe.effect: Before damage: Reaper's Touch healing becomes +damage on this attack/1. Other Scythe healing becomes +DMG/1.

Foe.name: Phantom Blade
Foe.effect: Reaper's Touch heal on this attack = HP healed from Scythe abilities (except Phantom Blade) last round.

Foe.name: Left-Hand Path
Foe.effect: User moves along line from origin until hitting obstruction. If no Totem: inflict -2 EVA/1 and -3 DEF/1.

Foe.name: Heredity
Foe.effect: Totem moves adjacent to target. Heal HP sacrificed to create it. If no Totem: place one on target's tile.

Foe.name: Feral Spark
Foe.effect: Target: 10% recoil/1. User's current Totem type numerical effects doubled.

Foe.name: Exercitus
Foe.effect: Gladius: swap to Scutum. Scutum: Push 3, swap to Pilum. Pilum: inflict 4 Cripple/1, swap to Gladius.

Foe.name: Disengage
Foe.effect: Gladius: inflict -2d6 DEF/1, Push 1. Scutum: half AoE damage/1, push back 1. Switch to Pilum.

Foe.name: Forward Jab
Foe.effect: Requires Pilum. +1 base dice

Foe.name: Breach
Foe.effect: Switch to Gladius or Scutum. Gladius: foes entering melee take 3d8 damage/1. Scutum: user and allies in Burst 2 cannot have DEF ignored/1.

Foe.name: Phalanx
Foe.effect: Requires Scutum. Reaction: when foe hits user or ally in user's melee. If target in melee: +1 dice, swap to Gladius. If not: swap to Pilum. Ignores outside factors, ATK/MAG, half DEF.

Foe.name: Deus Vult
Foe.effect: Requires Scutum. Before accuracy: immune to statuses and debuffs/1, remove existing.

Foe.name: Thwack
Foe.effect: Only Stun can prevent use. +1 dice per 5 ATK or MAG (whichever higher) target has above 20.

Foe.name: Grave of Titans
Foe.effect: Ignores DEF. Per 10 max HP target has above 120: +3 DMG, -1 MR. If damage reduced by foes: next Standard/Full gains +1 ACC/1, +1 CR/1, and +1 dice.

Foe.name: Inertial Shift
Foe.effect: If foe moved or attempted to move user last round: +2 dice, becomes Homing 8 (Pull 7).

Foe.name: Hardwood Slam
Foe.effect:
Choose status if condition met. -2 MR (Poison), +2 dice (Confusion), or heal 5 HP (Bleed).
5 Poison/2: if user ACC negative or target EVA increased.
Confusion/2: if target's ACC caused them to hit or trigger effect on user/allies.
6 Bleed/2: if target crit or had +dice on attack on user/allies.

Foe.name: Exploit Feign
Foe.effect: inflict -4 DEF/1 or -4 DMG/1. If user debuffed by foe: cleanse before accuracy, +1 hit, debuff doubled.

Foe.name: Stance Breaker
Foe.effect: If target gained >5 DEF, HP or Shield last round: advantage dice. gain 75% of highest as Shield/1.

Foe.name: Defiance
Foe.effect: Reaction: when foe statuses user or targets outside Range 4. Teleport to unoccupied tile in their Melee. Next Standard/Full: +2 ACC

Foe.name: Calamitous Trance
Foe.effect: If target dealt 50+ to user last round: +3 dice. If 75+: +4 dice faces. -1 MR per hit on user since last turn. Confusion/2 when MR < 4.

Foe.name: Spurn
Foe.effect: If target can attack from Melee next turn but doesn't: user may AoO them at end of turn.

Foe.name: Figure 8
Foe.effect: Reaction: when foe willingly moves out of user's Range 2 from Melee

Foe.name: Reversal
Foe.effect: If target can end turn on different tile type but doesn't: gain +2 ACC/1, next attack ignores half DEF.

Foe.name: Wear Down
Foe.effect: Per MP target uses next turn: gain +3 DEF until next turn.

Foe.name: Yin Yang
Foe.effect: Choose Yin or Yang.\nYin: Physical/Melee. If target doesn't damage user next turn: target takes 1d8+5.\nYang: Magical/Homing 4. Foes take 1d8+5 when damaging user/1.

Foe.name: Standoff
Foe.effect: If target ends next turn in user's Melee: user may AoO (ignores ATK/MAG).

Foe.name: Dazing Hook
Foe.effect: Range cannot be reduced. If target attacked user outside Melee last round: inflict Confusion/1 and Inverse Bomb dice/1.

Foe.name: Tempest Sweep
Foe.effect: Choose Honte or Gyakute.\nHonte: Physical. Next turn: Tonfa effects lasting 1 round/turn last +1 round/turn.\nGyakute: Magical. Next Tonfa attack gains Star 2 Splash.

Foe.name: Feral Chop
Foe.effect: X = 2.5 * user's Rage.

Foe.name: Chain Axe
Foe.effect: Bloodlust grants +1 Rage per damage instance/1.

Foe.name: Power Swing
Foe.effect: Spend X Rage: -X MR

Foe.name: Knockback
Foe.effect: inflict Slow/1. Spend 1 Rage: +1 Push and/or inflict Cripple 6/1 instead.

Foe.name: Gash
Foe.effect: Spend Rage: inflict 5 Bleed/X (X = Rage spent).

Foe.name: Sever
Foe.effect: Spend Rage: +1 hit and +1 MR per Rage.

Foe.name: Amped Strike
Foe.effect: +damage = 4 * user's Rage. Lose all Rage.

Foe.name: Storm Strike
Foe.effect: Teleport to tile in target's Splash 1. inflict Slow/1.

Foe.name: Seismic Smash
Foe.effect: inflict 2 Cripple/2.

Foe.name: Crush
Foe.effect: If target cannot be pushed full distance: +1d10+5 damage.

Foe.name: Earth Render
Foe.effect: After damage or miss: replace up to 2 unoccupied tiles in Burst 2 of target with Broken (2 rounds, or until user dies/removes as Trigger).

Foe.name: Shockwave Slam
Foe.effect: Splash hits foes in target's Star. Original target: Push 2 in chosen direction. Splash targets: Push 2 away from original.

Foe.name: Collision Course
Foe.effect: Original target: Push to tile in their Range 5. Subsequent: Push to tile in their Range 3. Can Push user/allies via Unstoppable Force (no damage). Each target once.

Foe.name: Aftershock
Foe.effect: Reaction: after user pushes target. Move up to tiles pushed in that direction. Then deal 1d10+6 to foes in user's Burst 1.

Foe.name: Fissure
Foe.effect: Regardless of hit: push target. Tiles target exits while pushed become permanent Broken (unremovable, unignorable). Foes entering Burst 1 of Broken: 2d8 damage, once/turn per foe. User may remove any as Trigger on their turns.

Foe.name: Tomahawk Toss
Foe.effect: X = 4 - range used at. Apex: Pull 3

Foe.name: Kip Up
Foe.effect: Push regardless of hit. May negate Push: teleport 1 tile away from target. Ignores outside damage factors, ATK/MAG, DEF.

Foe.name: Repulse Slice
Foe.effect: No Push on Apex. Apex: per tile target moves toward user next turn: Plate Crusher values +1.

Foe.name: Continental Crash
Foe.effect: After Push: place Broken tile in target's Melee (3 rounds). User may remove as Trigger. Foes ending turn in tile's Melee: 10 damage. Apex: hits foes in target's Splash 1.

Foe.name: Discipline
Foe.effect: Start of target's next turn: gain +3X DEF/1 (X = 3 - range used). Apex: if last attack had Apex, next attack applies that Apex effects (excluding extra hits).

Foe.name: Kinetic Impact
Foe.effect: If target cannot be moved full distance: +1 dice. Apex: -2 Push, +2 dice faces.

Foe.name: Two Handed
Foe.effect: If user didn't push target last turn: +2 Push. Apex: if target can't be moved full distance: inflict 7 Bleed/1.

Foe.name: Elastic Collision
Foe.effect: Before targeting: move up to MP in straight line (half diagonals). X = 1 + tiles moved. Apex: +2 CR.

Foe.name: Besiege
Foe.effect: Before accuracy: sacrifice up to 10 HP. Gain equal Shield/1. 1.5x if target >50% HP.

Foe.name: Catapult Campaign
Foe.effect: Cannot use at Range 2. Target >75% HP: inflict 5 Bleed/1. May self-inflict 10 Bleed/1 to double Bleed.

Foe.name: Entrench
Foe.effect: If less than 6 bonus DEF: gain +3 DEF/1. Lose +1 Campaign per RtR instance/1.

Foe.name: The Art of War
Foe.effect: Choose War or Peace.\nWar: Physical. If 0 Campaigns: +dice faces = 1.5x Campaign max.\nPeace: Magical. Until next Standard/Full: target has -X/3 MP, -2X ATK/MAG (X = user's Campaigns).

Foe.name: Last Stand
Foe.effect: When user would take >55-3X damage (X = Campaign max): attacker takes 3d8+2, damage reduced by 3X/1.

Foe.name: Cursed Slice
Foe.effect: +1 CR. Target's next Standard/Full: 5% recoil. Spend 10 Resolve up to 5x: +1 CR and +5% recoil per spend.

Foe.name: Lunge
Foe.effect: Move adjacent to target (even on miss). Spend 20 Resolve up to 3x: -1 MR per spend. After damage: choose +10% damage dealt and taken/1.

Foe.name: Blade of Woe
Foe.effect: Before damage: inflict 5 Curse/1 on user and target. First Resolve spend after taking 55+ damage while Cursed: resolve effect +1/3.

Foe.name: Lotus Strike
Foe.effect: Spend all Resolve. X hits = Resolve/30. 5*X% recoil (no Resolve from recoil).

Foe.name: Delirium
Foe.effect: Spend 25 Resolve per debuff. X = Enrage: inflict -X ACC/1, -X CR/1, -X dice/1, -5X DEF/1.\nSpend 30 more: if cleansed or prevented, target gains disadvantage dice/1.

Foe.name: Provoke
Foe.effect: If target doesn't deal 45+ to user next turn: Resolve gain x1.75/1. Resolve gained since Provoke also x1.75.

Foe.name: Rising Sun
Foe.effect: Spend up to 100 Resolve: gain X% of damage as Shield/1 (X = Resolve/1.5). If first ability this turn: turn continues until another non-Standard/Full. While Shield active: healing doesn't reduce Resolve.

Foe.name: Giant Slayer
Foe.effect: If the user has less HP than the target, they may spend up to X Resolve, where X is the difference between the user's and target's HP. For every 10 Resolve spent, gain +2+Y damage, where Y is current Enrage.

Foe.name: Thrust
Foe.effect: Move to tile in target's Melee. If damage removed by outside factors: inflict 2 Bleed/1. Spend Focus: +Bleed or +1 duration.

Foe.name: Deflect
Foe.effect: Reaction: when foe attacks user. Attack loses 10% damage, store as Focus. If attack moves user: Pull 2. Ignores non-Rapier outside factors.

Foe.name: Counter
Foe.effect: Reaction/Standard: when foe deals 40+ to user. Ignores ATK/MAG/DEF and non-Rapier outside factors. Active Rapier effects +1 round. Next spent Focus x1.5.

Foe.name: Moulinet
Foe.effect: Target gains +4 DMG/1 or +4 DEF/1. Spend Focus: heal 3 HP per ability target uses next turn. If no Focus spent: next Focus gains half-value Focus.

Foe.name: Redoublement
Foe.effect: Spend any Focus: +1 hit per Focus. Each Focus hit: +CR equal to Focus value.

Foe.name: One for All
Foe.effect: Ignores 1/4 DEF. May change splash: Star 2 (1/2 DEF) or Line 2 (3/4 DEF). Per target: gain Focus = DEF ignored.

Foe.name: Rototill
Foe.effect: Physical or Magical. If target on non-Normal tile: lose Pull 3, gain +1 ACC and +1 dice.

Foe.name: Bioturbation
Foe.effect: If non-Normal tile in Burst 1: move to same tile type within Range 8. Pass through players (cannot end farther from target). Players passed through: -7 DEF/1, -1 EVA/1.

Foe.name: Blackthorn
Foe.effect: Physical or Magical. Before damage: targets invert positive tile effects/1. +4 dice on secondary targets.

Foe.name: Wildfire
Foe.effect: If target on Forest: set Wildfire on that tile and adjacent Forest tiles.\nWildfire: lasts 2 rounds. Start of turn on Wildfire: 3d4 damage, -7 damage on next Standard/Full.

Foe.name: Nature's Madness
Foe.effect: Immune to Air tiles. Augmented by X = number of certain tile types in Burst 1. After damage: convert used tiles to Normal.\nAir/Sticky/Boost: +X Range and damage (max 3). If X>1: +1 target.\nForest/Water/Lava/Ice: choose type, inflict X status/1. If X>3: extend 1 round.

Foe.name: Scorched Earth
Foe.effect: Before Push: tiles in target's Star 1 become Lava. Counts as user damage. Once per turn per entity.

Foe.name: Fireball
Foe.effect: Spend 2 Mana. May spend more: +1 base dice per extra Mana. If any damage dice roll 1: inflict 3 Burn/1.

Foe.name: Hex
Foe.effect: Spend 3 Mana. Next Standard/Full on each target: +2 ACC

Foe.name: Plague
Foe.effect: Spend 3 Mana. Choose Bleed, Burn, Curse, or Poison. inflict 3 [status]/1. Spend +1 Mana: /2.

Foe.name: Scourge
Foe.effect: Spend 4 Mana. Choose one non-Basic, non-Lv 1, non-EX move per target. Targets cannot use selected moves/1.

Foe.name: Maelstrom
Foe.effect: Spend 6 Mana. Choose 2 effects: +5 damage, +2 ACC, +5 DEF/1 on hit, or +3 MP/2 on hit.

Foe.name: Smite
Foe.effect: Before accuracy: choose a buff to channel/1. May be non-damaging Swift on self.

Foe.name: Compass
Foe.effect: Gain +2 ACC. If miss while channeled: gain +3 CR.

Foe.name: Seal of Solomon
Foe.effect: Choose a channeled buff: invert and apply as debuff/1. inflict Confusion/1.

Foe.name: Transcendence
Foe.effect: Before accuracy: convert +ACC to +CR, +DMG to +PDEF or +MDEF (and vice versa). Converted buffs channeled/1.

Foe.name: Judgment
Foe.effect: inflict Evil Eye permanently.\nEvil Eye: debuffs on player last +1 round. Start of turn: take d4+2 per debuff. Talisman heals equal damage dealt.

Foe.name: Card Flip
Foe.effect: Roll d3 after damage. 1: 0.8x damage. 3: 1.3x damage. Outside factors also affected.

Foe.name: Discard
Foe.effect: Roll d20. 15+: store reroll (Once/Trigger) for any Cards effect.

Foe.name: Roulette
Foe.effect: Roll 1d8 for status on foe, then d3. 1 on d3: inflict on self instead. 1=10 Bleed/1, 2=10 Poison/1, 3=10 Burn/1, 4=6 Cripple/1, 5=Root/1, 6=Seal/1, 7=Stun/1, 8=Confusion/1.

Foe.name: Gamble
Foe.effect: Roll d7. 1: subtract target ATK and MAG. 2: subtract target's higher offense. 3: subtract user ATK. 4: add user ATK. 5: add target's higher offense. 6: add user MAG again. 7: add user ATK and target ATK/MAG. Adds user MAG

Foe.name: Blackjack
Foe.effect: On a successful hit, roll 2d10, treating 1s as either 1 or 11 (user's choice). The user may choose to roll additional 1d10s to add to the roll. If the total is 17-20, this attack gains 1 base dice. On a total of 21, this attack instead gains 3 base dice and activates Jackpot. On a total of 22 or higher, the attack instead loses 2 base dice.

Foe.name: Craps
Foe.effect: Bomb dice. Per Bomb trigger: choose another foe in target's Splash 1 (once per foe). 5+ Bomb: Jackpot. Immune to non-Cards positive damage factors. Crit extra dice: no Bomb.

Foe.name: Slots Spin
Foe.effect: Roll 3d4. Per 4: +1 dice. No 4s: -1 dice. All 4s: +1 more dice.

Foe.name: Hi-Lo
Foe.effect: Roll d10. Predict higher or lower, then roll again. Correct: +2 base dice, continue (max 5). Wrong: stop, lose half base dice. Same roll: reroll.

Foe.name: Stacked Deck
Foe.effect:
In place of an accuracy roll, roll a 1d14 for an effect. 
1. The opponent is healed by the roll, 
2. The user takes 2x damage from all sources for one round,
3. The attack misses, 
4. After damage, the user and target swap their current HP (can overheal, foes with over 200 HP are considered to have 200 HP for this effect), 
5. For one round, attacks automatically hit the user,
6. The user and target gain a random position change,
7. The user and target are both Stunned/1,
8. 50% of this attack's damage is dealt to a random foe instead,
9. For one round, the user's attacks automatically hit,
10. The user gains a 1/Any/Global Once/Reaction: "Reroll one accuracy roll.",
11. Cleanse all statuses and numerical debuffs from the user & reset their other moves' frequencies,
12. Target is Sealed/1, 
13. Next turn, the user may choose numbers for their cards effects, rather than rolling dice for them,
14. This attack has unremovable thrice base dice.

Foe.name: Moonblast
Foe.effect: Next Phase effect value +1.

Foe.name: Dark Reflection
Foe.effect: inflict inverse of user's Phase/1.

Foe.name: Holy Light
Foe.effect: If Moonblast or Celestial Blessing active: target's statuses (except Seal/Stun) +1 round.

Foe.name: Harvest Moon
Foe.effect: New/Full Moon: heal 1d10+2. Otherwise: no Phase shift next turn. May be non-attack Standard.

Foe.name: Double Tide
Foe.effect: Crit on 16+. If at least 1 crit: gain Moonblast effect.

Foe.name: Gravity Crash
Foe.effect:
Effect varies by Phase.
New Moon: Homing 4, target cannot use limited moves/1.
Waxing: Push 1d6, inflict 4 Cripple/2.
Full Moon: foes deal 75% to allies in Range 5/1.
Waning: Bomb dice.

Foe.name: Augur
Foe.effect: Delay-1: +5 DMG or +3 CR. Delay-2: both.

Foe.name: Eventide
Foe.effect: Delay-1. Target gains 3 Curse until Eventide lands. Delay-2: Curse -DEF +2.

Foe.name: Echo Burst
Foe.effect: Delay-1: lose Splash, gain +5 DEF until lands. Cannot stack.

Foe.effect: On hit: target takes 5% of max HP over 100 damage. Up to Delay-2: +5*Delay%. Until lands: damaging statuses deal bonus = half on-hit damage.

Foe.effect: If target kills user within 1 round: reduce delays on them by 1. If target dies within 1 round: transfer one delay to new target in original's Range 7.

Foe.name: Foresight
Foe.effect: Reaction: when user attacked, after damage rolled. Remove 10% damage. Add to: 1) delayed attacks, or 2) user's HP x number of delayed attacks.

Foe.name: Dawn Break
Foe.effect: Delay-2. Until lands: attacks on target have -1 MR. +1 Delay: +1 more -1 MR.

Foe.name: Oracle
Foe.effect: Add or remove 1 delay from any number of delayed attacks. May be self-targeting non-damaging Movement+Swift.

Foe.name: Prophecy
Foe.effect: Per delayed move that landed start of turn: +2.5 ACC, +2 DMG. Delay-1/2: lose prior bonuses, gain +8 DMG per delayed move landing with Prophecy. Updates when delays used.

Foe.name: Dirty Trick
Foe.effect: Choose Push/Pull, Splash, Buff, or Status. Target's Standard attacks lack chosen attribute/1.

Foe.effect: Choose Trip or Slip. Trip: target must move 2+ tiles per direction/1. Slip: teleport to entity's Melee within Range 4.

Foe.name: Scallywag Slice
Foe.effect: Choose Outwit or Befuddle. Outwit: +1 CR, target's CR = 1 on first hit of next Standard. Befuddle: target ignores positive tile effects/1.

Foe.effect: Spend 1 Coin: inflict -DEF equal to damage this turn. Ignores outside factors, ATK/MAG, DEF.

Foe.name: Shady Bet
Foe.effect: If gaining Coin from this attack: gain Trick Coin instead (choose Swindler effect). May spend Coin to gain Trick Coin (ignores Scoundrel).

Foe.effect: Choose Pistol or Taunt. Pistol: AoE/Foes/Pierce 5, targets' Items become Movement/1. Taunt: targets' AoE become Pierce, must target user/1.

Foe.name: Swashbuckler
Foe.effect: Choose Cruel, Sly, or Daring. Cruel: +1 dice. Sly: before accuracy, end target's duration buffs/debuffs. Daring: 10 Shield/1.

Foe.name: Captain's Order
Foe.effect: Target chooses Plank or Marooning. Plank: Push 2, 4 damage per ongoing Cutlass effect on target. Marooning: target's next Standard: 25% recoil.

Foe.name: Twin Fangs
Foe.effect: Per hit: lose 2 Blood.\nThirst 5: +3 MR, Double Hit.

Foe.name: Otherworldly Attraction
Foe.effect: Accuracy per target. Statuses from this move ignored when moving toward user.\ninflict Slow/1.\nThirst 4: inflict Cripple 4/1.

Foe.name: Uninvited Guest
Foe.effect: If first attack on target: gain 2 Blood.\nIf one attacked other last turn but not reciprocated: +8 CR.

Foe.name: Indulge
Foe.effect: Ignores target DEF.\nThirst 7: on hit, lose half Blood (round up), heal 30% damage, cannot gain Blood until next turn.\nThirst 10: no effects.

Foe.name: Night Visitor
Foe.effect: Requires foe damaged this game not in melee. Before accuracy: teleport to melee of target.\nThirst 5: hits foes in Star 1 after teleport, inflict Slow/1.\nThirst 9: usable in melee, Star 2, lose 1 Blood +1 per hit.

Foe.name: Savage Spin-out
Foe.effect: Splash: Beam 1 behind target. Original: Pull 3. Splash targets: Push 1.

Foe.name: Debilitate
Foe.effect: Ignores 4 DEF, +4 per Ramping Magic proc. If ignores all target MDEF: triggers Ramping Magic.

None.name: Black Magic
None.effect: Per 5 CP: +1 DEF. Per 7 CP: +1 ACC. Per 10 CP: +1 dice.

None.effect: Attacks auto-hit and kill targets below 25% HP.

None.name: Egregore

None.effect: Subweapon bonuses:\nGladius: +0.5X dice. Scutum: +X DEF. Pilum: +0.5X ACC.\nX = uses of least used subweapon.

None.effect: When user misses Standard/Full: buffs apply to next Standard/Full, which gains +2 ACC, 10% of missed damage, and ignores 5 DEF.

None.effect: Adaptive numerical bonuses tripled. Turns: gain 5X Shield, attacks +5X% damage. X = times targeted by foes since last turn.

None.effect: Move up to MP+1, all tiles except final treated as Normal. This turn: attacks ignore obstructions and DEF, invert foe's negative outside damage factors.

None.name: Aikido
None.effect: When user uses 2 attacks of same damage type in one turn: gain +2 DEF and ATK/MAG of opposite type. Resets if effect doesn't occur.

None.name: Bloodlust
None.effect: When user deals or takes 15+ damage: gain 1 Rage.

None.name: Vindictive
None.effect: Gain 2 Rage on kill or miss.

None.name: Swing Cycle
None.effect: Start of turn: spend 2 Rage to reset cooldowns/frequencies of last 2 attacks.\nChain Axe becomes EoT. Start with 1 Rage.

None.name: Unstoppable Force
None.effect: If foe blocks target from full Push: that foe is hit and targeted. Pushed towards where target would have reached.

None.name: Stonemason
None.effect: Hammer effects ignore Ice Clause on player-created tiles.

None.effect: Once per turn: after Apex attack, teleport user or target up to 2 tiles.

None.name: Declaration of War

None.name: Imperial Tyranny
None.effect: Foes in Star 3: -0.5 DEF and -0.5 ATK/MAG per Campaign. If 0 Campaigns: foes attacking user take 10% recoil.

None.effect: Gain/lose 1 Resolve per HP lost/gained (min 0). On miss or kill: regain Resolve spent on that attack. If Resolve > 100 before attack: Advantage dice. Max 20 Resolve from self-damage per round.

None.effect: At 25%, 50%, 75% HP missing: gain 1 Enrage (once each). +1 dice per Enrage.

None.effect: Start of next turn: gain Resolve = X% of Resolve gained since use. X = 150 - user's max HP (max 20%).

None.effect: Max 150 Resolve. When exceeding max: next attack gains +1 ACC/1, +1 CR/1. Fallen Blade: every 1/6 HP.

None.effect: Zanshin's exceed bonuses doubled. Enrage dice doubled on crit.

1.effect: Create Stone wall on target and Line 2 in chosen direction. Removed after 2 rounds, or Free action on user's turn. Foes ending turn with Stone in Melee: take 5 damage and inflict 3 Burn/1. Stone acts like Ice, 30 HP to break, 1 EVA.

1.name: Reforge
1.effect: Choose one base stat (except HP). Foe: reduce by 1/3/1, cannot receive buffs to that stat. Ally: multiply by 1.5/1.

1.name: Mending Mantel
1.effect: Place Hearth tile. When user or allies end turn in its Star 3: gain +5 DEF/1 and heal 5 HP. Hearth acts like Stone. Removed when user dies.

1.name: First Aid
1.effect: Heal target for rolled amount. If ally: may use as Standard to add ATK or MAG. Can only target if attacked in last round.

1.name: Vestments
1.effect: Choose primary and secondary target (may be same)./1: primary heals 1/4 of damage secondary takes. Self as primary costs 2 uses. Max 1 Vestments per primary.

1.name: Pas de Deux
1.effect: Target takes turn immediately after user. Target cannot use Pas de Deux that turn. If Standard: target loses Movement. Juggernaut target: only 1 Standard.

1.name: Fouetté
1.effect: Until next turn: target may use one Once/Twice/Thrice move without expending a use. Cannot target Reactions or Triggers.

1.name: Divertissement
1.effect: Target's next Standard/Full attack next turn: gain +dice faces equal to actions used that turn (max +5). Unaffected by En Pointe.

1.name: Soulstep
1.effect: Move up to MP. Targeting before or after movement. Ignores outside damage factors, DEF, and ATK/MAG.

1.name: Eightfold Shield
1.effect: Spend 2+ Qi: gain +1d4+1 DEF per Qi spent./1

1.name: Aegis
1.effect: Reaction: When ally in Homing 4 damaged by attack. Move adjacent to ally. Redirect 25% of attack damage to user. User not considered target if not already.

1.name: Impasse
1.effect: Choose: ally/self, or foe. Ally/self: cannot be inflicted with Push/Pull or stat reduction by foes/1. Foe: remove target's buffs.

1.name: Oathkeeper
1.effect: User and target gain Oath of Mercy. Start of turn: heal 2 HP and gain +1 ATK/MAG (max +5). Ends on death. Does not stack.

1.name: Rewind
1.effect: Reaction: When user or foe attacking user rolls attack damage. Reroll up to 3 damage dice. Rerolled dice cannot trigger or negate Bomb dice.

1.name: Lightspeed
1.effect: If target Dashes before user's next turn: choose Glide or Rushdown. Glide: move 2 tiles per MP (max 12). Rushdown: after Dash, Standard in Melee (max 10 tiles, immune to AoO).

1.name: Wormhole
1.effect: Place Wormhole on target tile. Swift: user or ally spends half MP (rounded up) to teleport to Wormhole. Expires on use or after 2 rounds.

1.name: Arrow Flurry
1.effect: If target has Mark: Splash 1. If target has 3+ Marks: Splash 2 instead.

1.name: Cursed Bolts
1.effect: inflict 3X Curse/1 (X = Marks on target). If target has 3+ Marks: ignores negative outside damage factors.

1.name: Arrow Net
1.effect: Before damage: target takes 3 damage each time they gain a Mark from user/1.

1.name: Bolt Compaction
1.effect: This turn: Standard Crossbow attacks lose secondary effects. Next turn: first Standard attack gains +1 dice and the negated effects.

1.name: Quick Scope
1.effect: Ignores ATK/MAG, half DEF, and outside damage factors (except Hunter's Mark).

1.name: Explosive Shot
1.effect: The target holds a "Bomb". If a foe with a Bomb targets another foe (including their allies) they transfer the Bomb to one of their targets.\nAfter one round or when the holder dies, the Bomb detonates and deals Xd4 Bomb damage to foes in the Bomb's Burst 1. X = the foe who held the Bomb with the most Marks.

1.name: Tornado Bolt
1.effect: Push X (X = 1 + Marks on target). If target cannot be pushed full distance: gain +1 Mark.

1.name: Serrated Arrows
1.effect: inflict X Bleed/1 (X = half of Hunter's Mark damage from this attack).

1.name: Final Hour
1.effect: Next attack: Hunter's Mark gains +4 dice faces.

1.name: Swift Shot
1.effect: If target is at Range 7+: crit on 14+. If target is under Range 3: gain +1 MP/2.

1.name: Crippling Shot
1.effect:
Effect varies by range.
1-2: inflict Slow/1.
3+: inflict 2 Cripple/1 on accuracy 14+.
7+: inflict Cripple regardless of accuracy.

1.name: Blessed Arrow
1.effect: Allies in target's Star 2: healing and buffs x1.25/1. Foes in target's Star 2: debuffs x1.25/1. Does not stack. As non-damaging Standard: 1/Tile/Range 10.

1.name: Scatter Shot
1.effect: If target is at Range 7+: Splash 1.

1.name: Dispell Bow
1.effect: This turn: +2 MP, ranged attacks Range becomes 3. Next turn: +1 MP, ranged attacks Range becomes 6.

1.name: Arcane Shot
1.effect: If target under Range 3: Push 3. If target at Range 7+: ignores up to 10 DEF.

1.name: Chase Arrow
1.effect: Targets within 8 tiles. May target foes on path to original target (path cannot exceed range). Damage to path foes: ignores ATK/MAG and DEF.

1.name: Volley
1.effect: If target is 7+ tiles away: +1 hit. If foes in Splash 1 of target: +2 hits. Bonus hits target random foes in Splash 1 (including original). Each: half target DEF, ignores ATK/MAG.

1.name: Fireworks
1.effect: If target at Range 7+: Bomb dice. If target under Range 3: Bound Bow becomes +5 DEF/1 and +1 MP/1 until user attacks at Range 3+.

1.name: Blitz
1.effect: Crit on 18+. Per hit: gain +4 damage on next attack.

1.name: Hook Shot
1.effect: If +2 CR: Pull user within Range 2 of target, or target within Range 2 of user. Not an attack on Allies.

1.name: Splinter
1.effect: Per crit: next attack gains -1.5 dice faces and +1 base dice. Dice faces round up

1.name: Salvo
1.effect: May target different foes per hit. Adds ATK/MAG and applies damage effects to each.

1.name: Trick Shot
1.effect: If +ACC: Splash 1. If +4+ ACC: becomes Magical, Splash 2.

1.name: Surge
1.effect: Per crit: next multi-hit attack gains +1 hit.

1.name: Venom Shot
1.effect: Non-Hawkeye +ACC treated as +CR. inflict Poison/1 (X = 2 * +CR). If 12+: halve poison, extend 1 round.

1.name: Arrow Storm
1.effect: Crit on 18+.

1.name: Shrapnel Tip
1.effect: Per crit: gains +1 hit (MR 3, 2d3+0).

1.name: Bloodrush
1.effect: If used from max range: gain +5 DMG/1 and +1 MP/1.

1.name: Purloin Youth
1.effect: Attacks targeting user: 10% recoil/1. User sacrifices half recoil to CP.

1.name: Sanctified Blade
1.effect: Next single-target attack: CP sacrifice +10%. If foe targeted user since last turn: +5%.

1.name: Massacre
1.effect: If kill: gain 2x CP and +1 use of Massacre. If not: no CP sacrifice.

1.name: Covenant
1.effect: Target shares user's Black Magic buffs and gains CP passive/1. CP gained by target applies to user instead.

1.name: Exsanguinate
1.effect: If CP from this move grants Black Magic bonus: +1 to that bonus.

1.name: Siphon Soul
1.effect: Before accuracy: heal HP equal to CP.

1.name: Reap
1.effect: Reaper's Touch heals 1/5 instead of 1/8 on this attack.

1.name: Hades' Toll
1.effect: Reaper's Touch heal +50% on attacks against target/2.

1.name: Pestilent Strike
1.effect: inflict X Poison/1 (X = Reaper's Touch healing from this attack). If X >= 6: halve poison, extend 1 round.

1.name: Coup de Grâce
1.effect: If kill: heal 10 HP, gain +5 damage to next attack.

1.name: Spirit Break
1.effect: inflict -3 DEF/1. gain +3 DMG/1.

1.name: Memento Mori
1.effect: Delay-1. May delay up to +2 more turns. Per extra delay: Reaper's Touch heals +1/8 of damage.

1.name: Phantasmal Shield
1.effect: Target heals 15% of damage taken/1. Per Standard/Full hit on target: -5% (min 0%).

1.name: Stroke of Midnight
1.effect: Before damage: Reaper's Touch healing becomes +damage on this attack/1. Other Scythe healing becomes +DMG/1.

1.name: Phantom Blade
1.effect: Reaper's Touch heal on this attack = HP healed from Scythe abilities (except Phantom Blade) last round.

1.name: Whittle
1.effect: Sacrifice 10 HP: create Totem tile on target (removes existing). Range Burst 1. Type: Blood, Bone, or Soul (starts Blood). Cannot be overwritten.

1.name: Left-Hand Path
1.effect: User moves along line from origin until hitting obstruction. If no Totem: inflict -2 EVA/1 and -3 DEF/1.

1.name: Heredity
1.effect: Totem moves adjacent to target. Heal HP sacrificed to create it. If no Totem: place one on target's tile.

1.name: Feral Spark
1.effect: Target: 10% recoil/1. User's current Totem type numerical effects doubled.

1.name: Exercitus
1.effect: Gladius: swap to Scutum. Scutum: Push 3, swap to Pilum. Pilum: inflict 4 Cripple/1, swap to Gladius.

1.name: Disengage
1.effect: Gladius: inflict -2d6 DEF/1, Push 1. Scutum: half AoE damage/1, push back 1. Switch to Pilum.

1.name: Forward Jab
1.effect: Requires Pilum. +1 base dice

1.name: Breach
1.effect: Switch to Gladius or Scutum. Gladius: foes entering melee take 3d8 damage/1. Scutum: user and allies in Burst 2 cannot have DEF ignored/1.

1.name: Phalanx
1.effect: Requires Scutum. Reaction: when foe hits user or ally in user's melee. If target in melee: +1 dice, swap to Gladius. If not: swap to Pilum. Ignores outside factors, ATK/MAG, half DEF.

1.name: Deus Vult
1.effect: Requires Scutum. Before accuracy: immune to statuses and debuffs/1, remove existing.

1.name: Thwack
1.effect: Only Stun can prevent use. +1 dice per 5 ATK or MAG (whichever higher) target has above 20.

1.name: Grave of Titans
1.effect: Ignores DEF. Per 10 max HP target has above 120: +3 DMG, -1 MR. If damage reduced by foes: next Standard/Full gains +1 ACC/1, +1 CR/1, and +1 dice.

1.name: Inertial Shift
1.effect: If foe moved or attempted to move user last round: +2 dice, becomes Homing 8 (Pull 7).

1.name: Pole Vault
1.effect: Teleport to unoccupied tile in range (ignores range reduction, even on miss). Targets foes in Splash. If no foes: not an attack.

1.name: Fair Fight
1.effect: Next single-target target becomes Duel Partner/2. Ends on death or user damages other foe. User deals/takes 30 less damage from non-DP foes. If DP has allies or is monster: 5 instead.

1.name: Hardwood Slam
1.effect:
Choose status if condition met. -2 MR (Poison), +2 dice (Confusion), or heal 5 HP (Bleed).
5 Poison/2: if user ACC negative or target EVA increased.
