Confusion/2: if target's ACC caused them to hit or trigger effect on user/allies.
6 Bleed/2: if target crit or had +dice on attack on user/allies.

1.name: Exploit Feign
1.effect: inflict -4 DEF/1 or -4 DMG/1. If user debuffed by foe: cleanse before accuracy, +1 hit, debuff doubled.

1.name: Stance Breaker
1.effect: If target gained >5 DEF, HP or Shield last round: advantage dice. gain 75% of highest as Shield/1.

1.name: Defiance
1.effect: Reaction: when foe statuses user or targets outside Range 4. Teleport to unoccupied tile in their Melee. Next Standard/Full: +2 ACC

1.name: Calamitous Trance
1.effect: If target dealt 50+ to user last round: +3 dice. If 75+: +4 dice faces. -1 MR per hit on user since last turn. Confusion/2 when MR < 4.

1.name: Spurn
1.effect: If target can attack from Melee next turn but doesn't: user may AoO them at end of turn.

1.name: Figure 8
1.effect: Reaction: when foe willingly moves out of user's Range 2 from Melee

1.name: Reversal
1.effect: If target can end turn on different tile type but doesn't: gain +2 ACC/1, next attack ignores half DEF.

1.name: Wear Down
1.effect: Per MP target uses next turn: gain +3 DEF until next turn.

1.name: Guard
1.effect: Next Tonfa move: replace instances of the user with this target.

1.name: Yin Yang
1.effect: Choose Yin or Yang.\nYin: Physical/Melee. If target doesn't damage user next turn: target takes 1d8+5.\nYang: Magical/Homing 4. Foes take 1d8+5 when damaging user/1.

1.name: Standoff
1.effect: If target ends next turn in user's Melee: user may AoO (ignores ATK/MAG).

1.name: Dazing Hook
1.effect: Range cannot be reduced. If target attacked user outside Melee last round: inflict Confusion/1 and Inverse Bomb dice/1.

1.name: Tempest Sweep
1.effect: Choose Honte or Gyakute.\nHonte: Physical. Next turn: Tonfa effects lasting 1 round/turn last +1 round/turn.\nGyakute: Magical. Next Tonfa attack gains Star 2 Splash.

1.name: Feral Chop
1.effect: X = 2.5 * user's Rage.

1.name: Chain Axe
1.effect: Bloodlust grants +1 Rage per damage instance/1.

1.name: Power Swing
1.effect: Spend X Rage: -X MR

1.name: Knockback
1.effect: inflict Slow/1. Spend 1 Rage: +1 Push and/or inflict Cripple 6/1 instead.

1.name: Franciscate
1.effect: Gain +2 MP

1.name: Gash
1.effect: Spend Rage: inflict 5 Bleed/X (X = Rage spent).

1.name: Sever
1.effect: Spend Rage: +1 hit and +1 MR per Rage.

1.name: Amped Strike
1.effect: +damage = 4 * user's Rage. Lose all Rage.

1.name: Wrath
1.effect: Spend 2 Rage per effect (cost +1 each use). Choose: +4d10 base roll, Splash 2, or -3 MR. -2 ACC on Tile.

1.name: Storm Strike
1.effect: Teleport to tile in target's Splash 1. inflict Slow/1.

1.name: Seismic Smash
1.effect: inflict 2 Cripple/2.

1.name: Masonry
1.effect: If unoccupied: tile becomes Stone (acts like Ice, 30 HP, 1 EVA). Removed after 2 rounds. Can be Pushed/Pulled (no damage).

1.name: Crush
1.effect: If target cannot be pushed full distance: +1d10+5 damage.

1.name: Earth Render
1.effect: After damage or miss: replace up to 2 unoccupied tiles in Burst 2 of target with Broken (2 rounds, or until user dies/removes as Trigger).

1.name: Shockwave Slam
1.effect: Splash hits foes in target's Star. Original target: Push 2 in chosen direction. Splash targets: Push 2 away from original.

1.name: Collision Course
1.effect: Original target: Push to tile in their Range 5. Subsequent: Push to tile in their Range 3. Can Push user/allies via Unstoppable Force (no damage). Each target once.

1.name: Aftershock
1.effect: Reaction: after user pushes target. Move up to tiles pushed in that direction. Then deal 1d10+6 to foes in user's Burst 1.

1.name: Fissure
1.effect: Regardless of hit: push target. Tiles target exits while pushed become permanent Broken (unremovable, unignorable). Foes entering Burst 1 of Broken: 2d8 damage, once/turn per foe. User may remove any as Trigger on their turns.

1.name: Tomahawk Toss
1.effect: X = 4 - range used at. Apex: Pull 3

1.name: Kip Up
1.effect: Push regardless of hit. May negate Push: teleport 1 tile away from target. Ignores outside damage factors, ATK/MAG, DEF.

1.name: Repulse Slice
1.effect: No Push on Apex. Apex: per tile target moves toward user next turn: Plate Crusher values +1.

1.name: Continental Crash
1.effect: After Push: place Broken tile in target's Melee (3 rounds). User may remove as Trigger. Foes ending turn in tile's Melee: 10 damage. Apex: hits foes in target's Splash 1.

1.name: Discipline
1.effect: Start of target's next turn: gain +3X DEF/1 (X = 3 - range used). Apex: if last attack had Apex, next attack applies that Apex effects (excluding extra hits).

1.name: Kinetic Impact
1.effect: If target cannot be moved full distance: +1 dice. Apex: -2 Push, +2 dice faces.

1.name: Two Handed
1.effect: If user didn't push target last turn: +2 Push. Apex: if target can't be moved full distance: inflict 7 Bleed/1.

1.name: Elastic Collision
1.effect: Before targeting: move up to MP in straight line (half diagonals). X = 1 + tiles moved. Apex: +2 CR.

1.name: Besiege
1.effect: Before accuracy: sacrifice up to 10 HP. Gain equal Shield/1. 1.5x if target >50% HP.

1.name: Catapult Campaign
1.effect: Cannot use at Range 2. Target >75% HP: inflict 5 Bleed/1. May self-inflict 10 Bleed/1 to double Bleed.

1.name: Entrench
1.effect: If less than 6 bonus DEF: gain +3 DEF/1. Lose +1 Campaign per RtR instance/1.

1.name: The Art of War
1.effect: Choose War or Peace.\nWar: Physical. If 0 Campaigns: +dice faces = 1.5x Campaign max.\nPeace: Magical. Until next Standard/Full: target has -X/3 MP, -2X ATK/MAG (X = user's Campaigns).

1.name: Last Stand
1.effect: When user would take >55-3X damage (X = Campaign max): attacker takes 3d8+2, damage reduced by 3X/1.

1.name: Cursed Slice
1.effect: +1 CR. Target's next Standard/Full: 5% recoil. Spend 10 Resolve up to 5x: +1 CR and +5% recoil per spend.

1.name: Lunge
1.effect: Move adjacent to target (even on miss). Spend 20 Resolve up to 3x: -1 MR per spend. After damage: choose +10% damage dealt and taken/1.

1.name: Blade of Woe
1.effect: Before damage: inflict 5 Curse/1 on user and target. First Resolve spend after taking 55+ damage while Cursed: resolve effect +1/3.

1.name: Lotus Strike
1.effect: Spend all Resolve. X hits = Resolve/30. 5*X% recoil (no Resolve from recoil).

1.name: Delirium
1.effect: Spend 25 Resolve per debuff. X = Enrage: inflict -X ACC/1, -X CR/1, -X dice/1, -5X DEF/1.\nSpend 30 more: if cleansed or prevented, target gains disadvantage dice/1.

1.name: Provoke
1.effect: If target doesn't deal 45+ to user next turn: Resolve gain x1.75/1. Resolve gained since Provoke also x1.75.

1.name: Rising Sun
1.effect: Spend up to 100 Resolve: gain X% of damage as Shield/1 (X = Resolve/1.5). If first ability this turn: turn continues until another non-Standard/Full. While Shield active: healing doesn't reduce Resolve.

1.name: Giant Slayer
1.effect: If the user has less HP than the target, they may spend up to X Resolve, where X is the difference between the user's and target's HP. For every 10 Resolve spent, gain +2+Y damage, where Y is current Enrage.

1.name: Thrust
1.effect: Move to tile in target's Melee. If damage removed by outside factors: inflict 2 Bleed/1. Spend Focus: +Bleed or +1 duration.

1.name: Deflect
1.effect: Reaction: when foe attacks user. Attack loses 10% damage, store as Focus. If attack moves user: Pull 2. Ignores non-Rapier outside factors.

1.name: Counter
1.effect: Reaction/Standard: when foe deals 40+ to user. Ignores ATK/MAG/DEF and non-Rapier outside factors. Active Rapier effects +1 round. Next spent Focus x1.5.

1.name: Moulinet
1.effect: Target gains +4 DMG/1 or +4 DEF/1. Spend Focus: heal 3 HP per ability target uses next turn. If no Focus spent: next Focus gains half-value Focus.

1.name: Redoublement
1.effect: Spend any Focus: +1 hit per Focus. Each Focus hit: +CR equal to Focus value.

1.name: One for All
1.effect: Ignores 1/4 DEF. May change splash: Star 2 (1/2 DEF) or Line 2 (3/4 DEF). Per target: gain Focus = DEF ignored.

1.name: Rototill
1.effect: Physical or Magical. If target on non-Normal tile: lose Pull 3, gain +1 ACC and +1 dice.

1.name: Bioturbation
1.effect: If non-Normal tile in Burst 1: move to same tile type within Range 8. Pass through players (cannot end farther from target). Players passed through: -7 DEF/1, -1 EVA/1.

1.name: Blackthorn
1.effect: Physical or Magical. Before damage: targets invert positive tile effects/1. +4 dice on secondary targets.

1.name: Wildfire
1.effect: If target on Forest: set Wildfire on that tile and adjacent Forest tiles.\nWildfire: lasts 2 rounds. Start of turn on Wildfire: 3d4 damage, -7 damage on next Standard/Full.

1.name: Nature's Madness
1.effect: Immune to Air tiles. Augmented by X = number of certain tile types in Burst 1. After damage: convert used tiles to Normal.\nAir/Sticky/Boost: +X Range and damage (max 3). If X>1: +1 target.\nForest/Water/Lava/Ice: choose type, inflict X status/1. If X>3: extend 1 round.

1.name: Scorched Earth
1.effect: Before Push: tiles in target's Star 1 become Lava. Counts as user damage. Once per turn per entity.

1.name: The Serenity of Nature
1.effect: If attacked or attacked: sacrifice 50-100 HP and max HP. Summon Nature Spirit in Melee (acts after user). Win requires both defeated. Disabled after use.\nNature Spirit: 125% sacrificed HP | 17 ATK/MAG | 5 DEF | 1 EVA | 4 MP. Moves: Basic Abilities, Terraform (1 tile), Rototill, Bioturbation, Wildfire, Bloom, Flower Crown.

1.name: Fireball
1.effect: Spend 2 Mana. May spend more: +1 base dice per extra Mana. If any damage dice roll 1: inflict 3 Burn/1.

1.name: Hex
1.effect: Spend 3 Mana. Next Standard/Full on each target: +2 ACC

1.name: Plague
1.effect: Spend 3 Mana. Choose Bleed, Burn, Curse, or Poison. inflict 3 [status]/1. Spend +1 Mana: /2.

1.name: Faith
1.effect: Spend 2 Mana. Heal target equal to roll instead of damage. If Spellwoven: remains attack, targeting becomes Ally/Allies (only players attacked by foe last round).

1.name: Scourge
1.effect: Spend 4 Mana. Choose one non-Basic, non-Lv 1, non-EX move per target. Targets cannot use selected moves/1.

1.name: Tornado
1.effect: Spend 1 Mana. Move up to half MP (round down) and swap with target via teleport. Cannot move after.

1.name: Maelstrom
1.effect: Spend 6 Mana. Choose 2 effects: +5 damage, +2 ACC, +5 DEF/1 on hit, or +3 MP/2 on hit.

1.name: Resonate
1.effect: Restores a use after Standard/Full Talisman ability. Gain one buff: +3 DMG, +3 PDEF, +3 MDEF, or +1 ACC.

1.name: Smite
1.effect: Before accuracy: choose a buff to channel/1. May be non-damaging Swift on self.

1.name: Compass
1.effect: Gain +2 ACC. If miss while channeled: gain +3 CR.

1.name: Seal of Solomon
1.effect: Choose a channeled buff: invert and apply as debuff/1. inflict Confusion/1.

1.name: Transcendence
1.effect: Before accuracy: convert +ACC to +CR, +DMG to +PDEF or +MDEF (and vice versa). Converted buffs channeled/1.

1.name: Judgment
1.effect: inflict Evil Eye permanently.\nEvil Eye: debuffs on player last +1 round. Start of turn: take d4+2 per debuff. Talisman heals equal damage dealt.

1.name: Card Flip
1.effect: Roll d3 after damage. 1: 0.8x damage. 3: 1.3x damage. Outside factors also affected.

1.name: Discard
1.effect: Roll d20. 15+: store reroll (Once/Trigger) for any Cards effect.

1.name: Roulette
1.effect: Roll 1d8 for status on foe, then d3. 1 on d3: inflict on self instead. 1=10 Bleed/1, 2=10 Poison/1, 3=10 Burn/1, 4=6 Cripple/1, 5=Root/1, 6=Seal/1, 7=Stun/1, 8=Confusion/1.

1.name: Gamble
1.effect: Roll d7. 1: subtract target ATK and MAG. 2: subtract target's higher offense. 3: subtract user ATK. 4: add user ATK. 5: add target's higher offense. 6: add user MAG again. 7: add user ATK and target ATK/MAG. Adds user MAG

1.name: Double or Nothing
1.effect: Roll d2. 1: target cannot use Swift/Free until end of user's next turn. 2: target gains +1 Swift (or multiple Free) until user's next turn. Self: must use at start of turn.

1.name: Blackjack
1.effect: On a successful hit, roll 2d10, treating 1s as either 1 or 11 (user's choice). The user may choose to roll additional 1d10s to add to the roll. If the total is 17-20, this attack gains 1 base dice. On a total of 21, this attack instead gains 3 base dice and activates Jackpot. On a total of 22 or higher, the attack instead loses 2 base dice.

1.name: Craps
1.effect: Bomb dice. Per Bomb trigger: choose another foe in target's Splash 1 (once per foe). 5+ Bomb: Jackpot. Immune to non-Cards positive damage factors. Crit extra dice: no Bomb.

1.name: Slots Spin
1.effect: Roll 3d4. Per 4: +1 dice. No 4s: -1 dice. All 4s: +1 more dice.

1.name: Hi-Lo
1.effect: Roll d10. Predict higher or lower, then roll again. Correct: +2 base dice, continue (max 5). Wrong: stop, lose half base dice. Same roll: reroll.

1.name: Stacked Deck
1.effect:
In place of an accuracy roll, roll a 1d14 for an effect. 
1. The opponent is healed by the roll, 
2. The user takes 2x damage from all sources for one round,
3. The attack misses, 
4. After damage, the user and target swap their current HP (can overheal, foes with over 200 HP are considered to have 200 HP for this effect), 
5. For one round, attacks automatically hit the user,
6. The user and target gain a random position change,
7. The user and target are both Stunned/1,
8. 50% of this attack's damage is dealt to a random foe instead,
9. For one round, the user's attacks automatically hit,
10. The user gains a 1/Any/Global Once/Reaction: "Reroll one accuracy roll.",
11. Cleanse all statuses and numerical debuffs from the user & reset their other moves' frequencies,
12. Target is Sealed/1, 
13. Next turn, the user may choose numbers for their cards effects, rather than rolling dice for them,
14. This attack has unremovable thrice base dice.

1.name: Moonblast
1.effect: Next Phase effect value +1.

1.name: Dark Reflection
1.effect: inflict inverse of user's Phase/1.

1.name: Holy Light
1.effect: If Moonblast or Celestial Blessing active: target's statuses (except Seal/Stun) +1 round.

1.name: Lunar Shift
1.effect: Shift to next Phase. If Moonblast active: transfer to new Phase.

1.name: Harvest Moon
1.effect: New/Full Moon: heal 1d10+2. Otherwise: no Phase shift next turn. May be non-attack Standard.

1.name: Double Tide
1.effect: Crit on 16+. If at least 1 crit: gain Moonblast effect.

1.name: Gravity Crash
1.effect:
Effect varies by Phase.
New Moon: Homing 4, target cannot use limited moves/1.
Waxing: Push 1d6, inflict 4 Cripple/2.
Full Moon: foes deal 75% to allies in Range 5/1.
Waning: Bomb dice.

1.name: Augur
1.effect: Delay-1: +5 DMG or +3 CR. Delay-2: both.

1.name: Eventide
1.effect: Delay-1. Target gains 3 Curse until Eventide lands. Delay-2: Curse -DEF +2.

1.name: Echo Burst
1.effect: Delay-1: lose Splash, gain +5 DEF until lands. Cannot stack.

1.name: Omen
1.effect: Next attack: +1 delay

1.name: Corruption
1.effect: On hit: target takes 5% of max HP over 100 damage. Up to Delay-2: +5*Delay%. Until lands: damaging statuses deal bonus = half on-hit damage.

1.name: Astral Touch
1.effect: If target kills user within 1 round: reduce delays on them by 1. If target dies within 1 round: transfer one delay to new target in original's Range 7.

1.name: Foresight
1.effect: Reaction: when user attacked, after damage rolled. Remove 10% damage. Add to: 1) delayed attacks, or 2) user's HP x number of delayed attacks.

1.name: Dawn Break
1.effect: Delay-2. Until lands: attacks on target have -1 MR. +1 Delay: +1 more -1 MR.

1.name: Oracle
1.effect: Add or remove 1 delay from any number of delayed attacks. May be self-targeting non-damaging Movement+Swift.

1.name: Prophecy
1.effect: Per delayed move that landed start of turn: +2.5 ACC, +2 DMG. Delay-1/2: lose prior bonuses, gain +8 DMG per delayed move landing with Prophecy. Updates when delays used.

1.name: Dirty Trick
1.effect: Choose Push/Pull, Splash, Buff, or Status. Target's Standard attacks lack chosen attribute/1.

1.name: Fancy Footwork
1.effect: Choose Trip or Slip. Trip: target must move 2+ tiles per direction/1. Slip: teleport to entity's Melee within Range 4.

1.name: Scallywag Slice
1.effect: Choose Outwit or Befuddle. Outwit: +1 CR, target's CR = 1 on first hit of next Standard. Befuddle: target ignores positive tile effects/1.

1.name: Blinding Sheen
1.effect: Spend 1 Coin: inflict -DEF equal to damage this turn. Ignores outside factors, ATK/MAG, DEF.

1.name: Boot Pin
1.effect: Choose: inflict 6 Poison/2 or 6 Cripple/2. Start of turn: gain +3 DMG/1 per 6 damage from these statuses. Target may remove one status as Swift.

1.name: Shady Bet
1.effect: If gaining Coin from this attack: gain Trick Coin instead (choose Swindler effect). May spend Coin to gain Trick Coin (ignores Scoundrel).

1.name: High Ground
1.effect: Choose Pistol or Taunt. Pistol: AoE/Foes/Pierce 5, targets' Items become Movement/1. Taunt: targets' AoE become Pierce, must target user/1.

1.name: Swashbuckler
1.effect: Choose Cruel, Sly, or Daring. Cruel: +1 dice. Sly: before accuracy, end target's duration buffs/debuffs. Daring: 10 Shield/1.

1.name: Captain's Order
1.effect: Target chooses Plank or Marooning. Plank: Push 2, 4 damage per ongoing Cutlass effect on target. Marooning: target's next Standard: 25% recoil.

1.name: Twin Fangs
1.effect: Per hit: lose 2 Blood.\nThirst 5: +3 MR, Double Hit.

1.name: Draw Blood
1.effect: Ignores ATK/DEF. Auto-hits (rolls accuracy). +1 MP this turn. If 5+ damage: +1 Blood, next attack this turn +1 base dice.

1.name: Uninvited Guest
1.effect: If first attack on target: gain 2 Blood.\nIf one attacked other last turn but not reciprocated: +8 CR.

1.name: Indulge
1.effect: Ignores target DEF.\nThirst 7: on hit, lose half Blood (round up), heal 30% damage, cannot gain Blood until next turn.\nThirst 10: no effects.

1.name: Night Visitor
1.effect: Requires foe damaged this game not in melee. Before accuracy: teleport to melee of target.\nThirst 5: hits foes in Star 1 after teleport, inflict Slow/1.\nThirst 9: usable in melee, Star 2, lose 1 Blood +1 per hit.

1.name: Savage Spin-out
1.effect: Splash: Beam 1 behind target. Original: Pull 3. Splash targets: Push 1.

1.name: Silk Cocoon
1.effect: Create Silk Cocoon (Star tile) on unoccupied tile. Replaces existing. Acts like Ice (25 HP). User deals max 15 damage to it. Scissors effects ignore its Ice Clause. Tiles in Burst 1: +1 MP to enter. Does not stack. Range cannot be increased.

1.name: Debilitate
1.effect: Ignores 4 DEF, +4 per Ramping Magic proc. If ignores all target MDEF: triggers Ramping Magic.

2.name: Void's Call
2.effect: Pull targets towards Totem tile instead of user.

2.name: Disarm
2.effect: Each target's next Standard/Full on user: -1 dice

2.name: Bushido
2.effect: Choose up to 2 allies. Gain Resolve = 50% of damage they took from attacks that didn't target user/1.

2.name: En Garde
2.effect: Spend up to 2 Focus. Per Focus: target gains HP or +DEF/1 equal to its value. May move 2 tiles after next reaction.

2.name: Patinando
2.effect: Per dice 4+: +1 Push. Per dice <4: inflict 3 Cripple/1 (stacking). After damage: spend Focus to replace dice with its value.

2.name: Fog
2.effect: Spend 3 Mana. Targets cannot target beyond this move's range/1. Half MAG beyond Range 2.

2.name: Serpent's Gate
2.effect: Before accuracy: channel ACC and CR until next turn. Per accuracy 11+: +1 dice. If not: -1 dice.

2.name: Blood Moon
2.effect: Waxing/Waning: inflict 2d6 Poison/1. Otherwise: inflict 3d4 Bleed/1.

2.name: Fatal Moonlight
2.effect:
Two effects if user has 2 Phases.
New Moon: Seal/1 on max range target.
Waxing: permanent +2d6 DEF.
Full Moon: +2 targets.
Waning: ignores negative damage factors.

2.name: Otherworldly Attraction
2.effect: Accuracy per target. Statuses from this move ignored when moving toward user.\ninflict Slow/1.\nThirst 4: inflict Cripple 4/1.

4.name: Fateweave
4.effect: Choose Delay 1-5. Per foe dying on landing turn: permanent +2 ACC, +4 CR. After lands: delays <= 2 land immediately on user death. Disabled after hit. Ignores ATK/MAG and outside factors. Gains use on miss.

AoE.name: Rising Hope
AoE.effect: gain +1 ACC/1 and +1 CR/1. Max 2 Rising Hopes affecting a player.

AoE.name: Dissonance
AoE.effect: inflict 3 Bleed/1. Ignores ATK/MAG, half DEF, and outside damage factors. If target hit twice, +3 DMG/1.

AoE.name: Primadonna
AoE.effect: If origin has more MAG: gain +4 MAG/1 and -3 MDEF/1. If not: gain +4 ATK/1 and -3 MDEF/1. Targets with both ATK and MAG buffed also gain +1 dice/1, doubled on crit.

AoE.name: Ward
AoE.effect: Cannot be inflicted with debuffs or statuses/1.

AoE.name: Emboîté
AoE.effect: Targets' abilities on cooldown: use 1 round earlier (E3T->EoT, EoT->Every Turn).

AoE.name: Pierce
AoE.effect: If target has 1+ Marks: ignores EVA and 1/4 DEF. If 2+ Marks: also ignores negative ACC modifiers and ignores 1/2 DEF.

AoE.name: Quiver of Thunder
AoE.effect: Foes: can only target entities in their Line 8/1. If attack user in Melee: gain +1 Mark.

AoE.name: Windmill
AoE.effect: Non-Foe targets: gain +X ACC or CR/1 (X = players in range). As Swift: buffs halved. Attack only as Standard against Foes.

AoE.name: Sagittarian Pride
AoE.effect: Hits = number of moves targets used since user's last turn.

AoE.name: Overdraw
AoE.effect: Next attack gains one bonus:\nIf single-hit: non-duration numbers doubled (including X).\nIf multi-hit: +ACC treated as +dice faces on accuracy rolls.

AoE.name: Defile
AoE.effect: inflict 3 Curse/1. When foe takes Curse damage: user takes equal CP.

AoE.name: Pentagram
AoE.effect: Start of next turn: foes in user's Burst 1 take 2d6+3 + user's CP damage.

AoE.name: Haunted Swing
AoE.effect: Targets at full HP: +5 damage. Heal 5 HP per target triggered.

AoE.name: Wither Soul
AoE.effect: Per debuff or status on target: Reaper's Touch heals +3 HP.

AoE.name: Blasphemy
AoE.effect: inflict 6 Curse/1. While Cursed: targeting an ally extends Curse 1 round.

AoE.name: Ancestral Wrath
AoE.effect:
Requires Totem within Range 5. Targets within Totem range. Effects by type:
Blood: targets cannot leave Totem range/1.
Bone: cleanse debuffs/statuses on allies, cleanse buffs on foes in range.
Soul: heal allies in range for 1/3 of damage dealt.

AoE.name: Shield Wall
AoE.effect: Requires Gladius or Pilum. Switch to Scutum. Flat modifier on base rolls targeting user becomes negative/1. May be non-damaging Standard.

AoE.name: Invigorate
AoE.effect: Bonus varies by subweapon.\nGladius: +5 DMG/1. Scutum: 7 Shield/1. Pilum: +1 ACC/1 and +1 CR/1.

AoE.name: Impede
AoE.effect: Pilum: steal targets' buffs (duration 1). Switch to Scutum.\nScutum: becomes AoE/Foes/Beam 4. Switch to Gladius.\nGladius: gain +1 MP/1, reduce other cooldowns 1 round. Switch to Pilum.

AoE.name: Gale Force
AoE.effect: Regardless of accuracy: teleport any targets to any unoccupied tiles in range. Not an attack on Allies or when Movement.

AoE.name: Wide Slash
AoE.effect: Up to 2x: spend 2 Rage for +1 range.

AoE.name: Cyclone Sweep
AoE.effect: +dice = number of targets hit.

AoE.name: Lagging Spin
AoE.effect: Ignores 4 DEF per MP spent moving away from start tile. If all MP spent moving away: +2 dice.

AoE.name: Razor Rust
AoE.effect: Target: 3 MP/1. Apex: inflict 5 Cripple/1.

AoE.name: Supreme Strikes
AoE.effect: 1 Push per hit. May target in two directions, or +1 hit in one direction. Each direction: accuracy and Apex independently. Apex: +2 hits in this direction.

AoE.name: Bastion
AoE.effect: Foe attacks entering user's Cone 1: lose 2 dice/1. While in Melee of current tile: +4 DEF.

AoE.name: Ambush
AoE.effect: Lose all Campaigns. Coronation disabled until next turn. Per Campaign lost: gain +0.5 MP/1

AoE.name: Crusade
AoE.effect: Until next turn: gain +1 MP

AoE.name: War of Attrition
AoE.effect: Before damage: inflict inverse of user's active RtR bonuses/1.

AoE.name: Shock and Awe
AoE.effect: If 3+ Campaigns: attacks on user immune to positive outside factors/1.

AoE.name: Bloodspill
AoE.effect: Spend 40 Resolve: Burst 1 or Cone 2. Spend 70: Burst 2 or Cone 3. Per kill: no use consumed, +1 Enrage, advantage threshold -20.

AoE.name: Point-in-Line
AoE.effect: inflict -2 dice faces/1. If debuff not active: gain +2 dice faces/1. Spend Focus: increase one effect by half.

AoE.name: Feint
AoE.effect: Targets take half of out-of-turn damage from user/1. Spend Focus: target gains Focus*2% recoil/1.

AoE.name: Hydrolysis
AoE.effect: +2 dice faces per foe on Water or Lava.

AoE.name: Windstorm
AoE.effect: Push targets in cone direction. Place 4 Air, 4 Sticky, or 1 Boost tile(s) in range. Existing Windstorm tiles become Normal. May be non-damaging Standard on tiles.

AoE.name: Flower Crown
AoE.effect: Forest: +10% DMG/1. Water: heal 5d4 HP. Standard: doubles to 20% and 10d4. Cannot target players on neither.

AoE.name: Sandstorm
AoE.effect: Spend 3 Mana. Targets: -25% damage on next Standard/Full. Push in Beam direction.

AoE.name: Absolution
AoE.effect: Choose a target. Inflict target's debuffs on all other targets/1. Cleanse allies in range.

AoE.name: Providence
AoE.effect: Choose PDEF or MDEF to channel and apply to allies in range/1. May be non-damaging Standard.

AoE.name: Echo of Light
AoE.effect: Next turn: channeled buffs doubled.

AoE.name: Tidal Wave
AoE.effect: inflict Confusion/1. New Moon: +AoE range.

AoE.name: Celestial Blessing
AoE.effect: Until next turn: targets gain user's next Phase effect. User's Phase disabled next turn.

AoE.name: Scry
AoE.effect: Delay-1: Cone +1. Choose target: +10*X% of total delay on target to attack (X = targets).

AoE.name: Blood Wave
AoE.effect: If attacked multiple times last turn: gain 1 Blood before Thirst.\nThirst 3: inflict -X DEF/2 (X = Blood).\nThirst 5: may become AoE/Foes/Beam 5.

AoE.name: Blood Whirl
AoE.effect: Accuracy per target. Lose X Blood (X = targets hit).\nThirst 4: Star 2.\nThirst 7: before accuracy, teleport up to 2 tiles.

AoE.name: Sanguine Explosion
AoE.effect: Reaction: when reaching 10 Blood. inflict Slow/1. Also usable without use on foe death: originates from foe, Burst 2, loses Push.

AoE.name: Lasting Cuts
AoE.effect: inflict 3 Cripple/1. If already Crippled: Cripple +2, duration set to 1.

AoE.name: Piercing Jab
AoE.effect: Per 30 damage taken since last turn: +1 dice, range upgrade (Pierce -> Beam -> Cone).

AoE.name: Enchanted Blade
AoE.effect: inflict 4 Curse/1 or 4 Bleed/1. Multiple targets: both (damage does not stack).

AoE.name: Handle Bash
AoE.effect: Pull 1 or Push 1. Teleport to Beam 2 in attack direction (Push) or opposite (Pull). Next turn: target's actions cost 1 MP.

AoE.name: Weaver's Whirl
AoE.effect: gain 2d8 Shield/1. When Shield breaks: foes in Star 1: inflict -2 MP/1 (max -4).

AoE.name: Thirteenfold Cut
AoE.effect: Choose up to 3: inflict -5 DEF/1. Targets may negate. Per negation: user gains +4 DEF/1.

AoE.name: Guillotine
AoE.effect: Starts at 0 uses. Gains use on Ramping Magic proc. +1 dice per Ramping Magic proc, -1 dice per target.

Other/Special.name: Duet
Other/Special.effect: Apply Duet to one player. Bard abilities also originate from that player. May end Duet. Effects stack in overlap; Bard attack targets take +1 hit.

Other/Special.name: Fantasia
Other/Special.effect: Choose: +3 ATK/MAG, +1 ACC/CR, or +4 DEF. Until next turn, Rising Hope becomes Star 2 and grants all selected Fantasia bonuses. Cannot choose same bonus more than once.

Other/Special.name: Smokescreen
Other/Special.effect: Until next turn: attacks entering Burst 2 have -2 Range, -7 DMG. Attacks used within Burst 2 have -2 Range.

Other/Special.name: Reforge
Other/Special.effect: Choose one base stat (except HP). Foe: reduce by 1/3/1, cannot receive buffs to that stat. Ally: multiply by 1.5/1.

Other/Special.name: First Aid
Other/Special.effect: Heal target for rolled amount. If ally: may use as Standard to add ATK or MAG. Can only target if attacked in last round.

Other/Special.name: Ward
Other/Special.effect: Cannot be inflicted with debuffs or statuses/1.

Other/Special.name: Heaven's Wind
Other/Special.effect: Swap targets.

Other/Special.name: Pas de Deux
Other/Special.effect: Target takes turn immediately after user. Target cannot use Pas de Deux that turn. If Standard: target loses Movement. Juggernaut target: only 1 Standard.

Other/Special.name: Emboîté
Other/Special.effect: Targets' abilities on cooldown: use 1 round earlier (E3T->EoT, EoT->Every Turn).

Other/Special.name: Fouetté
Other/Special.effect: Until next turn: target may use one Once/Twice/Thrice move without expending a use. Cannot target Reactions or Triggers.

Other/Special.name: En Pointe
Other/Special.effect: May use Class and Item Swift actions as Free. When targeting ally with Dancer action: gain copy of this passive until end of next turn.

Other/Special.name: Divertissement
Other/Special.effect: Target's next Standard/Full attack next turn: gain +dice faces equal to actions used that turn (max +5). Unaffected by En Pointe.

Other/Special.name: Qi Force
Other/Special.effect: After non-Free/Swift attack: gain 1 Qi (max 5). Gain +2 ATK/MAG per Qi. Max 2 Qi between turns. Ally dies: gain 1 Qi.

Other/Special.name: Eightfold Shield
Other/Special.effect: Spend 2+ Qi: gain +1d4+1 DEF per Qi spent./1

Other/Special.name: Conversion
Other/Special.effect: Spend 1-3 Qi. This turn: attacks become opposite damage type, swap ATK and MAG. Per Qi spent: ignore 5 DEF and gain +1 Range.

Other/Special.name: Nirvana
Other/Special.effect: Spend any Qi. Next attack: gain +1 dice and +2 DMG per Qi spent.

Other/Special.name: Aegis
Other/Special.effect: Reaction: When ally in Homing 4 damaged by attack. Move adjacent to ally. Redirect 25% of attack damage to user. User not considered target if not already.

Other/Special.name: Impasse
Other/Special.effect: Choose: ally/self, or foe. Ally/self: cannot be inflicted with Push/Pull or stat reduction by foes/1. Foe: remove target's buffs.

Other/Special.name: Radiance
Other/Special.effect: Until next turn: user takes 80% damage from attacks. Aegis redirects 50%.

Other/Special.name: Rewind
Other/Special.effect: Reaction: When user or foe attacking user rolls attack damage. Reroll up to 3 damage dice. Rerolled dice cannot trigger or negate Bomb dice.

Other/Special.name: Superposition
Other/Special.effect: Roll d20 and store (max 1). Reaction: before user accuracy check, substitute stored roll. Reaction: when foe attacks in Range 4 after accuracy, replace accuracy with stored roll (cannot cause miss).

Other/Special.name: Fractal Division
Other/Special.effect: This turn: next single-target attack targets 2 foes in Range 4. Loses Splash. User picks target for secondary effects.

Other/Special.name: Time's Edge
Other/Special.effect: This turn: gain +1 Standard (MR -3). Next 2 Standard/Full: 25% ATK/MAG. If first deals damage, second ignores outside damage factors and ATK/MAG/DEF. Only Reactions and Triggers between these actions.

Other/Special.name: Adrenaline
Other/Special.effect: Backstep penalty: -1 MP (instead of -2). May use Basic Movement multiple times per turn.

Other/Special.name: Lightspeed
Other/Special.effect: If target Dashes before user's next turn: choose Glide or Rushdown. Glide: move 2 tiles per MP (max 12). Rushdown: after Dash, Standard in Melee (max 10 tiles, immune to AoO).

Other/Special.name: Outmaneuver
Other/Special.effect: Spend any MP. Until next turn: attacks from max range gain +1 ACC per 2 MP spent.

Other/Special.name: Quick Thinking
Other/Special.effect: After last Standard: spend MP, move 1 tile per 2 MP. Ignores Backstep penalty.

Other/Special.name: Tunneling
Other/Special.effect: This turn: move through tiles and foes as Normal tiles. Cannot end turn on obstructions or Broken tiles.

Other/Special.name: Wormhole
Other/Special.effect: Place Wormhole on target tile. Swift: user or ally spends half MP (rounded up) to teleport to Wormhole. Expires on use or after 2 rounds.

Other/Special.name: Hunter's Mark
Other/Special.effect: When Crossbow attack resolves: targets gain 1 Mark. Attacks deal +1d4 damage per Mark on target. Marks only apply to their user's abilities.

Other/Special.name: Bolt Compaction
Other/Special.effect: This turn: Standard Crossbow attacks lose secondary effects. Next turn: first Standard attack gains +1 dice and the negated effects.

Other/Special.name: Shadow Quiver
Other/Special.effect: Next Standard attack becomes Magical, treats non-player obstructions as Air, ignores non-targets. Loses 2 damage per Air tile passed through.

Other/Special.name: Final Hour
Other/Special.effect: Next attack: Hunter's Mark gains +4 dice faces.

Other/Special.name: Bolt Arsenal
Other/Special.effect:
When using single-target Standard Crossbow attack: choose one Bolt.
Bounty Bolt: target gains half the Marks of latest slain foe.
Split-Head Bolt: targets another foe, loses Splash.
Reeling Bolt: Pull target to tile in user's Line 3-6.
Each Bolt: once until refresh. Swift: refresh Bolts.

Other/Special.name: Quiver of Thunder
Other/Special.effect: Foes: can only target entities in their Line 8/1. If attack user in Melee: gain +1 Mark.

Other/Special.name: Dispell Bow
Other/Special.effect: This turn: +2 MP, ranged attacks Range becomes 3. Next turn: +1 MP, ranged attacks Range becomes 6.

Other/Special.name: Sniper's Focus
Other/Special.effect: This turn: Standard actions become Full. Range 7+ effects trigger at Range 4+.

Other/Special.name: Bound Gauntlet
Other/Special.effect: After Physical attack: deal magic damage equal to damage dealt (after DEF) to different foe in Melee. After Magical attack: next Physical attack ignores 5 DEF and cannot miss.

Other/Special.name: Tactical Sniper
Other/Special.effect: Game start: designate Bounty. Attacks on Bounty: treat obstructions as Air, +1 Range. Melee on Bounty: +1 dice. Bounty dies: designate new Bounty.

Other/Special.name: Hawkeye
Other/Special.effect: Gain +2 ACC on all attacks. Trigger before Standard: sacrifice up to 5 ACC, gain equal CR until next turn.

Other/Special.name: Crimson Pact
Other/Special.effect: When user damages a foe: sacrifice 10% of damage dealt as HP (if able). Gain permanent bonus damage equal to HP sacrificed. CP gained from effect-derived sources.

Other/Special.name: Sanctified Blade
Other/Special.effect: Next single-target attack: CP sacrifice +10%. If foe targeted user since last turn: +5%.

Other/Special.name: Black Magic
Other/Special.effect: Per 5 CP: +1 DEF. Per 7 CP: +1 ACC. Per 10 CP: +1 dice.

Other/Special.name: Covenant
Other/Special.effect: Target shares user's Black Magic buffs and gains CP passive/1. CP gained by target applies to user instead.

Other/Special.name: Oblation
Other/Special.effect: Next attack this turn: double damage from CP.

Other/Special.name: Total Depravity
Other/Special.effect: CP sacrifice +5%. Start of turn: if attacked last turn, take damage equal to CP. Cannot kill user.

Other/Special.name: Immortal Coil
Other/Special.effect: First death: set to 1 HP, take turn immediately. Immune to damage during bonus turn. Then take overkill damage. Turn order resumes.

Other/Special.name: Quietus
Other/Special.effect: Attacks auto-hit and kill targets below 25% HP.

Other/Special.name: Whittle
Other/Special.effect: Sacrifice 10 HP: create Totem tile on target (removes existing). Range Burst 1. Type: Blood, Bone, or Soul (starts Blood). Cannot be overwritten.

Other/Special.name: Totem of Blood
Other/Special.effect: Totem becomes Blood. Within Homing 6 of Blood Totem: may originate Totem moves from it. gain +5 DMG, -1 Range.

Other/Special.name: Totem of Bone
Other/Special.effect: Totem becomes Bone. Within range: +5 DEF, immune to AoE and Splash from foes outside range.

Other/Special.name: Totem of Soul
Other/Special.effect: Totem becomes Soul. User and allies: sacrifice 8 HP (Every Turn Free) within range. gain +1 MP

Other/Special.name: Animatus
Other/Special.effect: Non-Animated Totem on unoccupied tile: becomes Animated. Sacrifice any HP: becomes Totem's HP, gained as Shield/1. Animated Totem is allied entity, shares user's DEF. Removed when user or Totem at 0 HP.\nWith Animated Totem: move up to MP, deal 3d10 to foes in Totem range.

Other/Special.name: Egregore
Other/Special.effect: When user kills foe: Animated Totem gains overkill as HP. If not Animated: becomes Animated with HP = overkill. Choose one active ability from foe: Animated Totems may use it for rest of game (replaces Animatus damage).

Other/Special.name: Triumvirate
Other/Special.effect: Swap subweapons (Standard). Gladius: +1 dice. Scutum: ranged attacks on user lose 5 damage. Pilum: Melee attacks gain +3 Range. Swapping from effects: always occurs. Start in Gladius.

Other/Special.name: Iberian Steel
Other/Special.effect: Subweapons are used on weapon attack/standard. Next attack in least-used subweapon: +1 dice. If 2+ fewer uses: also +2 ACC.

Other/Special.name: Dual Wield
Other/Special.effect: Before moving: MP halved

Other/Special.name: Hastiliarius
Other/Special.effect: Subweapon bonuses:\nGladius: +0.5X dice. Scutum: +X DEF. Pilum: +0.5X ACC.\nX = uses of least used subweapon.

Other/Special.name: Adaptive
Other/Special.effect: When user misses Standard/Full: buffs apply to next Standard/Full, which gains +2 ACC, 10% of missed damage, and ignores 5 DEF.

Other/Special.name: Fair Fight
Other/Special.effect: Next single-target target becomes Duel Partner/2. Ends on death or user damages other foe. User deals/takes 30 less damage from non-DP foes. If DP has allies or is monster: 5 instead.

Other/Special.name: Defiance
Other/Special.effect: Reaction: when foe statuses user or targets outside Range 4. Teleport to unoccupied tile in their Melee. Next Standard/Full: +2 ACC

Other/Special.name: Paragon
Other/Special.effect: Adaptive numerical bonuses tripled. Turns: gain 5X Shield, attacks +5X% damage. X = times targeted by foes since last turn.

Other/Special.name: Martial Mastery
Other/Special.effect: Move up to MP+1, all tiles except final treated as Normal. This turn: attacks ignore obstructions and DEF, invert foe's negative outside damage factors.

Other/Special.name: Wear Down
Other/Special.effect: Per MP target uses next turn: gain +3 DEF until next turn.

Other/Special.name: Guard
Other/Special.effect: Next Tonfa move: replace instances of the user with this target.

Other/Special.name: Yin Yang
Other/Special.effect: Choose Yin or Yang.\nYin: Physical/Melee. If target doesn't damage user next turn: target takes 1d8+5.\nYang: Magical/Homing 4. Foes take 1d8+5 when damaging user/1.

Other/Special.name: Hold Over
Other/Special.effect: Declare range type. If foes target user with attacks of that range type outside Melee: user may AoO/1.

Other/Special.name: Aikido
Other/Special.effect: When user uses 2 attacks of same damage type in one turn: gain +2 DEF and ATK/MAG of opposite type. Resets if effect doesn't occur.

Other/Special.name: Tempest Sweep
Other/Special.effect: Choose Honte or Gyakute.\nHonte: Physical. Next turn: Tonfa effects lasting 1 round/turn last +1 round/turn.\nGyakute: Magical. Next Tonfa attack gains Star 2 Splash.

Other/Special.name: Bloodlust
Other/Special.effect: When user deals or takes 15+ damage: gain 1 Rage.

Other/Special.name: Vindictive
Other/Special.effect: Gain 2 Rage on kill or miss.

Other/Special.name: Swing Cycle
Other/Special.effect: Start of turn: spend 2 Rage to reset cooldowns/frequencies of last 2 attacks.\nChain Axe becomes EoT. Start with 1 Rage.

Other/Special.name: Unstoppable Force
Other/Special.effect: If foe blocks target from full Push: that foe is hit and targeted. Pushed towards where target would have reached.

Other/Special.name: Masonry
Other/Special.effect: If unoccupied: tile becomes Stone (acts like Ice, 30 HP, 1 EVA). Removed after 2 rounds. Can be Pushed/Pulled (no damage).

Other/Special.name: Stonemason
Other/Special.effect: Hammer effects ignore Ice Clause on player-created tiles.

Other/Special.name: Gravity Well
Other/Special.effect: Next attack this turn: before accuracy, choose non-Splash target. Pull another entity in target's Burst 2 to tile in target's Burst 1.

Other/Special.name: Aftershock
Other/Special.effect: Reaction: after user pushes target. Move up to tiles pushed in that direction. Then deal 1d10+6 to foes in user's Burst 1.

Other/Special.name: Heavy Weapon
Other/Special.effect: Cannot leave foe's Melee without teleporting. Tomahawk ability at max listed range: gains Apex. Apex includes final row/column of Beam.

Other/Special.name: Plate Crusher
Other/Special.effect: When user moves foe with non-Apex Tomahawk: foe takes 2 damage per tile. Apex attacks ignore 5 DEF.

Other/Special.name: Discipline
Other/Special.effect: Start of target's next turn: gain +3X DEF/1 (X = 3 - range used). Apex: if last attack had Apex, next attack applies that Apex effects (excluding extra hits).

Other/Special.name: Fleet Footwork
Other/Special.effect: Once per turn: after Apex attack, teleport user or target up to 2 tiles.

Other/Special.name: Line Out
Other/Special.effect: If next attack can target a foe in Apex: range may be treated as Pierce instead of Line.

Other/Special.name: Right to Rule
Other/Special.effect: Start with 3 Campaigns (max 3). Each: +2 DEF. Lose 1 when dealing or receiving 10+ damage at once.\nAttack with 0 Campaigns: +1 dice, +1 ACC.

Other/Special.name: Coronation
Other/Special.effect: Reaction/Trigger: when reaching 0 Campaigns, or start of turn with 0. Right to Rule max +1. Gain max Campaigns.

Other/Special.name: Crusade
Other/Special.effect: Until next turn: gain +1 MP

Other/Special.name: The Art of War
Other/Special.effect: Choose War or Peace.\nWar: Physical. If 0 Campaigns: +dice faces = 1.5x Campaign max.\nPeace: Magical. Until next Standard/Full: target has -X/3 MP, -2X ATK/MAG (X = user's Campaigns).

Other/Special.name: Declaration of War
Other/Special.effect: Gain +1.5 DEF per Campaign. Start with 0 or 4 Campaigns (choice).

Other/Special.name: Imperial Tyranny
Other/Special.effect: Foes in Star 3: -0.5 DEF and -0.5 ATK/MAG per Campaign. If 0 Campaigns: foes attacking user take 10% recoil.

Other/Special.name: Resolute Blade
Other/Special.effect: Gain/lose 1 Resolve per HP lost/gained (min 0). On miss or kill: regain Resolve spent on that attack. If Resolve > 100 before attack: Advantage dice. Max 20 Resolve from self-damage per round.

Other/Special.name: Fallen Blade
Other/Special.effect: At 25%, 50%, 75% HP missing: gain 1 Enrage (once each). +1 dice per Enrage.

Other/Special.name: Kensei
Other/Special.effect: Start of next turn: gain Resolve = X% of Resolve gained since use. X = 150 - user's max HP (max 20%).

Other/Special.name: Delirium
Other/Special.effect: Spend 25 Resolve per debuff. X = Enrage: inflict -X ACC/1, -X CR/1, -X dice/1, -5X DEF/1.\nSpend 30 more: if cleansed or prevented, target gains disadvantage dice/1.

Other/Special.name: Bushido
Other/Special.effect: Choose up to 2 allies. Gain Resolve = 50% of damage they took from attacks that didn't target user/1.

Other/Special.name: Fudoshin
Other/Special.effect: Zanshin's exceed bonuses doubled. Enrage dice doubled on crit.

Other/Special.name: Allez
Other/Special.effect: Reaction: once between turns on attack involving user. Remove 1 dice, store Focus = half of removed dice faces.

Other/Special.name: En Garde
Other/Special.effect: Spend up to 2 Focus. Per Focus: target gains HP or +DEF/1 equal to its value. May move 2 tiles after next reaction.

Other/Special.name: Parry
Other/Special.effect: Reaction: on attack involving user (no Rapier reaction since last turn). Attack loses all damage and dice buffs. Store Focus = removed buff's value.

Other/Special.name: All for One
Other/Special.effect: Reaction: when user spends Focus. If targeting same player as previous Focus spend: gain half-value Focus.

Other/Special.name: Terraform
Other/Special.effect: Place up to 3 Forest or 3 Water tiles in Cone 1 or cardinal Line 3.

Other/Special.name: Blackthorn
Other/Special.effect: Physical or Magical. Before damage: targets invert positive tile effects/1. +4 dice on secondary targets.

Other/Special.name: Bloom
Other/Special.effect: Normal tiles grant +1 ACC to user and allies/1. If last Standard was Physical: +4 MAG. If Magical: +4 ATK.

Other/Special.name: Cryosphere
Other/Special.effect: Replace up to 3 Water/Stop/Stone tiles in Pierce 5 or Burst 1 with Ice/2. Foes ending turn in melee of Ice: 15 damage. Replaced Stops cannot be fully surrounded.

Other/Special.name: All-Terrain Master
Other/Special.effect: Terraform: Every Turn, up to Twice place Normal/Sticky/Air instead of Water/Forest. End-of-turn tile bonus/1:\nNormal: +1 ACC. Forest: +10% DMG. Water: 5d4 heal. Air: attacks ignore Air, +1 Range. Boost: +6 CR. Sticky: +2 EVA, -1 range on incoming. Lava: +1 Standard (ignores ATK/MAG/DEF).

Other/Special.name: The Serenity of Nature
Other/Special.effect: If attacked or attacked: sacrifice 50-100 HP and max HP. Summon Nature Spirit in Melee (acts after user). Win requires both defeated. Disabled after use.\nNature Spirit: 125% sacrificed HP | 17 ATK/MAG | 5 DEF | 1 EVA | 4 MP. Moves: Basic Abilities, Terraform (1 tile), Rototill, Bioturbation, Wildfire, Bloom, Flower Crown.

Other/Special.name: Attuned
Other/Special.effect: Start with 5 Mana. Start of turn: gain 5 per Spellbook attack used last turn (cap 10). Gain 2 per non-Spellbook Standard/Full last turn. Mana spent only on hit.

Other/Special.name: Spellweave
Other/Special.effect: The user chooses any number of distinct usable Spellbook moves to "Spellweave", consuming a use of each move. Their next Spellbook attack this turn adds the base rolls and all secondary effects (including Mana costs) of the Spellwoven moves to its own.

Other/Special.name: Faith
Other/Special.effect: Spend 2 Mana. Heal target equal to roll instead of damage. If Spellwoven: remains attack, targeting becomes Ally/Allies (only players attacked by foe last round).

Other/Special.name: Tornado
Other/Special.effect: Spend 1 Mana. Move up to half MP (round down) and swap with target via teleport. Cannot move after.

Other/Special.name: Ichorous
Other/Special.effect: Start with 10 Mana (instead of 5). Gain 1 when hit. Infinite Mana capacity. Start of turn (after Attuned): take 3x Mana above 10 as damage.

Other/Special.name: Catalysis
Other/Special.effect: Spellbook moves (including Spellweave): ignore Frequency for rest of turn. Spellwoven: spend 2 Mana before accuracy to add targets from woven ability's targeting, once per woven move.

Other/Special.name: Conduit
Other/Special.effect: Talisman buffs/debuffs are permanent but only active when channeled. Buffs that would be removed become un-channeled. Dice channeled with DMG.

Other/Special.name: Resonate
Other/Special.effect: Restores a use after Standard/Full Talisman ability. Gain one buff: +3 DMG, +3 PDEF, +3 MDEF, or +1 ACC.

Other/Special.name: Divine Merit
Other/Special.effect: Target gains +2d4+1 damage on next attack. If on self: channel DMG next turn. Cannot target same target twice.

Other/Special.name: Sanctuary
Other/Special.effect: Next channeling: +1 round.

Other/Special.name: Heaven's Will
Other/Special.effect: Resonate: Trigger, up to 2x/turn. If buff removed by foe: apply as debuff to foes in Star 2/1.

Other/Special.name: Double or Nothing
Other/Special.effect: Roll d2. 1: target cannot use Swift/Free until end of user's next turn. 2: target gains +1 Swift (or multiple Free) until user's next turn. Self: must use at start of turn.

Other/Special.name: Card Counter
Other/Special.effect: Once per turn: reroll Cards dice effect (Craps: reroll damage dice).

Other/Special.name: High Roller
Other/Special.effect: Per remaining Standard: roll 1d5. Targeting amount = roll - 1 (1: lost).

Other/Special.name: Lunar Phase
Other/Special.effect: Start of first turn: choose Phase. Start of each turn: shift Phase. Cannot be disabled.\nNew Moon: +1 Range. Waxing: +2 dice faces. Full Moon: -1 dice on attacks targeting user. Waning: +1 dice. Cycle repeats.

Other/Special.name: Lunar Shift
Other/Special.effect: Shift to next Phase. If Moonblast active: transfer to new Phase.

Other/Special.name: Celestial Blessing
Other/Special.effect: Until next turn: targets gain user's next Phase effect. User's Phase disabled next turn.

Other/Special.name: Far Side of the Moon
Other/Special.effect: Choose another Phase (doesn't shift). Active when original Phase not affected by Moonblast/Celestial Blessing. May use for Lunar Rod effects.

Other/Special.name: Future Sight
Other/Special.effect: Delay attacks always land if they hit (even if dead).\nDelay: damage and effects delayed X rounds, land at start of user's turn. Damage rolled on use.

Other/Special.name: Omen
Other/Special.effect: Next attack: +1 delay

Other/Special.name: Astral Touch
Other/Special.effect: If target kills user within 1 round: reduce delays on them by 1. If target dies within 1 round: transfer one delay to new target in original's Range 7.

Other/Special.name: Foresight
Other/Special.effect: Reaction: when user attacked, after damage rolled. Remove 10% damage. Add to: 1) delayed attacks, or 2) user's HP x number of delayed attacks.

Other/Special.name: Scoundrel
Other/Special.effect: When the user rolls 13 or below on their damage roll of a Cutlass attack (excluding base modifier and ATK/MAG/DEF), the user gains 1 Coin. Any number of Coins can be spent when the user uses a Cutlass move that's effect contains "chooses", the user then chooses an additional option.

Other/Special.name: Swindler
Other/Special.effect: When spending Coin: roll 1d2. 1: -1 dice, +DMG = half removed dice size. 2: base rolls 13 or lower treated as 16.

Other/Special.name: Buy Time
Other/Special.effect: Spend 1 Coin: next Cutlass attack effect +1 round.

Other/Special.name: Deathly Crew
Other/Special.effect: Coin kill: gain 1 Trick Coin. Until spent: +4 DEF, +1 CR. Max 1 Trick Coin from this effect.

Other/Special.name: Bloodthirst
Other/Special.effect: Max 10 Blood. End of turn: gain 2. When hit: gain 1. At 10 Blood: next attack auto-hits, lose all Blood, double damage if already hits.\nThirst N: active when N+ Blood on move select (mandatory).

Other/Special.name: The Urge
Other/Special.effect:
Passive bonuses:
Thirst 3: +1 MP.
Thirst 4: immune to Slow, Root, Seal, Stun. Half Confusion/Cripple damage.
Thirst 6: +1 base dice.

Other/Special.name: Sky Turns Red
Other/Special.effect: The user's next 2 Fangs attacks on foes cannot cause the user to lose Blood and gain "Thirst X: This move ignores X DEF, and heals equal to 5 * X% of the damage dealt to one target." (X is equal to the user's Blood).\nThis effect ends if the user reaches 10 Blood, if they use Indulge (before accuracy), or if they use a Free action to end it early.

Other/Special.name: Nocturnal Predator
Other/Special.effect: No normal turn. Extra turn after each foe's turn. Duration/frequencies count on normal turn. MP halved on extra turns.

Other/Special.name: Ramping Magic
Other/Special.effect: When targeting 2+ foes with Scissors: AoE +1, Push/Pull +1. Once between turns.

Other/Special.name: Silk Cocoon
Other/Special.effect: Create Silk Cocoon (Star tile) on unoccupied tile. Replaces existing. Acts like Ice (25 HP). User deals max 15 damage to it. Scissors effects ignore its Ice Clause. Tiles in Burst 1: +1 MP to enter. Does not stack. Range cannot be increased.

Other/Special.name: Jammed Blades
Other/Special.effect: Silk Cocoon: Every Turn, immune to damage, disappears start of next turn. Piercing Jab: max 3 dice.

Other/Special.name: Silken Suit
Other/Special.effect: First time damaging or damaged by a foe: take 20% less damage/1.

Buff.name: Rising Hope
Buff.effect: gain +1 ACC/1 and +1 CR/1. Max 2 Rising Hopes affecting a player.

Buff.name: Primadonna
Buff.effect: If origin has more MAG: gain +4 MAG/1 and -3 MDEF/1. If not: gain +4 ATK/1 and -3 MDEF/1. Targets with both ATK and MAG buffed also gain +1 dice/1, doubled on crit.

Buff.name: Mending Mantel
Buff.effect: Place Hearth tile. When user or allies end turn in its Star 3: gain +5 DEF/1 and heal 5 HP. Hearth acts like Stone. Removed when user dies.

Buff.name: Martyrdom
Buff.effect: Gain +15% healing/1. Healed targets gain +1 EVA and +1 MP/1 (max +3). Per dead ally: +15% healing.

Buff.name: Pavise
Buff.effect: Until next turn: when user or ally in Burst 2 hit by attack, damaged players gain +3 DEF/1 per damaged player.

Buff.name: Bound Bow
Buff.effect: Physical attacks become Magical when targeting at Range 3+. Once per turn: when attacking at Range 1-2, gain +3 DEF/1.

Buff.name: Invigorate
Buff.effect: Bonus varies by subweapon.\nGladius: +5 DMG/1. Scutum: 7 Shield/1. Pilum: +1 ACC/1 and +1 CR/1.

Buff.name: Zanshin
Buff.effect: Max 150 Resolve. When exceeding max: next attack gains +1 ACC/1, +1 CR/1. Fallen Blade: every 1/6 HP.

Buff.name: Jackpot
Buff.effect: When rolling max on all dice (total >= 8): gain +7 ATK/MAG/1, +7 DEF/1, +1 EVA/1, +1 ACC/1, +2 MP/1. Hi-Lo: activates on max dice. Refreshes duration, does not stack.

Damage.name: Dissonance
Damage.effect: inflict 3 Bleed/1. Ignores ATK/MAG, half DEF, and outside damage factors. If target hit twice, +3 DMG/1.

Damage.name: Soulstep
Damage.effect: Move up to MP. Targeting before or after movement. Ignores outside damage factors, DEF, and ATK/MAG.

Damage.name: Arrow Flurry
Damage.effect: If target has Mark: Splash 1. If target has 3+ Marks: Splash 2 instead.

Damage.name: Cursed Bolts
Damage.effect: inflict 3X Curse/1 (X = Marks on target). If target has 3+ Marks: ignores negative outside damage factors.

Damage.name: Arrow Net
Damage.effect: Before damage: target takes 3 damage each time they gain a Mark from user/1.

Damage.name: Pierce
Damage.effect: If target has 1+ Marks: ignores EVA and 1/4 DEF. If 2+ Marks: also ignores negative ACC modifiers and ignores 1/2 DEF.

Damage.name: Quick Scope
Damage.effect: Ignores ATK/MAG, half DEF, and outside damage factors (except Hunter's Mark).

Damage.name: Explosive Shot
Damage.effect: The target holds a "Bomb". If a foe with a Bomb targets another foe (including their allies) they transfer the Bomb to one of their targets.\nAfter one round or when the holder dies, the Bomb detonates and deals Xd4 Bomb damage to foes in the Bomb's Burst 1. X = the foe who held the Bomb with the most Marks.

Damage.name: Tornado Bolt
Damage.effect: Push X (X = 1 + Marks on target). If target cannot be pushed full distance: gain +1 Mark.

Damage.name: Serrated Arrows
Damage.effect: inflict X Bleed/1 (X = half of Hunter's Mark damage from this attack).

Damage.name: Swift Shot
Damage.effect: If target is at Range 7+: crit on 14+. If target is under Range 3: gain +1 MP/2.

Damage.name: Crippling Shot
Damage.effect:
Effect varies by range.
1-2: inflict Slow/1.
3+: inflict 2 Cripple/1 on accuracy 14+.
7+: inflict Cripple regardless of accuracy.

Damage.name: Blessed Arrow
Damage.effect: Allies in target's Star 2: healing and buffs x1.25/1. Foes in target's Star 2: debuffs x1.25/1. Does not stack. As non-damaging Standard: 1/Tile/Range 10.

Damage.name: Scatter Shot
Damage.effect: If target is at Range 7+: Splash 1.

Damage.name: Arcane Shot
Damage.effect: If target under Range 3: Push 3. If target at Range 7+: ignores up to 10 DEF.

Damage.name: Chase Arrow
Damage.effect: Targets within 8 tiles. May target foes on path to original target (path cannot exceed range). Damage to path foes: ignores ATK/MAG and DEF.

Damage.name: Volley
Damage.effect: If target is 7+ tiles away: +1 hit. If foes in Splash 1 of target: +2 hits. Bonus hits target random foes in Splash 1 (including original). Each: half target DEF, ignores ATK/MAG.

Damage.name: Fireworks
Damage.effect: If target at Range 7+: Bomb dice. If target under Range 3: Bound Bow becomes +5 DEF/1 and +1 MP/1 until user attacks at Range 3+.

Damage.name: Blitz
Damage.effect: Crit on 18+. Per hit: gain +4 damage on next attack.

Damage.name: Windmill
Damage.effect: Non-Foe targets: gain +X ACC or CR/1 (X = players in range). As Swift: buffs halved. Attack only as Standard against Foes.

Damage.name: Hook Shot
Damage.effect: If +2 CR: Pull user within Range 2 of target, or target within Range 2 of user. Not an attack on Allies.

Damage.name: Splinter
Damage.effect: Per crit: next attack gains -1.5 dice faces and +1 base dice. Dice faces round up

Damage.name: Salvo
Damage.effect: May target different foes per hit. Adds ATK/MAG and applies damage effects to each.

Damage.name: Trick Shot
Damage.effect: If +ACC: Splash 1. If +4+ ACC: becomes Magical, Splash 2.

Damage.name: Surge
Damage.effect: Per crit: next multi-hit attack gains +1 hit.

Damage.name: Venom Shot
Damage.effect: Non-Hawkeye +ACC treated as +CR. inflict Poison/1 (X = 2 * +CR). If 12+: halve poison, extend 1 round.

Damage.name: Sagittarian Pride
Damage.effect: Hits = number of moves targets used since user's last turn.

Damage.name: Arrow Storm
Damage.effect: Crit on 18+.

Damage.name: Shrapnel Tip
Damage.effect: Per crit: gains +1 hit (MR 3, 2d3+0).

Damage.name: Overdraw
Damage.effect: Next attack gains one bonus:\nIf single-hit: non-duration numbers doubled (including X).\nIf multi-hit: +ACC treated as +dice faces on accuracy rolls.

Damage.name: Bloodrush
Damage.effect: If used from max range: gain +5 DMG/1 and +1 MP/1.

Damage.name: Defile
Damage.effect: inflict 3 Curse/1. When foe takes Curse damage: user takes equal CP.

Damage.name: Purloin Youth
Damage.effect: Attacks targeting user: 10% recoil/1. User sacrifices half recoil to CP.

Damage.name: Pentagram
Damage.effect: Start of next turn: foes in user's Burst 1 take 2d6+3 + user's CP damage.

Damage.name: Massacre
Damage.effect: If kill: gain 2x CP and +1 use of Massacre. If not: no CP sacrifice.

Damage.name: Exsanguinate
Damage.effect: If CP from this move grants Black Magic bonus: +1 to that bonus.

Damage.name: Siphon Soul
Damage.effect: Before accuracy: heal HP equal to CP.

Damage.name: Reap
Damage.effect: Reaper's Touch heals 1/5 instead of 1/8 on this attack.

Damage.name: Hades' Toll
Damage.effect: Reaper's Touch heal +50% on attacks against target/2.

Damage.name: Haunted Swing
Damage.effect: Targets at full HP: +5 damage. Heal 5 HP per target triggered.

Damage.name: Wither Soul
Damage.effect: Per debuff or status on target: Reaper's Touch heals +3 HP.

Damage.name: Pestilent Strike
Damage.effect: inflict X Poison/1 (X = Reaper's Touch healing from this attack). If X >= 6: halve poison, extend 1 round.

Damage.name: Coup de Grâce
Damage.effect: If kill: heal 10 HP, gain +5 damage to next attack.

Damage.name: Spirit Break
Damage.effect: inflict -3 DEF/1. gain +3 DMG/1.

Damage.name: Memento Mori
Damage.effect: Delay-1. May delay up to +2 more turns. Per extra delay: Reaper's Touch heals +1/8 of damage.

Damage.name: Stroke of Midnight
Damage.effect: Before damage: Reaper's Touch healing becomes +damage on this attack/1. Other Scythe healing becomes +DMG/1.

Damage.name: Phantom Blade
Damage.effect: Reaper's Touch heal on this attack = HP healed from Scythe abilities (except Phantom Blade) last round.

Damage.name: Void's Call
Damage.effect: Pull targets towards Totem tile instead of user.

Damage.name: Left-Hand Path
Damage.effect: User moves along line from origin until hitting obstruction. If no Totem: inflict -2 EVA/1 and -3 DEF/1.

Damage.name: Heredity
Damage.effect: Totem moves adjacent to target. Heal HP sacrificed to create it. If no Totem: place one on target's tile.

Damage.name: Feral Spark
Damage.effect: Target: 10% recoil/1. User's current Totem type numerical effects doubled.

Damage.name: Blasphemy
Damage.effect: inflict 6 Curse/1. While Cursed: targeting an ally extends Curse 1 round.

Damage.name: Sacrificial Lamb
Damage.effect: Before accuracy: players in Totem range sacrifice 5 HP. Per sacrifice: +1 target, +1 base dice, -1 MR.

Damage.name: Ancestral Wrath
Damage.effect:
Requires Totem within Range 5. Targets within Totem range. Effects by type:
Blood: targets cannot leave Totem range/1.
Bone: cleanse debuffs/statuses on allies, cleanse buffs on foes in range.
Soul: heal allies in range for 1/3 of damage dealt.

Damage.name: Exercitus
Damage.effect: Gladius: swap to Scutum. Scutum: Push 3, swap to Pilum. Pilum: inflict 4 Cripple/1, swap to Gladius.

Damage.name: Disengage
Damage.effect: Gladius: inflict -2d6 DEF/1, Push 1. Scutum: half AoE damage/1, push back 1. Switch to Pilum.

Damage.name: Forward Jab
Damage.effect: Requires Pilum. +1 base dice

Damage.name: Breach
Damage.effect: Switch to Gladius or Scutum. Gladius: foes entering melee take 3d8 damage/1. Scutum: user and allies in Burst 2 cannot have DEF ignored/1.

Damage.name: Phalanx
Damage.effect: Requires Scutum. Reaction: when foe hits user or ally in user's melee. If target in melee: +1 dice, swap to Gladius. If not: swap to Pilum. Ignores outside factors, ATK/MAG, half DEF.

Damage.name: Shield Wall
Damage.effect: Requires Gladius or Pilum. Switch to Scutum. Flat modifier on base rolls targeting user becomes negative/1. May be non-damaging Standard.

Damage.name: Deus Vult
Damage.effect: Requires Scutum. Before accuracy: immune to statuses and debuffs/1, remove existing.

Damage.name: Weapon Crash
Damage.effect:
Varies by subweapon.
Gladius: 1/Foe/Melee, +3 dice faces.
Scutum: AoE/Foes/Cone 2, attacks on user immune to positive outside factors/1.
Pilum: AoE/Foes/Pierce 5, -3 MR.
Dual Wield: pick one range and one effect.

Damage.name: Impede
Damage.effect: Pilum: steal targets' buffs (duration 1). Switch to Scutum.\nScutum: becomes AoE/Foes/Beam 4. Switch to Gladius.\nGladius: gain +1 MP/1, reduce other cooldowns 1 round. Switch to Pilum.

Damage.name: Thwack
Damage.effect: Only Stun can prevent use. +1 dice per 5 ATK or MAG (whichever higher) target has above 20.

Damage.name: Grave of Titans
Damage.effect: Ignores DEF. Per 10 max HP target has above 120: +3 DMG, -1 MR. If damage reduced by foes: next Standard/Full gains +1 ACC/1, +1 CR/1, and +1 dice.

Damage.name: Inertial Shift
Damage.effect: If foe moved or attempted to move user last round: +2 dice, becomes Homing 8 (Pull 7).

Damage.name: Pole Vault
Damage.effect: Teleport to unoccupied tile in range (ignores range reduction, even on miss). Targets foes in Splash. If no foes: not an attack.

Damage.name: Hardwood Slam
Damage.effect:
Choose status if condition met. -2 MR (Poison), +2 dice (Confusion), or heal 5 HP (Bleed).
5 Poison/2: if user ACC negative or target EVA increased.
Confusion/2: if target's ACC caused them to hit or trigger effect on user/allies.
6 Bleed/2: if target crit or had +dice on attack on user/allies.

Damage.name: Exploit Feign
Damage.effect: inflict -4 DEF/1 or -4 DMG/1. If user debuffed by foe: cleanse before accuracy, +1 hit, debuff doubled.

Damage.name: Stance Breaker
Damage.effect: If target gained >5 DEF, HP or Shield last round: advantage dice. gain 75% of highest as Shield/1.

Damage.name: Calamitous Trance
Damage.effect: If target dealt 50+ to user last round: +3 dice. If 75+: +4 dice faces. -1 MR per hit on user since last turn. Confusion/2 when MR < 4.

Damage.name: Disarm
Damage.effect: Each target's next Standard/Full on user: -1 dice

Damage.name: Spurn
Damage.effect: If target can attack from Melee next turn but doesn't: user may AoO them at end of turn.

Damage.name: Figure 8
Damage.effect: Reaction: when foe willingly moves out of user's Range 2 from Melee

Damage.name: Reversal
Damage.effect: If target can end turn on different tile type but doesn't: gain +2 ACC/1, next attack ignores half DEF.

Damage.name: Standoff
Damage.effect: If target ends next turn in user's Melee: user may AoO (ignores ATK/MAG).

Damage.name: Dazing Hook
Damage.effect: Range cannot be reduced. If target attacked user outside Melee last round: inflict Confusion/1 and Inverse Bomb dice/1.

Damage.name: Gale Force
Damage.effect: Regardless of accuracy: teleport any targets to any unoccupied tiles in range. Not an attack on Allies or when Movement.

Damage.name: Feral Chop
Damage.effect: X = 2.5 * user's Rage.

Damage.name: Chain Axe
Damage.effect: Bloodlust grants +1 Rage per damage instance/1.

Damage.name: Power Swing
Damage.effect: Spend X Rage: -X MR

Damage.name: Wide Slash
Damage.effect: Up to 2x: spend 2 Rage for +1 range.

Damage.name: Knockback
Damage.effect: inflict Slow/1. Spend 1 Rage: +1 Push and/or inflict Cripple 6/1 instead.

Damage.name: Franciscate
Damage.effect: Gain +2 MP

Damage.name: Gash
Damage.effect: Spend Rage: inflict 5 Bleed/X (X = Rage spent).

Damage.name: Sever
Damage.effect: Spend Rage: +1 hit and +1 MR per Rage.

Damage.name: Amped Strike
Damage.effect: +damage = 4 * user's Rage. Lose all Rage.

Damage.name: Wrath
Damage.effect: Spend 2 Rage per effect (cost +1 each use). Choose: +4d10 base roll, Splash 2, or -3 MR. -2 ACC on Tile.

Damage.name: Cyclone Sweep
Damage.effect: +dice = number of targets hit.

Damage.name: Storm Strike
Damage.effect: Teleport to tile in target's Splash 1. inflict Slow/1.

Damage.name: Seismic Smash
Damage.effect: inflict 2 Cripple/2.

Damage.name: Crush
Damage.effect: If target cannot be pushed full distance: +1d10+5 damage.

Damage.name: Earth Render
Damage.effect: After damage or miss: replace up to 2 unoccupied tiles in Burst 2 of target with Broken (2 rounds, or until user dies/removes as Trigger).

Damage.name: Lagging Spin
Damage.effect: Ignores 4 DEF per MP spent moving away from start tile. If all MP spent moving away: +2 dice.

Damage.name: Shockwave Slam
Damage.effect: Splash hits foes in target's Star. Original target: Push 2 in chosen direction. Splash targets: Push 2 away from original.

Damage.name: Collision Course
Damage.effect: Original target: Push to tile in their Range 5. Subsequent: Push to tile in their Range 3. Can Push user/allies via Unstoppable Force (no damage). Each target once.

Damage.name: Fissure
Damage.effect: Regardless of hit: push target. Tiles target exits while pushed become permanent Broken (unremovable, unignorable). Foes entering Burst 1 of Broken: 2d8 damage, once/turn per foe. User may remove any as Trigger on their turns.

Damage.name: Razor Rust
Damage.effect: Target: 3 MP/1. Apex: inflict 5 Cripple/1.

Damage.name: Tomahawk Toss
Damage.effect: X = 4 - range used at. Apex: Pull 3

Damage.name: Kip Up
Damage.effect: Push regardless of hit. May negate Push: teleport 1 tile away from target. Ignores outside damage factors, ATK/MAG, DEF.

Damage.name: Repulse Slice
Damage.effect: No Push on Apex. Apex: per tile target moves toward user next turn: Plate Crusher values +1.

Damage.name: Continental Crash
Damage.effect: After Push: place Broken tile in target's Melee (3 rounds). User may remove as Trigger. Foes ending turn in tile's Melee: 10 damage. Apex: hits foes in target's Splash 1.

Damage.name: Kinetic Impact
Damage.effect: If target cannot be moved full distance: +1 dice. Apex: -2 Push, +2 dice faces.

Damage.name: Two Handed
Damage.effect: If user didn't push target last turn: +2 Push. Apex: if target can't be moved full distance: inflict 7 Bleed/1.

Damage.name: Elastic Collision
Damage.effect: Before targeting: move up to MP in straight line (half diagonals). X = 1 + tiles moved. Apex: +2 CR.

Damage.name: Supreme Strikes
Damage.effect: 1 Push per hit. May target in two directions, or +1 hit in one direction. Each direction: accuracy and Apex independently. Apex: +2 hits in this direction.

Damage.name: Besiege
Damage.effect: Before accuracy: sacrifice up to 10 HP. Gain equal Shield/1. 1.5x if target >50% HP.

Damage.name: Bastion
Damage.effect: Foe attacks entering user's Cone 1: lose 2 dice/1. While in Melee of current tile: +4 DEF.

Damage.name: Catapult Campaign
Damage.effect: Cannot use at Range 2. Target >75% HP: inflict 5 Bleed/1. May self-inflict 10 Bleed/1 to double Bleed.

Damage.name: Ambush
Damage.effect: Lose all Campaigns. Coronation disabled until next turn. Per Campaign lost: gain +0.5 MP/1

Damage.name: Entrench
Damage.effect: If less than 6 bonus DEF: gain +3 DEF/1. Lose +1 Campaign per RtR instance/1.

Damage.name: War of Attrition
Damage.effect: Before damage: inflict inverse of user's active RtR bonuses/1.

Damage.name: Shock and Awe
Damage.effect: If 3+ Campaigns: attacks on user immune to positive outside factors/1.

Damage.name: Last Stand
Damage.effect: When user would take >55-3X damage (X = Campaign max): attacker takes 3d8+2, damage reduced by 3X/1.

Damage.name: Cursed Slice
Damage.effect: +1 CR. Target's next Standard/Full: 5% recoil. Spend 10 Resolve up to 5x: +1 CR and +5% recoil per spend.

Damage.name: Lunge
Damage.effect: Move adjacent to target (even on miss). Spend 20 Resolve up to 3x: -1 MR per spend. After damage: choose +10% damage dealt and taken/1.

Damage.name: Blade of Woe
Damage.effect: Before damage: inflict 5 Curse/1 on user and target. First Resolve spend after taking 55+ damage while Cursed: resolve effect +1/3.

Damage.name: Lotus Strike
Damage.effect: Spend all Resolve. X hits = Resolve/30. 5*X% recoil (no Resolve from recoil).

Damage.name: Provoke
Damage.effect: If target doesn't deal 45+ to user next turn: Resolve gain x1.75/1. Resolve gained since Provoke also x1.75.

Damage.name: Bloodspill
Damage.effect: Spend 40 Resolve: Burst 1 or Cone 2. Spend 70: Burst 2 or Cone 3. Per kill: no use consumed, +1 Enrage, advantage threshold -20.

Damage.name: Rising Sun
Damage.effect: Spend up to 100 Resolve: gain X% of damage as Shield/1 (X = Resolve/1.5). If first ability this turn: turn continues until another non-Standard/Full. While Shield active: healing doesn't reduce Resolve.

Damage.name: Giant Slayer
Damage.effect: If the user has less HP than the target, they may spend up to X Resolve, where X is the difference between the user's and target's HP. For every 10 Resolve spent, gain +2+Y damage, where Y is current Enrage.

Damage.name: Point-in-Line
Damage.effect: inflict -2 dice faces/1. If debuff not active: gain +2 dice faces/1. Spend Focus: increase one effect by half.

Damage.name: Thrust
Damage.effect: Move to tile in target's Melee. If damage removed by outside factors: inflict 2 Bleed/1. Spend Focus: +Bleed or +1 duration.

Damage.name: Counter
Damage.effect: Reaction/Standard: when foe deals 40+ to user. Ignores ATK/MAG/DEF and non-Rapier outside factors. Active Rapier effects +1 round. Next spent Focus x1.5.

Damage.name: Feint
Damage.effect: Targets take half of out-of-turn damage from user/1. Spend Focus: target gains Focus*2% recoil/1.

Damage.name: Patinando
Damage.effect: Per dice 4+: +1 Push. Per dice <4: inflict 3 Cripple/1 (stacking). After damage: spend Focus to replace dice with its value.

Damage.name: Moulinet
Damage.effect: Target gains +4 DMG/1 or +4 DEF/1. Spend Focus: heal 3 HP per ability target uses next turn. If no Focus spent: next Focus gains half-value Focus.

Damage.name: Redoublement
Damage.effect: Spend any Focus: +1 hit per Focus. Each Focus hit: +CR equal to Focus value.

Damage.name: One for All
Damage.effect: Ignores 1/4 DEF. May change splash: Star 2 (1/2 DEF) or Line 2 (3/4 DEF). Per target: gain Focus = DEF ignored.

Damage.name: Bioturbation
Damage.effect: If non-Normal tile in Burst 1: move to same tile type within Range 8. Pass through players (cannot end farther from target). Players passed through: -7 DEF/1, -1 EVA/1.

Damage.name: Hydrolysis
Damage.effect: +2 dice faces per foe on Water or Lava.

Damage.name: Wildfire
Damage.effect: If target on Forest: set Wildfire on that tile and adjacent Forest tiles.\nWildfire: lasts 2 rounds. Start of turn on Wildfire: 3d4 damage, -7 damage on next Standard/Full.

Damage.name: Nature's Madness
Damage.effect: Immune to Air tiles. Augmented by X = number of certain tile types in Burst 1. After damage: convert used tiles to Normal.\nAir/Sticky/Boost: +X Range and damage (max 3). If X>1: +1 target.\nForest/Water/Lava/Ice: choose type, inflict X status/1. If X>3: extend 1 round.

Damage.name: Windstorm
Damage.effect: Push targets in cone direction. Place 4 Air, 4 Sticky, or 1 Boost tile(s) in range. Existing Windstorm tiles become Normal. May be non-damaging Standard on tiles.

Damage.name: Scorched Earth
Damage.effect: Before Push: tiles in target's Star 1 become Lava. Counts as user damage. Once per turn per entity.

Damage.name: Fireball
Damage.effect: Spend 2 Mana. May spend more: +1 base dice per extra Mana. If any damage dice roll 1: inflict 3 Burn/1.

Damage.name: Hex
Damage.effect: Spend 3 Mana. Next Standard/Full on each target: +2 ACC

Damage.name: Plague
Damage.effect: Spend 3 Mana. Choose Bleed, Burn, Curse, or Poison. inflict 3 [status]/1. Spend +1 Mana: /2.

Damage.name: Sandstorm
Damage.effect: Spend 3 Mana. Targets: -25% damage on next Standard/Full. Push in Beam direction.

Damage.name: Scourge
Damage.effect: Spend 4 Mana. Choose one non-Basic, non-Lv 1, non-EX move per target. Targets cannot use selected moves/1.

Damage.name: Fog
Damage.effect: Spend 3 Mana. Targets cannot target beyond this move's range/1. Half MAG beyond Range 2.

Damage.name: Maelstrom
Damage.effect: Spend 6 Mana. Choose 2 effects: +5 damage, +2 ACC, +5 DEF/1 on hit, or +3 MP/2 on hit.

Damage.name: Smite
Damage.effect: Before accuracy: choose a buff to channel/1. May be non-damaging Swift on self.

Damage.name: Serpent's Gate
Damage.effect: Before accuracy: channel ACC and CR until next turn. Per accuracy 11+: +1 dice. If not: -1 dice.

Damage.name: Compass
Damage.effect: Gain +2 ACC. If miss while channeled: gain +3 CR.

Damage.name: Absolution
Damage.effect: Choose a target. Inflict target's debuffs on all other targets/1. Cleanse allies in range.

Damage.name: Seal of Solomon
Damage.effect: Choose a channeled buff: invert and apply as debuff/1. inflict Confusion/1.

Damage.name: Providence
Damage.effect: Choose PDEF or MDEF to channel and apply to allies in range/1. May be non-damaging Standard.

Damage.name: Transcendence
Damage.effect: Before accuracy: convert +ACC to +CR, +DMG to +PDEF or +MDEF (and vice versa). Converted buffs channeled/1.

Damage.name: Echo of Light
Damage.effect: Next turn: channeled buffs doubled.

Damage.name: Judgment
Damage.effect: inflict Evil Eye permanently.\nEvil Eye: debuffs on player last +1 round. Start of turn: take d4+2 per debuff. Talisman heals equal damage dealt.

Damage.name: Card Flip
Damage.effect: Roll d3 after damage. 1: 0.8x damage. 3: 1.3x damage. Outside factors also affected.

Damage.name: Discard
Damage.effect: Roll d20. 15+: store reroll (Once/Trigger) for any Cards effect.

Damage.name: Roulette
Damage.effect: Roll 1d8 for status on foe, then d3. 1 on d3: inflict on self instead. 1=10 Bleed/1, 2=10 Poison/1, 3=10 Burn/1, 4=6 Cripple/1, 5=Root/1, 6=Seal/1, 7=Stun/1, 8=Confusion/1.

Damage.name: Gamble
Damage.effect: Roll d7. 1: subtract target ATK and MAG. 2: subtract target's higher offense. 3: subtract user ATK. 4: add user ATK. 5: add target's higher offense. 6: add user MAG again. 7: add user ATK and target ATK/MAG. Adds user MAG

Damage.name: Blackjack
Damage.effect: On a successful hit, roll 2d10, treating 1s as either 1 or 11 (user's choice). The user may choose to roll additional 1d10s to add to the roll. If the total is 17-20, this attack gains 1 base dice. On a total of 21, this attack instead gains 3 base dice and activates Jackpot. On a total of 22 or higher, the attack instead loses 2 base dice.

Damage.name: Craps
Damage.effect: Bomb dice. Per Bomb trigger: choose another foe in target's Splash 1 (once per foe). 5+ Bomb: Jackpot. Immune to non-Cards positive damage factors. Crit extra dice: no Bomb.

Damage.name: Slots Spin
Damage.effect: Roll 3d4. Per 4: +1 dice. No 4s: -1 dice. All 4s: +1 more dice.

Damage.name: Hi-Lo
Damage.effect: Roll d10. Predict higher or lower, then roll again. Correct: +2 base dice, continue (max 5). Wrong: stop, lose half base dice. Same roll: reroll.

Damage.name: Stacked Deck
Damage.effect:
In place of an accuracy roll, roll a 1d14 for an effect. 
1. The opponent is healed by the roll, 
2. The user takes 2x damage from all sources for one round,
3. The attack misses, 
4. After damage, the user and target swap their current HP (can overheal, foes with over 200 HP are considered to have 200 HP for this effect), 
5. For one round, attacks automatically hit the user,
6. The user and target gain a random position change,
7. The user and target are both Stunned/1,
8. 50% of this attack's damage is dealt to a random foe instead,
9. For one round, the user's attacks automatically hit,
10. The user gains a 1/Any/Global Once/Reaction: "Reroll one accuracy roll.",
11. Cleanse all statuses and numerical debuffs from the user & reset their other moves' frequencies,
12. Target is Sealed/1, 
13. Next turn, the user may choose numbers for their cards effects, rather than rolling dice for them,
14. This attack has unremovable thrice base dice.

Damage.name: Moonblast
Damage.effect: Next Phase effect value +1.

Damage.name: Dark Reflection
Damage.effect: inflict inverse of user's Phase/1.

Damage.name: Holy Light
Damage.effect: If Moonblast or Celestial Blessing active: target's statuses (except Seal/Stun) +1 round.

Damage.name: Harvest Moon
Damage.effect: New/Full Moon: heal 1d10+2. Otherwise: no Phase shift next turn. May be non-attack Standard.

Damage.name: Tidal Wave
Damage.effect: inflict Confusion/1. New Moon: +AoE range.

Damage.name: Double Tide
Damage.effect: Crit on 16+. If at least 1 crit: gain Moonblast effect.

Damage.name: Blood Moon
Damage.effect: Waxing/Waning: inflict 2d6 Poison/1. Otherwise: inflict 3d4 Bleed/1.

Damage.name: Gravity Crash
Damage.effect:
Effect varies by Phase.
New Moon: Homing 4, target cannot use limited moves/1.
Waxing: Push 1d6, inflict 4 Cripple/2.
Full Moon: foes deal 75% to allies in Range 5/1.
Waning: Bomb dice.

Damage.name: Fatal Moonlight
Damage.effect:
Two effects if user has 2 Phases.
New Moon: Seal/1 on max range target.
Waxing: permanent +2d6 DEF.
Full Moon: +2 targets.
Waning: ignores negative damage factors.

Damage.name: Augur
Damage.effect: Delay-1: +5 DMG or +3 CR. Delay-2: both.

Damage.name: Eventide
Damage.effect: Delay-1. Target gains 3 Curse until Eventide lands. Delay-2: Curse -DEF +2.

Damage.name: Echo Burst
Damage.effect: Delay-1: lose Splash, gain +5 DEF until lands. Cannot stack.

Damage.name: Corruption
Damage.effect: On hit: target takes 5% of max HP over 100 damage. Up to Delay-2: +5*Delay%. Until lands: damaging statuses deal bonus = half on-hit damage.

Damage.name: Dawn Break
Damage.effect: Delay-2. Until lands: attacks on target have -1 MR. +1 Delay: +1 more -1 MR.

Damage.name: Oracle
Damage.effect: Add or remove 1 delay from any number of delayed attacks. May be self-targeting non-damaging Movement+Swift.

Damage.name: Scry
Damage.effect: Delay-1: Cone +1. Choose target: +10*X% of total delay on target to attack (X = targets).

Damage.name: Prophecy
Damage.effect: Per delayed move that landed start of turn: +2.5 ACC, +2 DMG. Delay-1/2: lose prior bonuses, gain +8 DMG per delayed move landing with Prophecy. Updates when delays used.

Damage.name: Fateweave
Damage.effect: Choose Delay 1-5. Per foe dying on landing turn: permanent +2 ACC, +4 CR. After lands: delays <= 2 land immediately on user death. Disabled after hit. Ignores ATK/MAG and outside factors. Gains use on miss.

Damage.name: Dirty Trick
Damage.effect: Choose Push/Pull, Splash, Buff, or Status. Target's Standard attacks lack chosen attribute/1.

Damage.name: Fancy Footwork
Damage.effect: Choose Trip or Slip. Trip: target must move 2+ tiles per direction/1. Slip: teleport to entity's Melee within Range 4.

Damage.name: Scallywag Slice
Damage.effect: Choose Outwit or Befuddle. Outwit: +1 CR, target's CR = 1 on first hit of next Standard. Befuddle: target ignores positive tile effects/1.

Damage.name: Blinding Sheen
Damage.effect: Spend 1 Coin: inflict -DEF equal to damage this turn. Ignores outside factors, ATK/MAG, DEF.

Damage.name: Boot Pin
