Damage.effect: Choose: inflict 6 Poison/2 or 6 Cripple/2. Start of turn: gain +3 DMG/1 per 6 damage from these statuses. Target may remove one status as Swift.

Damage.name: Shady Bet
Damage.effect: If gaining Coin from this attack: gain Trick Coin instead (choose Swindler effect). May spend Coin to gain Trick Coin (ignores Scoundrel).

Damage.name: High Ground
Damage.effect: Choose Pistol or Taunt. Pistol: AoE/Foes/Pierce 5, targets' Items become Movement/1. Taunt: targets' AoE become Pierce, must target user/1.

Damage.name: Swashbuckler
Damage.effect: Choose Cruel, Sly, or Daring. Cruel: +1 dice. Sly: before accuracy, end target's duration buffs/debuffs. Daring: 10 Shield/1.

Damage.name: Captain's Order
Damage.effect: Target chooses Plank or Marooning. Plank: Push 2, 4 damage per ongoing Cutlass effect on target. Marooning: target's next Standard: 25% recoil.

Damage.name: Twin Fangs
Damage.effect: Per hit: lose 2 Blood.\nThirst 5: +3 MR, Double Hit.

Damage.name: Otherworldly Attraction
Damage.effect: Accuracy per target. Statuses from this move ignored when moving toward user.\ninflict Slow/1.\nThirst 4: inflict Cripple 4/1.

Damage.name: Draw Blood
Damage.effect: Ignores ATK/DEF. Auto-hits (rolls accuracy). +1 MP this turn. If 5+ damage: +1 Blood, next attack this turn +1 base dice.

Damage.name: Uninvited Guest
Damage.effect: If first attack on target: gain 2 Blood.\nIf one attacked other last turn but not reciprocated: +8 CR.

Damage.name: Blood Wave
Damage.effect: If attacked multiple times last turn: gain 1 Blood before Thirst.\nThirst 3: inflict -X DEF/2 (X = Blood).\nThirst 5: may become AoE/Foes/Beam 5.

Damage.name: Indulge
Damage.effect: Ignores target DEF.\nThirst 7: on hit, lose half Blood (round up), heal 30% damage, cannot gain Blood until next turn.\nThirst 10: no effects.

Damage.name: Blood Whirl
Damage.effect: Accuracy per target. Lose X Blood (X = targets hit).\nThirst 4: Star 2.\nThirst 7: before accuracy, teleport up to 2 tiles.

Damage.name: Night Visitor
Damage.effect: Requires foe damaged this game not in melee. Before accuracy: teleport to melee of target.\nThirst 5: hits foes in Star 1 after teleport, inflict Slow/1.\nThirst 9: usable in melee, Star 2, lose 1 Blood +1 per hit.

Damage.name: Sanguine Explosion
Damage.effect: Reaction: when reaching 10 Blood. inflict Slow/1. Also usable without use on foe death: originates from foe, Burst 2, loses Push.

Damage.name: Lasting Cuts
Damage.effect: inflict 3 Cripple/1. If already Crippled: Cripple +2, duration set to 1.

Damage.name: Savage Spin-out
Damage.effect: Splash: Beam 1 behind target. Original: Pull 3. Splash targets: Push 1.

Damage.name: Debilitate
Damage.effect: Ignores 4 DEF, +4 per Ramping Magic proc. If ignores all target MDEF: triggers Ramping Magic.

Damage.name: Piercing Jab
Damage.effect: Per 30 damage taken since last turn: +1 dice, range upgrade (Pierce -> Beam -> Cone).

Damage.name: Enchanted Blade
Damage.effect: inflict 4 Curse/1 or 4 Bleed/1. Multiple targets: both (damage does not stack).

Damage.name: Handle Bash
Damage.effect: Pull 1 or Push 1. Teleport to Beam 2 in attack direction (Push) or opposite (Pull). Next turn: target's actions cost 1 MP.

Damage.name: Thirteenfold Cut
Damage.effect: Choose up to 3: inflict -5 DEF/1. Targets may negate. Per negation: user gains +4 DEF/1.

Damage.name: Guillotine
Damage.effect: Starts at 0 uses. Gains use on Ramping Magic proc. +1 dice per Ramping Magic proc, -1 dice per target.

Debuff.name: Warp
Debuff.effect: Teleport to tile in Range 4. Inflict -5 DEF/1 on foes in tile's Burst 1. This turn: attacks pass through players.

Debuff.name: Psychic Overlord
Debuff.effect: When foe dies to Delay damage: heal half overkill, gain +4 MAG. Choose foe with unlanded Delay: inflict -2 EVA/1 and -25% damage/1.

Debuff.name: Weaver's Whirl
Debuff.effect: gain 2d8 Shield/1. When Shield breaks: foes in Star 1: inflict -2 MP/1 (max -4).

Status.name: Ironclad
Status.effect: When attacked for 40+: inflict 2 Cripple/1 on attacker. If 55+ (before effect): nullify 10% damage, deal it back to attacker.

Status.name: Mantrap
Status.effect: Reaction: When foe ends turn within or enters tile's Star 1: inflict 3 Cripple/1 and -4 DMG/1, then remove.

Status.name: Tinker's Dam
Status.effect: Create Stone wall on target and Line 2 in chosen direction. Removed after 2 rounds, or Free action on user's turn. Foes ending turn with Stone in Melee: take 5 damage and inflict 3 Burn/1. Stone acts like Ice, 30 HP to break, 1 EVA.

Status.name: Effigial Pyre
Status.effect: Destroy Totem: inflict 13 Burn/1 on foes in tile's Burst 1. Current Totem type loses effects for game. Totem range becomes Burst 2.
